dpar skrun gsal bshad/༄༅/ /bka' babs bdun ldan ni phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa'i gsang sngags bla med kyi gdams ngag bdun gyi grub thob brgyud pa'i rnam thar yin/ 'di nyid rjar man skad du phyi lo 1914 lor bsgyur te dpar du btab cing / dbyin skad du ḍi graḍa shen pal men gyis bsgyur te phyi lo 1983 lor bod kyi dpe mdzod khang nas dpar du bskrun/ rang re bod kyi skad du ni rje btsun tā ra nā thas (1572——1634)rang nyid dgung lo nyer lnga ste phyi lo 1600 lor mdzad de gsung 'bum gyi khrod du bzhugs na'ang / rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi mdun du zhib klog bde ba'i deb gzugs logs su da res thon pa dang po yin/ da lam 'di nas dkar chag shin tu gsal bar bkod pas ma tshad zhus dag nges pa 'drongs pa gleng brjod dang bcas te rnam thar deb phreng drug par dpar skrun zhu gi yod//gzhung 'di nyid mes po'i shul bzhag 7〈 shog ngos 271 nas mjug bar du yang bzhugs yod cing / 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas bsgrigs pa yin/ nga tsho'i dpar skrun gyi ma phyi ni gang gi gsung 'bum ma pa'i dbyin ji'i shog ngos 551 nas 689 bar du bzhugs pa de lags/rnam thar 'di dag ni rang res mno bsam btang shes na gdams ngag mtshang thog tu 'khel ba zhe gcig tu snang / res 'ga' ni 'dod chags kyi nyis dmigs dngos su ston pa dang / res ni khong khro'i nyis dmigs gzugs can bzhin du snang bar byed pa zhe gcig tu tshor/ der
8 bka' babs bdun ldan/brten klog pa po kun skyes chen rnams la dad pa 'phel ba dang rang nyid rang ngo shes pa la rnam thar 'di dag kyang shin tu rngo thogs par sems/bzhugs sgar bod kyi dpe mdzod khang ni/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i bla med kyi dgongs gzhi las grub cing / phyi lo 1971 nas da bar chos rig gi gsung rab ji snyed cig dpar du bskrun yod cing / bar lam phyi lo 2000 tsam nas tshan rig dang nang chos kyi 'brel ba'i steng nyams zhib dang bod 'gyur/ bod kyi nang pa'i na gzhon ris med dge 'dun grangs bcad la tshan rig gi zab sbyong / 2005 tsam nas nang bstan gsung 'gyur gyi zab sbyong rgyun skyong gnang bzhin pa/ gsung chos 'dzin grwa 'phar ma dbu 'dzugs zhus pa bcas ni las gzhi 'phar ma gsar gtod zhus pa'i dpe mtshon tsam yin/ las gzhi de dag thams cad 'di ga'i 'gan 'dzin dge bshes lhag rdor mchog gi thad ku'i gzigs rtog 'og las don sgrub bzhin pa lags so/ /bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gi bod kyi rig gzhung nyams zhib dang bod yig dpar skrun sde tshan gyi 'gan 'dzin na ga sangs rgyas bstan dar gyis rab gnas lcags mo yos lo ste/ phyi lo 2011 zla 09 tshes 20 nyin spel ba dge legs 'phel//
sngon gleng /༄/ /rje btsun tā ra nā thas (1575 1634)rang nyid dgung lo nyer lnga ste phyi lo 1600 lor mdzad pa'i bka' babs bdun ldan zhes pa 'di ni rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi rnal 'byor pho mo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi rnam thar lags shing / grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rnam thar gyi go rim la mtshon na dus rabs dang brgyud pa rim byon/ de bzhin bla slob kyi rim pa nges can zhig med mod cing / de ni bla ma rdo rje gdan pa chen pos tshogs 'khor chen po zhig bshams te grub thob rnams spyan drangs pas thams cad dngos su rim gyis byon te gdan bshams pa la bzhugs pa'i go rim du lū hi pa dang por byon nas gdan la dang por bzhugs pas 'di ni de'i dbang du byas pa'i go rim mo/ /der byon pa'i grub thob rnams kyi grangs kyang brgyad cu rtsa bzhi yin pas 'dir brgyad cu rtsabazhi'i grangs kyang de'i dbang du byas par gsal lo//(11'on kyang bka' bab bdun ldan gyi rnam thar du ni de dang mi 'dra bar gsang sngags bla med kyi bka' babs sam gdams ngag bye brag pa bdun gyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i bla slob kyi go rim mthar chags su bzhugs yod/ /bla ma rdo rje gdan pa chen po ni bka' babs bdun ldan gas bskyed rim 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i bka' babs kyi rnal 'byor pa lnga pa de yin//1 grub thob brgyag cu ntā bzhi'i lo rgyus kyi lding gzhir slob dpon chen lha sepag dpa' rdo rjeswā phyapa sprin sta5 thob sa gnang bshad pa las lung 'dren gnang / ga sa 21 wa ṇa
10 bka' babs bdun ldan/dang po phyag rgya chen po'i bka' babs kyi brgyud pa la gtso bo rnal 'byor pa drug byon cing / de dag ni bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin nam bra hmaṇa rā hul dang / mgon po klu sgrub bam nagārdzun/sha wa ri/ lū yi pa/ maitri pa/ dga' byed skyong ngam rām pāl bcas so/ /de dag gas dang po bzhi yi rnam thar ni grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rnam thar du gsal yang / bka' babs bdun ldan du gsal ba'i rnam thar dang tha dad yin zhing / des na rnam thar phan tshun kha skong gi tshul du bzhugs zhes smras na'ang rung / de bzhin dang po gnyis kyi rnam thar ma gtogs phyi ma bzhi ste sha wa ri dang lū yi pa/ me tri pa/rām pāl bcas kyi rnam thar ni dam pa'i chos rin po che 'phags pa'i yul du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul gsal bar ston pa dgos 'dod kun 'byung du'ang gsal med/ 'on kyang de dag gi mtshan tsam dang 'ga' zhig gi ②'phrul re zung ni gsal yod/ der 'khod pa'i rām pāl ni rgyal po tsam zhig yin pa gas bka' babs bdun ldan du gsungs pa'i rām pāl ni min te 'di ni rnal 'byor pa zhig yin dgos pa'i phyir//grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i zhe bdun pa gu ru rā hul pā bod skad du bsgyur na sgra gcan 'dzin yin yang 'di nyid bka' babs bdun ldan du gsungs pa'i bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin min/ bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin ni grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i drug pa gu ru sa ra ha pā yin/ sa ra ha pā ni bod skad du bsgyur na mda' bsnun yin cing / rgya gar chos 'byung du 'di la bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po zhes kyang 'khod yod/ /'on kyang der 'khod pa'i slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po dang rgyal rigs sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ paṇḍi ta chen po rā hul shrī bha dra bcas ni slob dpon chen po bram
sngon gleng / 11ze sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po min pa mkhyen par mdzod/ dang po slob dpon ārya de wa'i slob ma dang / gnyis pa ni slob dpon chen po ye shes zhabs kyi slob ma/ gsum pa ni buddha se na'i dus kyi slob dpon zhig yin/ phyi ma de ni slob dpon klu sgrub kyi bla ma sa ra ha pā yin/ khong gi mkhan po ni gnas brtan nag po dang / de'i mkhan po btsun pa rta skad/de'i mkhan po nyer sbas yin pa gsungs so//gnyis pa gtum mo'i bka' babs kyi brgyud pa la gtso bo rnal 'byor pa drug byon cing / de dag ni wi 6pa dang / nag po wi rupa/ byā da li pa/ ḍo bi he ru ka /mi thub zla ba'am durya tsand+ra/ sgra gcan 'dzin rdo rje'am rā hul wadzdza bcas so/ /de dag las dang po wi 4pa dang ḍo bi he ru ka gnyis kyi rnam thar ni grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rnam thar du'ang gsal zhing / dang po'i rnam thar ni gzhung de gnyis su rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par tsam du zad cing / phyi ma'i rnam thar ni kha skong lta bur gyur/ wi rupa las gzhan pa'i rnal 'byor lhag ma yi rnam thar ni rgya gar chos 'byung dgos 'dod kun 'byung du mi gsal na'ang / ḍo bi he ru ka dang mi thub zla ba'i mtshan tsam ni der gsal//der gsal ba'i wi rshapa kyi rnam thar dang 'dir gsal ba'i rnam thar gnyis cung zad mi gcig pas 'dir bkod na/ chos 'byung de nyid gas/wi rū pa'i lo rgyus ni/ de yang naland+ra'i gtsug lag khang du slob gnyer byed skabs shigalan gcig de bī ko ṭar phyin pas/bud med gcig gis me tog utpal gcig dang 'gron bu gcig gtad pa blangs te phyin pas/ mi rnams mkha' 'gro mas rgyas btab pa snying re rje zer/ rgyu mtshan ci byas pas/ de
12 bka' babs bdun ldan/bor dang zer bor bas/ lag pa la 'byar te 'bor ma thub/ de nas nang pa'i mkha' 'gro ma dang 'phrad nas skyob dgos byas pas/ nged phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro ma rnams me tog sprod pa su snga dbang bar chad so byas zer/ thabs gzhan med dam byas pa na/ dpag tshad lnga'i pha rol tu phyin na thar zer yang nyi ma dgong kur song bas mi sleb ste/ 'gron khang gcig tu rdza ma kha sbub pa'i 'og tu bsdad/ stong pa nyid bsgoms so/ /nub mo de na yod pa'i mi rnams re re nas phra men rnams kyis bos/ rgyas btab pa de ma yin par shes nas yang yang btsal/ bi rupa ma mthong ba'i ngang la nam langs te de rnams gyes so/ /de nas bros te slar nā land+rar phyin/ paṇḍi tar gyur tsa na/ da ni phra men ma rnams 'dul dgos snyam/ lho phyogs dpal gyi rir phyin/ slob dpon klu'i byang chub la gshin rje gshed zhus nas zhal mngon sum du mthong / da dung yun ring du bsgoms pas dpal khro bo chen po dang mnyam par gyur skad/de nas yang de bī ko ṭar phyin pas sngar gyi phyi pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams na re/ sngon rgyas btab pa de byung zer/ nub mo 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis za bar byung ba la/ gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor du bzhengs pas de rnams brgyal zhing shi la thug par song / de dag dam la bzhag nas nā land+rar 'ongs/de nas spyod pa la byon pa yin no/ /zhes gsal/(21chos 'byung der gsal wi rupa mtshan can gzhan de ni wi rupa chung ba yin cing / 'di yi rnam thar yang shin tu ngo mtshar che bar snang bas 'dir bkod na/ de nyid las/ nub phyogs kacu'i yul du bi bha ra ṭṭa zhes bya 7 rje ba|na tāranālha/dmasna 'i chos rin po lha 'byigs pa'i yul du spri ltar dar ba'i snrolagasal kā( nā ༵ da sa 'a da kun 'byung / ga sa 162———169 da gzhung shes ga dpar
sngon gleng / 13ba'i rgyal po zhig byung / de'i bu mo de wa pā la'i btsun mor blangs te bu rās pāl skyes par bshad/ bi bha ra ṭṭa de'i dus su bi rupa chung ba byung ba yin la ༈ rgyal po de la mchod gnas phyi nang gnyis kur yod pa las rgyal po rang nang pa la mos pa zhig ste/ blon po thams cad phyi rol pa la dad do/ /der lha khang bzhengs pa la phyi nang gnyis ku'i lha'i rdo sku mi tshad tsam pa mang po bzhengs/ sangs rgyas pa rnams kyis lha khang tha dad gyis zhes byas la/ mu stegs pa rnams gcig tu bya'o zhes zer zhing / blon po rnams kyis de ltar bkod do/ /der rab gnas la bi rupa chung ba spyan drangs/ cho ga sogs gang yang mi mdzad par a yi sha /a yi sha zhes bod skad du shog shog ces pa ste de ltar gsungs pas lha rnams thams cad lha khang gi phyi rol gyi khyams su byon no / / sdod cig byas pas lta rnams sa la bzhugs so/ /der snod cig tu chab btsags te lha sku rnams kyi dbu la nar tsam nar tsam bran pas nang pa'i lha rnams har gyis bzhengs/ gad mo ding ding lha khang gi nang du bzhud/ phyi pa'i lha rnams mgo dud de khyams su lus so/ /lha khang da lta yang yod de/ amri ta khum pa zer (31gsum pa gas kyi phyag rgya'i bka' babs kyi brgyud pa la gtso bo rnal 'byor pho mo lnga byon cing / de dag ni dbang 'byor ram ind+ra bhū ti dang / rnal 'byor ma lhan cig skyes grub bam sa hātna siddhi/ padma rdo rje chen po'am padma 'dzo chen po/yan lag med pa'i rdo rje'am a rnag wadzdza/mtsho skyes te sa ro ru ha bcas yin/ ind+ra bhū ti ni grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i zhe gnyis pa ind+ra bhū ti de ni min cing / 'di ni ston pa zhal bzhugs skabs kyi rnal 'byor pa 3 gong gi mchan dang mtshungs/shog ngos 212
14 bka' babs bdun ldan/zhig yin/ de ni sam stol grong khyer 'bum tsho phyed dang gsum la dbang ba'i rgyal po zhig yin cing / khong gi sring mo ni dge slong ma dpal mo'am lakṣa smru ka ra yin/ lakṣa smru ka ra ni grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i gya gnyis pa'am rnal 'byor ma bzhi yod khongs nas tha ma de yin//rgya gar chos 'byung dgos 'dod kun 'byung nang 'di na bshad pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo gang gi yang rnam thar mi 'dug /sa ro ru ha'i mtshan tsam ni 'dug cing / der bod yig tu mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes bris 'dug na de gnyis gcig yin nam tha dad yin cha ma 'tshal/ /grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i gya gcig pa de gu ru arnagapā yin zhing / 'di nyid bod skad du bsgyur na yan lag med par gyur cing /'di dang yan lag med pa'i rdo rje rnam gnyis grub thob gcig min//bzhi pa 'od gsal gyi bka' babs brgyud pa la gtso bo rnal 'byor pho mo bcu bzhi byon cing / de dag ni rta mchog dang / pi wang zhabs sam wī nā pa/ rnal 'byor ma sgeg mo rdo rje'am wi lhasu wadzdza/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ lwa ba pa'am kaṃ bal pā/ dra ba 'dzin nam dzā gandha ri pa/ nag po spyod pa'am kroṣṭha tsārya/ bzang po'i zhabs sam bhadra pād/ tilli pa/ nā ro pa/ pa ram ḍo bi pa/ ku sa la bha dra/ a si gha na/ ye shes bshes gnyen nam dzñān mitra bcas so de dag las wī nā pa dang / lwa ba pa/ dzā landha ri pa/ nag po spyod pa/ bhadra pād/tilli pa/ nā ro pa bcas kyi rnam thar ni grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rnam thar du'ang gsal/ lwa ba pa'i rnam thar 'di na cung zad rgyas pa yod na rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par tsam du zad/ rgya gar chos 'byung dgos 'dod kun 'byung nang lwa wa pa dang /lā li ta badzra dang /ind+ra bhū ti rnams kyis cho 'phrul 'gran pa'i lo rgyus shin tu snyan pa de 'dir 'god rgyur/ de nyid las/ de yang lwa

24 bka' babs bdun ldan/tā ra nā tha'i bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po'i bla ma yin/ bla ma 'di'i mdun nas bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas sbas pas byin rlabs kyi bka' babs bdun de mched par bshad/ dī na kur ni bka' babs bdun ldan du gsal ba'i grub thob rnal 'byor ma tha ma de 'o/ /bka' babs bdun ldan 'dir grub chen lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi rnam thar thung 'bring sna tshogs shig mchis shing / de dag las dī na kur dang sa hā dza siddhi rnam gnyis ni rnal 'byor ma 'o/ /da lam 'dir grub chen de dag gi rnam thar rgya gar chos 'byung dang / grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rnam thar/ bka' babs bdun ldan bcas su gsal ba rnams cung zad mtshungs bsdur byas te gleng brjod du bkod pa lags so/ /lha rab byung na deb ther sngon po la sogs pa'i nang du yod pa'i grub chen rnams kyi rnam thar dang mtshungs bsdur gnang rgyu'i dus khom byung na phun sum je tshogs su 'gro bar som nyi bral/ 'dis kyang grub chen de dag gi ngos 'dzin thad cung zad blo kha 'byed pa'i nus pa zhig klog pa po rnams la ster bar shog ces smon 'dun dang bcas bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gi na ga sangs rgyas bstan dar gyis rab gnas lcags yos gro bzhin zla ba'i mar ngo'i tshes lnga dbyar zhag tha ma'i nyin spel ba lags so//
༄༅/ /bka' babs bdun ldan gyi brgyud pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba rin po che'i khungs lta bu'i gtam zhes bya ba bzhugs so//༄tsho༅/ /oṃ swasti/ na mo gu ra we/ bka' babs bdun ldan gyi brgyud pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba rin po che'i khungs lta bu'i gtam zhes bya ba/bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo//'gro ba kun la rdo rje 'chang gi lam//gsal mdzad rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la//gus pa'i yid kyis yang yang phyag 'tshal nas//mdzad pa'i tshul rnams mdo tsam brjod par bya//grub pa'i skyes bu gcig nyid kho na yi//ngo mtshar spyod pa'ang ②'phrul ljags ldan pas//bskal brgya'i bar du brjod par mi nus mod//'on kyang bla ma'i gsung las 'byung bzhin bri//de la kho bo cag gi bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po zhes bya ba'i zhal snga nas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa dang /gsung dbyangs yan lag rgya mtsho la skad cig re re bzhin yang 'jug par
26 bka' babs bdun ldan/mdzad pa'i phrin gas can yin pa'i phyir/ dam pa'i chos kyi bka' ji tsam mnga' ba'i tshad gzung ba ni ga la spyod/ 'on kyang rje nyid kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma grub chen zhi ba'i zhal snga nas byin rlabs kyi bka' babs bdun dang ldan par grags shing / de nyid kyi gdams pa ma lus pa yang rje nyid kyis legs par gsan pa yin no//
bka' babs dang po/phyag rgya chen po'i bka' babs/༄༅/ /de la bka' babs dang po ni/ phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag yin te / de yang slob dpon chen po bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin zhes bya ba yul o ḍi bi shar 'khrungs/ rigs ni bram ze/ gzhon nu nas rig byed yan lag dang bcas pa dang / rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad/ brtag pa brgyad la sogs pa thams cad la mkhas par gyur/ bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya la gsang tshig klog par byed cing yod pa las/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma chang 'tshong ma'i gzugs kyis 'ongs nas/ slob dpon la don dam ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnam pa myos byed du snang ba dag yang dang yang du stsal bas rnam par rtog pa med par gsol ba na/ nang du ting nge 'dzin mchog brnyes kyang bram ze'i rigs nyams par byas zhes grags pa ngan pa byung / der bram ze rnams kyis dma' dbab par 'dod pa la/ slob dpon ni nang gi rnal 'byor gyi mthus nus pa rnyed pa yin pas bram ze rnams la chang skyug pa'i sbyor ba mdzad/ rdo chen po mtsho'i steng du 'phangs te/ gal te ngas chang 'thungs na rdo 'di bying bar gyur cig /ci ste khyed rnams kyis 'thungs la ngas ma 'thungs na 'phyo bar gyur cig /ces gsungs pas chu'i steng du 'phyo bar gyur to/ /der bram ze rnams nus pas tshar bcad/ yul dbus su song ste sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung / rim gyis dge slong gne snod gsum pa ches mchog tu gyur to//slob dpon 'di'i mkhan po ni gnas brtan nag po zhes bya ba yin/ de'i
28 bka' babs bdun ldan/mkhan po btsun pa rta skad ces bya/de'i yang mkhan po nyer sbas yin zhes bla ma gsung yang mkhan brgyud rnying pa 'di dag brtag par dka' 'o/ /bod kyi sdom rgyun la ni sras sgra gcan 'dzin gyi dngos kyi slob ma yin par grags na'ang / dpyad pa med par bzhag na legs so/ /de nas nā land+ra'i mkhan por gyur/ bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad cing theg pa chen po'i mdo sde ches dar rgyas su byung ba yang slob dpon 'di'i dus yin par grags/ de nas rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bya bar dgongs te/ thugs mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gas ma g.yos bzhin du yul sna tshogs su rgyu ba na mthar gyis lho phyogs ma ra ha ṭa zhes bya bar bdag nyid kyi rgyud grol bar byed pa zhing gi rnal 'byor ma mda' mkhan gyi bu mo'i tshul can zhig gzigs te/ de'i mda' srong ba la sogs pas kyang gnas lugs kyi don brda thabs kyis mtshon nas ngo sprad pa bzhin du gyur te chos nyid mngon sum du gzigs shing / mda' mkhan gyi bu mo de nyid phyag rgyar khrid nas yul sna tshogs su spyod cing mda' bzo ba'i bya ba mdzad/ ye shes gong nas gong du 'phel bas mtshan yang sa ra ha ste mda' bsnun zhes grags/ sngon dge 'dun thams cad kyi gnas brtan yin pas ha cang yang ma rigs te/ rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo mtha' yas pa zhig gis blta bar 'ongs shing 'phyas pas/ slob dpon mda' srong bzhin du/kye lags nga ni bram ze ste//smig mkhan mo dang lhan cig spyod//rigs dang rigs min ngas ma mthong //dge slong mgo breg brtul zhugs 'dzin//
phyag rgya chen po'i bka' babs/ 29chung mar bcas te lhan cig rgyu//chags dang chags bral dbyer yod min//mi gtsang 'dir ni rnam rtog ste//'di lta gzhan gyis mi shes so//sbrul gdug lta bu'i skye bo ni//zhes sogs do ha rdo rje'i glu mang du blangs pas rgyal po la sogs pa stong phrag lnga ni gnas lugs kyi don mngon sum du mthong / lus kyang rig pa 'dzin par gyur nas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'gro zhing mthar gyis mi snang bar gyur skad/ gzhan yang phyag rgya chen po sems rnal du mtshon pa ni brgya stong du ma zhig byung bas phyogs thams cad du grags pas khyab par gyur/'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad nas sku lus de nyid kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan du bzhud pa yin gsung / 'di ni bod rnams dang mthun par byas pa yin/ phyis sangs rgyas thod pa'i zin bris rgya dpe 'thor ba gcig na/ bar du rab tu byung ba'i skor de med cing / bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin dang / gnas brtan sgra gcan 'dzin tha dad par 'dod pa'ang snang / mi nyag lo tsā ba'ang de bzhin 'dod par mngon te de dngos mi 'thad rgyu'ang med do//༈ de'i slob ma ni slob dpon klu sgrub yin te/ de yang lho phyogs zadarbhar sku 'khrungs/ rigs ni bram ze'o/ /btsas pa na ltas mkhan rnams kyis dge slong brgya/ bram ze brgya/ skye bo phal pa brgya rnams la ston mo drangs na rim pas lo bdun/ zla ba bdun/ zhag bdun 'tsho/ de las lhag pa'i thabs med zer/ pha mas kyang de bzhin byas/ dus de rnams rdzogs su nye ba
30 bka' babs bdun ldan/na g.yog dang bcas yul gzhan du 'khyam du btang bas mthar nā land+rar sleb/ mkhan po sgra gcan 'dzin gyis tshe dpag med kyi rig sngags bzlar bcug pas legs par 'tsho thub/ der rab tu byung nas theg pa che chung gi sde snod mtha' dag dang / rig pa'i gnas su gyur pa gang yang mi mkhyen pa med par byas so//de nas rma bya chen mo dang / ku ru ku lle dang / gnod sbyin mo dgu dang /nag po chen po rnams bsgrubs pas ri lu mig sman ral gri rkang mgyogs bcud len gter la sogs pa dngos grub mang po dang / tshar gcod pa dang /slar gso ba la sogs pa'i nus pa thams cad 'grub bo/ /gnod sbyin dang klu la sogs pa mi ma yin thams cad mngag gzhug tu song / khyad par bcud len grub pas rdo rje'i skur gyur/ rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes chen por gyur skad/ nag po chen po'i rig sngags grub nas dhā n+ya ka ṭa ga'i gling na nag po chen po'i rgyud bzhugs pa spyan 'dren par dgongs/ gling der mig yor (mi g.yo ba )la brten te sgyu ma bsgrubs nas sgyu mas mkha' 'gro ma rnams mgo 'khor ba'i bar la lha mo nag mo dang / nag po chen po'i rgyud brgyad de phyag gnyis gnyis pa nas phyag bco brgyad kyi bar gyi rgyud dang / ku ru ku sle'i rtog pa la sogs pa spyan drangs/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams la zhal gyi gdams pa thob/ sgrub thabs mi gcig pa brgya drug cu spyan drangs zer/ ral gri dngul chu sogs thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad char la rigs mi gcig pa mtha' yas pa bsgrubs so//dge 'dun la 'tsho ba sbyar ba'i lo rgyus ni/ mkhan po sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma sgrub cing bzhugs/ klu sgrub mkhan
phyag rgya chen po'i bka' babs/ 31por byon nas dge 'dun lnga brgya la lung 'bogs pa'i bya ba sogs mdzad cing yod pa na/ mu ge lo bcu gnyis su byung bas ma ga dha'i yul rnams stongs pa tsam byung ba na sems can gyi las su gzigs nas/ slob dpon gyis gser 'gyur gyi rtsi mdzad de gser rnams yul thag ring po mu ge med pa rnams su 'bru dang bsgyur nas dge 'dun rnams 'tsho bas mi brel bar byas/ slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin sgrub pa thon pa na yul rnams stongs par gzigs nas rgyu mtshan dris pas/ slob dpon gyi sgrub pa'i bar chad du gyur dogs zhu bar ma nus/ mu ge byung nas lo bcu gnyis lon zhus pas/ slob dpon na re/ ma legs zas kyi char 'bebs pa'i nus pa'ang nga la yod pa la / khyod sems can la snying rje chung / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang 'gal/ da ni de'i sdig sbyong (557)gtsug lag khang brgya rtsabargyad/lha khang stong / mchod rten khri phrag bzhengs dgos gsung / de dge slong gcig kho nas 'grub dka' bar gzigs nas/ yo byad gnod sbyin dzambha la las nor bslangs/ las grogs klu rnams gas 'tshol dgos pas/ re zhig klu rnams dad par byed dgos dgongs te ku ru ku lle'i rig sngags kyis klu'i rgyal po 'jog po'i bu mo 'khor dang bcas pa bkug pas/ chos gsung ba'i tshogs su mi'i bu mo'i rnam pa gnyis 'khor mang po dang bcas byung bas dpag tshad tsam tsandan sa mchog gi dris khyab bo//yang de song ba na dri de sangs 'gro/ de yo lan mang du byung / der ci yin zhes dri ba ltar mdzad pas nged klu 'jog po'i bu mo yin/ mi'i grib ma srung ba la tsandan sa mchog gis lus la byugs pa yin zer/ 'o na tsandan
32bka' babs bdun ldan/de la sgrol ma'i sku bzheng bar 'dod pas tsandan yang sbyin dgos/ kho bo gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i las grogs kyang byed dgos gsungs pas/phal bzlos nas 'ong zer ba/ de'i nangs par de gnyis na re/ klu'i rgyal po'i mchid nas slob dpon nyid klu yul du phebs na bka' bzhin byed/ gzhan sgrub mi nus zer/ de nas sher phyin 'bum pa spyan 'dren pa sogs klu dang mi'i don rgya chen po gzigs nas re zhig klu'i yul du byon no/ /lo rgyus kha cig gas/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung dang gser thub la sogs pa'i zhal mthong ba'i dge slong yin zer ba lus gzhan pas che ba mang po gzigs zer te che ba tsam yin no//bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstan pa 'di'i dgra bcom pa mang po klu rnams kyi mchod gnas su 'dug pa rnams na re/ nged rnams ni dgra bcom pa yin la/ khyod dug gsum dang bcas pa'i mi zhig 'dir 'ongs pa la klu'i dug gis gnod pa mi 'ong ba'i rgyu ci yin 'dri ba la/ ngas ni rma bya chen mo'i rig sngags grub pa yin gsungs/ yang lo rgyus 'ga' las/ de rnams la rgyal ba'i bka' las ni chos thams cad ngo bos grub pa med par gsungs la/ sa'i steng gi dge slong shas che ba rnams ni de las bzlog ste smra na/ khyed rnams kyis ci ltar rtogs zhes dris pas/chos rnams kyi rang bzhin ni khyod kyi ltar yin/phyis dmigs pa'i lta ba can gyi nyan thos 'ba' zhig 'byung bar sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan gsung skad de/ dbu ma pa rnams kyis bcos pa min na rung ngo //de nas klu rnams la chos gsungs shing yun ring por bzhugs/ sher phyin rgyas pa dang / gzungs dang rtog pa'i rigs du ma spyan drangs/ 'bum
phyag rgya chen po'i bka' babs/ 33gyi zhabs nas bag tsam klus ma bskur ba yin yang zer/ dam pa'i chos la dgra lan gsum byung ba'i tshe ma tshang ba yin yang zer te phyi ma dag gsung /'bum rgya nag ma'i zhabs kyi le'u gsum ni nyi khri nas drangs pa'o/ /de nas sa steng du byon/ rig tshogs la sogs pa'i bstan bcos kyang mang du brtsams/ dge slong bde byed la sogs pa theg pa chen po la sdang ba thams cad rtsod pas sun byung / gar nyan thos sen dha pas brtsams pa'i rtog ge theg chen la rtsod pa'i gzhung mang po byung ba de dag gi dpe thams cad bsdus nas sa 'og tu sbas so//yang phyi zhig na lho phyogs dza ṭa saṃ gha ra ral pa 'joms pa zer ba'i gnas der/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba 'dus pa lnga brgya tsam dang brtsad nas tshar bcad de thams cad bstan pa la bcug go /de dag gi skabs su lha khang dang mchod rten yang grub/ slob (559)dpon 'dis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten gyis phyogs thams cad khyab yod gsung / da ltar theg chen gyi bstan pa nyi ma ltar mdzad/ dril bu brag dang byang phyogs dhing koṭa sogs ri mang po gser du bsgyur bzhed pa la/ rje btsun sgrol mas ma 'ongs pa na rtsod par 'gyur gsung bas bzlog /'on kyang gser gyi 'byung khungs mang po byung / rdo rnams gser mdog tu gyur pa tsam yod gsung / de nas lam kha zhig na byis pa mang po rtse ba la gcig rgyal por 'gyur bar lung bstan nas byang sgra mi snyan du bzhud/ gling gzhan dang mi ma yin gyi gnas su lo bcu gnyis tsam song / slar 'dzam bu'i gling du phebs tsam na sngar gyi byis pa de rgyal por gyur pa bde spyod ces bya bar song / slob dpon la gus pas mchod/
34 bka' babs bdun ldan/rgyal po'ang slob dpon gyi gdams pa la brten nas bcud len dang gnod sbyin gyi mngag gzhug grub/ dge 'dun bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang lnga brgya bzhengs so//phyis dpal gyi rir lo nyis brgya tsam gnod sbyin mo rnams kyi 'khor dang bcas te sngags kyi spyod pas bzhugs/ mtshan bzang po so gnyis kyang sku la 'grub/ phyis dbu sbyin par btang ba'i rkyen gyis lo phyed lo'i lo drug brgyar bdun cu don gcig gis ma tshang skad de/ de yang rgyal po bde spyod kyi bu chung ngu su shalta rgyal bu rab nus sam/ rgyal bu nus ldan yang zer te de rgyal srid la dga' bas ma na re/ yab slob dpon dang sku tshe mnyam par byin gyis brlabs 'dug /slob dpon rdo rje'i sku yin pas 'grong ba med/rgyal po'i sras po snga ma rnams kyang rgyal srid ma thob par 'das shing / bu dang tsha bo'i bar yang 'das zer ba shin tu yid mi dga' ba la ma na re/ 'o na thabs yod/ slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' yin pas dbu bslangs na ster bas/ slob dpon 'das pa'i tshe yab kyang 'da' bas khyod la rgyal srid 'byung zer/ rgyal bus dpal gyi rir phyin dbu bslangs pas/ mtshon chas ma chod par sngon rtswasngon pos srog chags kyi ske bcad pa'i las gzigs nas ku shas bcad nas gnang / nga ni 'di nas bde ba can du 'gro/ /phyin (phyis )nas lus 'di la yang 'jug par 'gyur/ /zhes sgra byung / der sa g.yos/ mu ge lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du byung skad//rgyal bus slob dpon bcud len grub pas slar 'grig gis dogs nas dbu dpag tshad mang pos chod pa'i sar khyer/ der gnod sbyin mos
phyag rgya chen po'i bka' babs/ 35phrogs/ dbu pha bong gi khar bzhag pas pha bong gas pa'i sa der 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs lha lnga'i rdo sku rang byon du byon/ dbu dang sku lus gnyis la yon bdag gnod sbyin mos so sor lha khang brtsigs/ de gnyis kyi bar du sngon dpag tshad bzhi tsam yod snang ba/ da ltar rgyang grags gcig kyang bag mi snang gsung / de ni bdag gi bla mas kyang mjal te/ rdo'i rtsig pa rnams 'brel te brag lta bur song ba'i lha khang cho 'phrul dang gnyan cha che ba/sgo ni med/ dkar khung nas bltas pa la/ gnyis ku'ang khri'i steng na rdo sku'i dum bu 'dra ba re 'dug gsung //༈ de'i slob ma grub chen sha ba ri yin te/ shar phyogs na gar mkhan ming sring gsum gyis klu sgrub bhang (bang )ga lar bzhugs pa la rol mo phul bas nang du bos/ skal ba dang ldan par mkhyen nas byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen gyi sku gcig bstan pas/ ngas kyang 'di mthong (561)ba zhig zhu zer/ me long zhig bstan pas kho rang dmyal ba na me la 'tshed pa mthong / shin tu bred nas 'di las thar ba'i thabs gcig kyang zhu byas pas bad mchog tu dbang bskur/ bsgoms paso snyeng༄ kho3 na mngon du gyur/byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen gyi zhal mthong / zung 'jug grub nas khyod lho phyogs kyi ri la ri dwags bshor ba ltar gyis la sems can gyi don gyis gsung / lcam gnyis la lo gi dang / gu ni zer ba phyis mkha' 'gro ma padma warti dang / dzñā na warti yin ces phyag chen brda skor ba dang do ha 'chad mkhan bod rnams zer te/ lcam gnyis dang lhan cig lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la bzhugs/ ngon pa'i bya ba byed pa ltar mdzad do/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang brnyes pas grub chen shā ba ri pa zhes grags/ ri dwags bshor ba la
36 bka' babs bdun ldan/sogs pa 'di dag ni 'phags pa'i spyod pa dang zung 'jug gi spyod pa yin gyi / gzhan rtogs pa mtho yang mi rung ba yin no//slob dpon 'di la sa ra ha chung ba zer/ de'i slob ma ni lū yi pa ste/de'i slob ma ḍi gi pa/ de'i slob ma tilli pa/ de'i slob ma nā ro pa/ de'i slob ma ḍo bhi pa chung ba/ de'i slob ma ku sa la bha dra/ 'di yang brgyud pa'i lugs gcig yin/ lū yi pa/ dā ri ka pa/ gantar pa/ ti lo pa nas brgyud pa'ang yod/༈ de la lū yi pa ni/ nub phyogs o rgyan gyi rgyal po'i yig mkhan kun tu dge ba zhes bya ba zhig lan cig grub thob sa ra ha chung ba shā ba ri pa de do ha glur len pa dang mjal/ dbang bskur dang gdams ngag gnang / de sgom zhing yig mkhan yang byed cing yod pa la/ res cig dur khrod du phyin pas mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs grag du sleb/ skye ba bdun pa zhig gi sha 'gyed pa'i lag bde ba yang byas/ rdo rje phag mos sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing /rkang pa brkyang ba spangs nas su//'khor ba'i mngag gzhug dor nas kyang //rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che//yang dang yang du bsgul bar bya//zhes gdams pas g.yeng ba med par bsgom dgos par shes te/ sngar gyi las byas na g.yeng bas khyer/ shing tog sogs la'ang 'bad rtsol dgos/bsod snyoms kyang chags sdang skye/ 'tsho ba gang gas bsgrub dgos dgongs rigs gsangs nas shar phyogs bhang (bang )ga gar song / gang gā'i 'gram
phyag rgya chen po'i bka' babs/ 37na nya'i rgyu lto ri ltar spungs pa gzigs pas/ der nya lto gsog zhing lo bcu gnyis bsgoms pas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob//o ḍi bi sha'i rgyal po dang blon po sogs 'dul ba'i dus yin par mkhyen nas/ rgyal po de la lho phyogs rgyal po zhig mjal du byung ba la/ skyed mos tshal du khri sogs bshams/ lam srang thams cad mchod rdzas sna tshogs kyis bkang / rgyal po rang gi sngon du shis brjod kyi bram ze rnams 'ongs pas/khri'i steng na mi sngon po nyi lhags kyis khyer ba skra 'dzings pa zhig nyal nas 'dug pa la/ khyed longs byas pas lan med/ bram ze sum cus 'then pas g.yo 'gul ma byung / der bram ze rnams rang stobs med pa la gad mo shor bas/ slob dpon na re/ma lus sa 'di ji tsam yin te 'jig rten gsum 'di ji tsam yin//de cha nyid kyis gcig ni mi bdag gzhan ni de yi g.yog yin na//blo bzang de yang gzhan gyi dam pa'i spyod la bzhad gad byed pa ni//e ma 'khor ba ngo mtshar re che 'di la smra mang ci zhig dgos// gsung /(563)de rgyal po la brjod pas/ de choms shig zer/ dmag rnams 'ongs pas slob dpon gyis ha ha hi hi zhes bzhad pas dmag mi thams cad rengs/ der gcig gis grub thob tu shes nas gus pa byas pas rengs pa gas grol/ des bstan te gzhan kun kyang grol/ rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes nas 'ongs te khyod su yin byas pas/ khyod kyang su yin gsung / nga rgyal po yin byas pas/ nga yang rgyal po yin gsung / khyod la rgyal po'i yo byad mi 'dug byas pas/
38 bka' babs bdun ldan/sa gzhi mal stan chen po yin te byin pa'i stan bting lag ngar glo stan 'bol ba 'khril/ /zla ba'i 'od zer sgron me rab gsal bsil yab rjes su mthun pa'i rlung / /rgya chen nam mkha'i bla re chags bral stong pa'i bud med la spyod de/ /a re rgyal ltar srid na 'jigs med bder nyal rnal 'byor rgyal po yin//byas pas rgyal po dang / rgyal blon gnyis la bde mchog tu dbang bskur/gdams pa gnang / dpal mngon rtogs kyang mdzad/ rgyal po la khyod lho phyogs ku mā ra kṣe tra na smad 'tshong ma 'di lta bu yod pas de'i g.yog gyis gsung / blon po bram ze la khyod shar phyogs pa ṭa nā na gar na chang 'tshong ma 'di lta bu zhig yod pas de'i g.yog gyis/ khyed gnyis kyis de ltar na lo bcu gnyis nas mchog gi dngos grub thob gsung / de gnyis kyis kyang srid spangs nas de bzhin byas/ rgyal pos smad 'tshong ma'i g.yog byas te der 'ongs pa'i skyes pa rnams kyi rkang pa bkru ba sogs byed cing ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pas/ gan cig nam phyed na skyes pa gcig gis ldog phyin pas khol po'i spyil po na me 'bar bar mthong / bltas pas de'i lus kyi 'od du 'dug /grub pa thob par shes/ de dang smad 'tshong mas kyang bzod par gsol/ der slob dpon gyis yul der rdo rje theg pa cher bshad//lan cig dril bsgrags te tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad/ 'khor bud med stong phrag bcu drug dang bcas pa thams cad mkha' la gshegs shing mchog gi dngos grub thob bo/ /sngar gyi skyes pa des gsol ba btab pas grong khyer gyi shar phyogs na rdo ring zhig yod/ de'i steng na glang po che'i gzugs kha shar
phyag rgya chen po'i bka' babs/ 39bstan cig yod/ lo re la yungs kur gyi tshad re 'chugs kyin yod/ nam kha nub tu bstan pa na grub pa thob par lung bstan/ grub thob dā ri ka pa'am da ri pa ste smad 'tshong ma'i g.yog ces bya ba yin no/ /blon pos kyang chang 'tshong ma'i g.yog byas pa la 'bras sbru ba'i rkyen gyis rang sems kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du mthong / der ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang du bag tsam zhig 'byams pa'i skabs 'bras rnams phug ron gyis zos pas chang 'tshong mas 'thabs/ yang dus gzhan zhig na rdo rje'i glu blangs pas skye bo thams cad kyis grub pa thob par shes/ rdo rje theg pa mang du bshad pas skye bo dpag tu med pa yang grol lo/ /'bras brdung ba'i ḍaṅgi la sems zin pas ḍiṅge par grags so//༈ yang sha ba ri'i slob ma dus phyis byung ba ni mnga' bdag chen po mai tri pa ste/ mtshan ni mai tri gupta'o/ /de yang bram ze mu stegs kyi paṇḍi ta phyis nā ro pa dang mjal nas nang par gyur te dbang dang gdams ngag zhus/ nā land+rar rab tu byung ste ratna ā ka ra shanti pa sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma mang po bsten pas paṇa chen du song nas/ bi kra ma la shī la rnam gnon tshul gyi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs/ paṇḍi ta'i bya ba dang sgrub pa spel mar mdzad cing yod pa las rdo rje rnal (565)'byor ma zhal gzigs shing / ting nge 'dzin gyi grogs su 'gro ba'i dus yin par mkhyen nas nang gi kun tu spyod pa gsang zhing spyod pa yin pa gas/ dge tshul zhig gis slob dpon bud med dang lhan cig chang gsol ba mthong nas tshogs su rgol du byung ba la/slob dpon gyis 'o ma skyugs/ dge tshul de rang la chang skyugs pa'i sbyor ba byas pas chang skyugs/ re zhig gleng ba med//
40 bka' babs bdun ldan/yang lan cig dge bskos la sogs pas rig nas brdzir 'ongs pa na chang 'o mar bsgyur/ bud med mi snang bar byas sam dril bur bsgyur zer ba'ang yod/ yang phyis gan cig 'jabs nas brdzis pas/ sngags kyis bsgyur long ma byung bas dge 'dun gyis gnas dbyung byas/ chu bo gaṅgā la lpags gdan bting nas bzhud/ de dus dge bskos jo bo rje yin skad/ de'i sgrib sbyong la mnga' bdag rang la chos gsan pa dang / bod du byon yang zer/sātstsha 'chag med mdzad kyang zer/ der nus pa ni dpag tu med pa brnyes kyang de kho na nyid cung zad ma rtogs pa la/ yi dam gyi lung bstan byung nas dpal gyi ri la shā ba ri pa 'tshol du bzhud pa/ lho phyogs kyi lam du rgyal bu sa ka ra dang 'phrad/ de dang lhan cig dpal gyi rir phyin pas de dang nye ba'i mi rnams na re/ shā ba ri pa sngon gyi grub thob yin/ da ltar ga la rnyed zer yang / rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab pas zla ba drug na mjal te/ shā bā ri pa'i dbu'i ral pa bshig pas sro shig nyil gyis byung ba yum gnyis kyis gsol bar 'dug pas mai tri pa cung zad thugs ma dad/ rgyal bu des zhabs la phyag byas pas/ a ya dza ra wa la hu gsungs pas de nyid du grol zhing 'ja' lus su gyur pas thugs dad pa 'khrungs/yang btsun mo gnyis kyis phag dang ri dwags dang rma bya gsod pa gzigs pas cung zad ma dad pa se gol gtogs pas der mi snang bar gyur/ 'on kyang dbang bskur zhing gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pas gnas lugs gzigs pa'i ye shes skyes/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mtha' yas pa'i gtso bor gyur/ da ni ral gri la sogs pa grub pa brgyad bsgrubs nas tshe bskal par gnas pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa bya snyam rdzas bsgrubs pas grub
phyag rgya chen po'i bka' babs/41pa'i ltas byung ba na/ sha ba ri pas sdigs mdzub mdzad pas thal bar song /da khyod sgyu ma des ci bya gnas lugs kyi don rgya cher shod ces gsung ba bzhin slar yul dbus su byon no//bod rnams de rjes shānti pa dang rtsod pa byas pa sogs kyi lo rgyus 'chad pa ni don la yang mi rigs par snang zhing / 'phags pa'i yul na kha skad tsam yang med gsung / bod na de ltar grags zhus pas/ bhoṭa swa na bā st+ya sā ma ya tsho ḍi ka siddhi sā dha ka kyā/ zhes gsungs te bod pa khyi'i lwa ba dam tshig spangs pa'i grub thob dang sgrub pa po gang zhes pa'o/ /des na de ni bod blun po rnams kyi brdzun phal ka sgrigs su shes par bya'o/ /slob dpon 'dis yul dbus su yid la mi byed pa gsungs pas 'ga' zhig yid ma ches pa la/gzhung gi khungs grub snying gi skor rgya cher gsungs/ rgyud kyi dgongs pa min zer ba dgyes rdor dang 'dus pa gtso bor gyur pa'i lung gis bsgrubs/ su las thob dris pa la/ dbang nges bstan brtsams te ri khrod pa'i man ngag nyams su myong bar bstan zhes bod rnams zer/ dur khrod bsil ba tshal du grong 'jug gi tshul mang po bstan/ ji ltar bzhed pa (567)thams cad nag po chen po bsgrubs pas dpag tshad brgya phrag mang po'i pha rol nas brtan g.yo'i dngos po nam mkha' las khyer 'ongs te/ ma la ba'i rgyal po'i bu mo nam mkha' las khyer 'ongs pa phyis mkha' 'gro gi gā dha ra zhes par grags/ phag cher ni shar phyogs su sa la'i nags su gtso bor bzhugs/mkha' 'gro lce spyang du sprul nas gtor ma len pa dang / lta stangs grub pa dang / sku lus gzugs sna tshogs su sprul pa sogs ngo mtshar dpag tu med pa mnga'/ sngon sha ba ri pa la ma dad pa gnyis po des sku lus gnas ma gyur/
42 bka' babs bdun ldan/dgung lo bdun cu tsam na sku 'das te bar dor phyag rgya chen po mchog 'grub bo/ /jo bo nā ro pa sku 'das pa tsam na slob dpon 'di'i 'gro don mgo tshugs pa yin/ nā ro pa tsam rang gi snyan grags dang slob ma 'du 'tshogs ni bag tsam ma byung mod/ thog mnyam la gzhan phan che shos yin/'phags yul rang du de dus rjes 'brang mang yang phyis mang rgyu med/ bal po dang bod sogs byang phyogs na ches dar bar gyur to//mai tri pa'i slob ma la/ sngar gyi bod rnying pa rnams che bzhi/ 'bring bdun/chung ba bcu zer/ 'bring dang chung gi ngos 'dzin grangs nges rgya gar ba la ma grags/ spyir rnal 'byor pa'i slob ma mkhas pa dang nus pa thob pa mang ngo //che ba bzhi po de kun nas grags pa yin te lhan skyes rdo rje/ stong nyid ting 'dzin/ rā ma pā la/ badzra pā ṇi'o/ /dang po la na ṭe ga na zer/ de kho na nyid bcu pa'i 'grel pa dang gnas bsdus pa mdzad/ gnyis pa de ba ā ka ra tsand+ra zer/ shes rab ye shes gsal ba'i gzhung brtsams/ bzhi pa rgya gar phyag na ru grags pa de yin/ rdo rje'i tshig bsdus mdzad/ de gsum sku lus kyi rig 'dzin ma thob/༈ 'dir rām pāl ste dga' ba skyong ngam/ dga' byed skyong la brgyud pa ste dbang nges bstan gyi 'grel pa mdzad mkhan de yin no/ /rig ma nus pa thob pa rnal 'byor ma rin chen lha mo mnga' bdag nyid dang mkhyen rtogs mnyam par grags/ gaṅgā dha ri phyed kyi go 'phang can yin par grags so/ /de ni rigs rgyal rigs/ lho phyogs kuṇa ṭa kur 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas rig pa'i gnas mang po mkhyen/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa lo bcu gnyis su bsten/mai tri pa sku gshegs nas mchod rten dpal yon can du lo gsum bla ma'i
phyag rgya chen po'i bka' babs/43mya ngan byed cing gtam yang mi gsung / rtse gcig tu sgrub pa mdzad cing bzhugs/ de nas snying po'i don thams cad mngon du gyur nas nyo phyogs su sems can gyi don mdzad cing bzhugs/ nag po chen pos ral gri'i dngos grub byin te/ sku lus de nyid ma spangs par sa 'og tu dpal gyi sgor bzhud nas lha min gyi gnas na da lta yang bzhugs zer/ de la ni slob dpon ku sa la bha dra chung ba dang / a si ta gha nas kyang phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag rnams zhus so/ /khyad par ye shes bshes gnyen gyis gsan no/ /slob dpon chen po zhi ba'i brgyud 'dzin rnams mai tri nyid la bsngags pa che/ a ma na si la mchog dman gyi dbye ba bag tsam mdzad do/ /rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ phyag rgya chen po'i brgyud pa'i skabs te dang po'o// //
bka' babs gnyis pa/gtum mo'i bka' babs/༄༅/ /bka' babs gnyis pa ni gtum mo yin te/ de yang snga rol nas kyang gtum mo'i gdams pa med pa ni ga la yin/ tra rū pas kyang bla ma gzhan la ma gsan par ma nges (569)mod/ 'di pa'i lugs kyis re zhig slob dpon bi rū pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la mngon sum du zhus pa yin no//slob dpon de ni nā land+ra'i paṇḍi ta dge slong zhig yin pa las/ der chang yang gsol ba dang / bud med dang lhan cig spyod pa la dge 'dun gyis gnas nas phyung / de nas gaṅgā'i 'gram du gru pa la gru gtong dgos byas pas/ gla dgos zer ba la gla ster rgyu med de gaṅgā la sdigs mdzub bstan pas gaṅgā gyen du bzlog nas pha rol tu song //de nas o ḍi bi shar chang 'tshong ma gcig la chang nyo byas pas rin dgos zer/ nyi grib mtshams sa la ri mo byas te 'di las ma 'das gong du sbyin byas nas/ nyi ma la mdzub mo bstan nas btod la mnan te chang gsol/de nas gtong ma 'dod de dbyug tshod dang mel tshe thams cad 'phyugs/rnal 'byor pas nus pa bstan par shes te rgyal pos chang rin byin nas btang bar zhus pas/ zhag gsum gyi tho rangs su song yang zer/ de nas triliṅga'i rgyal po'i mchod gnas byas/ mu stegs kyi mchod pa kun gyi phud zos/ phyag mi 'tshal bas rgyal po sogs kyis rgol ba la/ slob dpon gyis phyag byas pas mu stegs kyi lha thams cad gas/ lha'i gtso bo ni bi shwa nā tha
gtum mo'i bka' babs/ 45bya ba 'jigs sdes bzhengs pa ling ga gdong bzhis mtshan pa gcig yod pa de bzhi tshal du gas yod gsung / de nas ḍā ki nī pa ṭar mu stegs pa'i tshogs khang du byon/ der mi phal pa su byung ba la tri shu la rang zug ste shi ba'i sha la phra men ma rnams tshogs byed pa yin pa la/ slob dpon gyis thal mo brdabs pas tri shu la chag /tsaṇḍi ku'i rdo sku rang byung gul gul byed pa la mgo lcag bsnun pas mgo brang na mar sleb/ rna ba ya gar lus pas krong nge ba da lta'ang 'dug gsung / phyin chad sems can la gnod pa mi byed par bka' bsgos/ ḍā ki nī pa ṭa zhes pa 'di bod rnams lho phyogs yin zer na'ang yod ni shar phyogs na yod par gda'o//yang lha mo 'di 'dul ba po go rakṣa yin zer ba'ang yod/ de nas sau raltar byon nas so ma nā tha zhes bya ba lha dbang phyug chen po'i rdo sku rang byung gcig yod/ cho 'phrul shin tu che/ de la sdigs mdzub bstan kyang 'gas su ma 'dod nas ci yin brtags pas/ steng na spyan ras gzigs kyi sku zhig snang skad/ kha cig 'od zer can ma'i sku yin nam yang zer/ de bsal bas dngos su gzugs bstan nas bka' bzhin byed par zhus pa la/ slob dpon gyis khyod kyi mchod gnas su dge 'dun brgya rtsa zhig mchod cig /srog bcad pa'i mchod pa ma len/ phud kyis nga'i sku la mchod pa gyis gsung //kho na re/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa myur du 'jig la/ nga la mchod pa rtag tu 'ong mod/ 'on kyang bstan pa nam gnas kyi bar dge 'dun mchod zer/ slob dpon rang rdo sku gser 'gyur rtsi phyag tu bsnams pa cig tu song zer/ re zhig dngos su mi snang bar thal/ nyin re bzhin rdo sku'i phyag gi gser 'gyur rtsi de blangs te lcags zangs mang po la reg pa tsam gyis
46bka' babs bdun ldan/gser du 'gro bas/ de la brten te dge 'dun gyi 'tsho ba sbyor/ phyi zhig na dzo na gha ṭa'i rgyal po zhig gis gser srang khri phrag gnyis zhus nas/ da dung zhu snyam pa la rdo sku'i spar ba bsdams/yang bram ze dbul po zhig gis sa the btsugs nas gsol ba btab pas gser 'gyur rtsi gnang / zhag bdun nas khyer shog gsung / des zhag gsum gyi bar du (571)yo byad gser du ci 'gyur byas pas/ rgyal po'i mi gnyis byung nas len par brtsams pa la/ bram zes rdo sku'i phyag tu phul bas yang spar ba bsdams/ rgyal po'i mi gcig gis phyag la dbyug pa bsnun pas rang lag pa chad nas shi /gcig gis lag pa chog byas pas kha lkugs/ rgyal po yang sems smyo byung nas 'das pas shin tu gnyan par grags/ da lta de na dge 'dun ni med/ nags tshal bgrod dka' ba cig gi dkyil na rdo sku smug nag zhal gdangs pa zil che ba zhig yod gsung //yang bar skabs rgyal po rā ma pā la'i dus su rnal 'byor pa si ro pa zhes par mtshan btags nas kyang yul dbus su 'gro ba'i don ci rigs mdzad/ zhabs bkrus pa'i khu ba rgyal po rā ma pā la'i glang po che bha na wa da la la blud nas g.yul 'thab pas kla klo'i rgyal po brgyad (brgya )tsam thul/dus phyis shar phyogs go ra'i yul du stag gzig gi rgyal po zhig gnyid sad pa'i sngas mgo na rnal 'byor pa zhig 'dug /chu bo la bskyur bas yang yang ldog /me la bsregs pas kyang ma tshig /mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnun kyang ma bsnad cing mtshon cha rnams chag /dug khal drug gsol du bcug /nyin zhag phrugs gcig mi mang pos bsrungs pas slob dpon stobs dang mdangs rgyas par mthong nas/ grub pa thob par shes te su yin zhus pas/ bi
gtum mo'i bka' babs/47rū pa yin zhes gsung / der yang skal ldan 'ga' la gdams ngag gnang ba dang / gus par bsten pa la bden tshig tsam brjod pas thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa mang du byung / bhang ga lar zla ba bzhi tsam dngos su kun gyis mjal du rung bar bzhugs/ phyis gar gshegs cha med/ rgya nag tu dngos su byon pa'ang 'di skabs ka yin/ bi rū pa mi yul du lan gsum 'byon par grags pa gsum char sngar song ngo / /slob dpon 'di la shrī dharma pā la zer yang / gnas brtan dharma pā la zhes bya ba nā land+ra'i mkhan po mdzad pa de dang mi gcig go/༈ de'i slob ma ni o ḍi yā nar byung ba'i nag po bi rū pa yin te/ de ni bram ze'i rigs btsas tsam na bram ze ltas mkhan rnams kyis sdig pa bzhi byed par lung bstan skad/ ming ni nag po zhes bya'o/ /der lo bdun tsam na sdig pa bzhi po mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir yul gzhan du 'khyams su btang ba las/ dus yun ring mo 'das te ma bram ze mo gazla zhes pa de yang khyim thab dang gyos sgyug rnams shi bas yul gzhan du 'khyams shing song ba rigs nyams te/ shar phyogs o ḍi bi sha'i yul du chang 'tshong zhing yod pa las/ phyi zhig bu yang o ḍi bi shar sleb/ ma'i khyim du phyin pa na phan tshun ma dang bu ngo ma shes pa'i skyon gyis ma dang 'dus/ rdzi'u nas chu 'dod pas skom 'thungs pa myos byed du 'dug /khros te rdzi'u shod du 'phangs pas ba zhig la phog ste shi /de gsang bar bsams te mtshan mo yang thog nas ce spyang gi bzar 'phangs pas srang ka na bram ze zhig rgyu ba'i mgo la phog bram ze shi /der the tshom zos nas gtam dris pas chang 'tshong ma de
48 bka' babs bdun ldan/rang gi ma yin par shes/ de yang sngon lung bstan pa'i sdig pa bzhi ni bram ze gsod pa/ ba glang gsod pa/ ma dang 'dus pa/ chang 'thung ba ste rig byed nas bshad pa'i bram ze nyams byed kyi sdig par grags pa bcu drug gi nang nas bzhi po de yin la/ de rnams dus gcig la byung bas sdig pa de sbyang ba'i don du phyi nang gi gnas thams cad du song (573)nas dris kyang gzhan yid ches pa ma byung //slob dpon dzā landha ra pa dang mjal/ rdo rje phag mo'i gdams ngag cig gnang ste/ des sdig pa 'byang gsung / de nas koṅku na'i yul du chu nang du mgrin pa man chad nub par byas nas zla ba drug tu bsgrubs pas rtags ci yang ma byung ste/ phreng ba bcad de chu la dor/ slob dpon la drir song bas/da dung sgrubs shig /dngos grub myur du 'ong gsung / der snga ma bzhin du bsgrubs pas zhag bdun song ba'i tho rangs rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mi'i bu mo'i rnam par byung ste/ aṣṭa se ka te/ na ba se dza la na/ ka mā yi pu tra/ ltu hi koṅku na ma ra na/ de yang rgya mtsho'i lag brgyad brgya dang / chu bo dgu brgya 'das te bu ga nas 'ongs/ koṅku'i yul du khyod 'chi bar byed dam zhes pa yin pa la / tshig dang po gnyis 'dra ba la/ a yi mā ta badzra yo gi nī/ te ri sa ra ṇa / yum rnal 'byor ma khyod la skyabs su mchir 'ongs zhes pa'o/ /de nyid du phyag spyi bor bzhag pas ting nge 'dzin mchog tu gyur pa thob cing / khyod kyi skye ba mang por las kyi 'brel ba yod pa ni bi rū pa yin pas/ de ma ha ra ta na yod kyi der song gsung //der yang bi rū pas rdo rje thod bcings phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob nas dur khrod rnams su brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas rgyu zhing
gtum mo'i bka' babs/49gshegs so/ /rdo rje thod byas kyang zhwa chung sngon po zhig yod do/ /da lta yang sku lus ma spangs par o rgyan gyi gnas na bzhugs par grags/ bi rū pa che chung 'di gnyis gshin rje'i gshed dang / phag mo'i lam la brten nas grub pa brnyes par byed gsung /sto bi rū pa chung ba la byā da li pas zhus te/ de ni sngon bya gsod pa'i rigs yin pa la/ gan cig ne tso zhig shing tog khar thogs nas nam mkha' la 'phur ba mthong ste/ der khyod ci zhig byed dris pa na/ phyogs 'di na grub thob bi rū pa bzhugs pas de la mchod pa byed du 'gro zhes zer bas/ des bsams pa/ dud 'gro 'di lta bu yang dge ba'i sems dang ldan na/ kho bo cag mir gyur pa dge ba byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos snyam ste shing tog 'ga' zung de la bskur te/ khyod kyis 'di yang grub thob de la phul zhig ces byas so//ne tsos kyang rngon pa'i shing tog phul ba na/ bi rū pas de ma blangs te/ka ye ne tso/ phyin chad kyang sdig pa can de lta bu'i yo byad khur ma 'ong zhes gsung ngo / /de nas ne tso des shing tog slar kho rang la gtad/ de la khyod kyis ci'i phyir ma phul zhes dris pas/ grub thob de 'di ltar gsung zhes snga ma ltar bsnyad do/ /de nas shin tu 'gyod par gyur nas sdig pa bshags/nags tshal de nyid du yang dang yang du 'khor zhing 'tshol du song ba na phyi zhig na mjal/ dbang bskur/ gdams pe yang gnang bas de nyid sgom bzhin du rtse gcig tu 'dug pa na/ bya rngon pa'i bya ba la sems yengs te/bla ma la zhus pas/ shin tu dgag dka' ba'i rnam rtog 'di bkag kyang ting nge 'dzin skye mi thub kyi/ de bas na 'jim pa dang zan dag la bya'i gzugs
50 bka' babs bdun ldan/chos la de dag gi ske gcod cing ting nge 'dzin sgoms shig ces gsungs/des kyang de bzhin du byed cing bsgoms pas mthar gyis lo bcu gnyis na phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyang thob cing grong khyer rnams su bya sna tshogs gsod pa'i sprul pa ston/ sha yang gsol/ der mi rnams kyi rnal (575)'byor pa'i gzugs bzung nas sems can la gnod pa 'di lta bu byas so zhes 'phya bar byas pa na/ sngar bsad pa thams cad slar gsos/ de ltar lo bcu gnyis su bya rngon pa'i bya ba byed par sprul nas rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad pa na/ mtshan yang grub thob byā da li pa zhes grags te/byā da li pa ni bya rngon pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /des ku sa li bha dra la bshad de gtum mo'i brgyud pa lugs gcig go/༈ yang bi ru pas ḍombi he ru ka la gdams te/ slob dpon de ni ko mkhan yin par bod na grags kyang shar phyogs ti pu ri'i yul gyi rgyal po zhig yin gsung / der slob dpon bi rū pa byon te/ rgyal po de yang lhag par dad nas rjes su 'dzin par zhus pas dbang bskur zhing gdams pa yang gnang ngo / /rgyal pos kyang de nyid sgom bzhin du 'dug pa na/ rim pa gnyis kyi rtogs pa yang rgya cher skyes pas spyod pa bya ba'i dus yin par mkhyen nas gsangs te spyod pa cung zad spyad pa na/ phyag rgya mo lung bstan pa byung ste g.yung mo'i rigs kyi bu mo padma can du gyur pa zhig 'jig rten pa'i mngon du bsten pas/ rgyal po'i rigs nyams zhes blon po la sogs pa'i 'bangs rnams kyis rgyal srid las bton te phyir bskrad do//de nas rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod cing yul dang nags tshal rnams su rgyu ba na/ rgyal po ḍombi pa zhes grags so/ /de yang khosba zhes pa
gtum mo'i bka' babs/ 51ni g.yung po ste grong khyer gyi phyi rol tu gnas pa/ nya dang bya dang ri dgas gsod cing za/ sha 'tshong du med/ glu gar byed/ rtsa ba 'bras bu 'tshong ba la sogs pa ngan pa'i las gcig tu ma nges pa spyod pa'i rigs ngan gyi khyad par zur pa zhig yin no/ /slob dpon rang ḍombi min yang / btsun mo ḍombi nī yin pas ḍombi par thogs/ ḍombi zhes pa ni g.yung mo can zhes pa yin no//slob dpon 'di ni shin tu dbang po rno bas/ sngon bi rū pas dbang bskur nas de bar du lo drug las ma lon skad//de nas yul sna tshogs su spyod cing ring zhig lon pa na sngar gyi yul der nad yams dang mu ge la sogs pa sna tshogs pas sdug bsngag bar gyur/ltas mkhan rnams kyis brtsis pas/ rgyal po bsod nams can yul gzhan du bskrad pas yin par shes nas slar yang spyan drangs pa na/ slob dpon rig ma dang bcas pa stag mo grus ma la chibs/ dug sprul phyag tu bsnams te byon pa na/ thams cad kyis rgyal po grub pa thob pa yin pa shes/ zhabs la phyag btsal/ yul gyi gnod pa thams cad kyang zhi/ yul mi skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyis rjes su bzung bar zhus te gdams pa mtha' dag gis nye bar gdams pas der yang dngos grub thob pa dang / sgrub pa po mchog tu gyur pa mang du byung //de nas yul ra dha zhes pa'am phal skad du ra ra zhes bya ba'i rgyal po de ni sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa la gnod pa byed pa zhig ste/ 'on kyang stag dang sprul la ni shin tu skrag pa zhig yod/ de 'dul ba'i don du slob dpon gyis de'i pho brang dang nye ba'i nags tshal zhig tu bzhugs pa na/ rgyal pos rnal 'byor pa ngan pa de ma 'dug zer/ de nas slob dpon gyis cho 'phrul gzhan
52 bka' babs bdun ldan/snga ma dang 'dra ba la/ sbrul reg dug can gyi rgyan mdzad/ mthong dug can ni lcag gi tshul du bsnams/ kha rlangs kyi dus can bdun gyis dbu la gdengs ka byas/ rgyal po'i mdun na (577)phar gshegs pa na/ rgyal po grong khyer gyi mi dang bcas pa 'jigs shing skrag nas/ gser dang dngul gyi me tog gtor te slob dpon gzhan du gshegs par zhu zhus pas/ slob dpon nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gyur/ stag mo yang mi gang tsam gyi sa la ma reg par nam mkha' la 'gro zhing / khyed rnams sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mi 'jug na sbrul gdug pa can 'di rnams gtong ngo zhes bsdigs pas thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs/ du ra ra'i yul du re zhig mu stegs rgyun chad skad//de nas lho phyogs kurṇa ṭa ku'i yul du byon nas nags tshal zhig tu 'khor mang po dang bcas ting nge 'dzin du bzhugs/ re zhig na asnyo hā sa zhes bya ba'i dur khrod cig tu rgyal po sa mu cha ya zhes bya bas sbyin bdag byas te/ rnal 'byor pho mo lnga brgya'i 'khor gyis bskor nas zla ba drug tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ bram ze'i dge slong su siddhā ka ra zhes bya ba tshogs kyi spyod pa la ma dad nas slob dpon la gnang ba ma zhus par phyir song ngo / /de nyid ni bka'i chad pas shi /gzhan lnga brgya po thams cad kyis dngos grub sna re ma thob pa ma byung skad//de dang nye ba na mu stegs kyi rgyal po zhig gis mu stegs pa'i lugs kyi mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ ral pa can khri tsam 'tshogs nas rab gnas byed pa na/ srog chags sna tshogs bsad pa'i snying gi phung po 'ba' zhig rang la yang mi 'greng gsum tsam gyi dpangs yod pa'i gtor ma byas
gtum mo'i bka' babs/ 53so / / der slob dpon gyi g.yog mo zhig song ba de rnams kyis brdungs pas/slob dpon gyis dgongs pa gtad pas nub mo mchod rten thams cad mgo mjug log /gtor ma sogs mchod pa thams cad phyogs bcur 'thor/ nang par mu stegs rgyal po dang bcas pa 'jigs shing skrag nas slob dpon gyi drung du byung ste bzod par rigasol/ mchod rten rnams rnal du gnas par zhus/der slob dpon gyis khyed rnams phyin chad lha mchod pa'i don du srog chags gcig kyang ma gsod cig /gal te gsod na mchod rten thams cad 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas pa'i nus pa bstan pa'i phyir/ mchod rten gcig min pa thams cad rnal du gnas par 'gro gsung /de rnams kyis slar ldog ste bltas pa na de bzhin du song / dus phyis yul de'i rgyal po zhig gis srog gi mchod pa byas pas mchod rten brgya dang bdun po thams cad nyis tshal gsum tshal du gas/ da lta lcags kyis bsdams nas 'dug /mu stegs kyi mchod rten zer yang ling ga'i rigs can zhig yin gsung / der yun ring du 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas sku lus de nyid kyis mkha' spyod du gshegs so//de'i slob ma grub pa brnyes pa'i gtso bo ni/ ḍombi rigs kyi rnal 'byor ma / slob dpon a la la badzra/ he ma la badzra ste gser 'chang rdo rje/ yul dbus kyi ra ta badzra ste bzhi'o/ /gzhan yang nags khrod pa dang / slob dpon garba ri pa dang / dza ya shrī dang / mi thub zla ba dang / sgra gcan 'dzin rdo rje la sogs pa yang slob dpon 'di'i zhabs la reg pas dngos grub phra mo thob pa yin no/ /de la grub thob chen po ḍombi pas g.yung mo rnal 'byor ma la gdams/ des ra ta badzra la/ des nag po spyod pa la gdams te brgyud pa'i lugs gcig go/
54 bka' babs bdun ldan/yang g.yung mo rnal 'byor mas spyod pa pa la gdams (579)pa'ang lugs gcig yin mod kyi/ gtum mo'i bka' babs ni bar pa gtso che ba yin no/ /de'i g.yung mo rnal 'byor ma ni lta stangs bzhis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ las bzhi'i sngags dang sbyor ba mang po khong nyid kyis mdzad pa shin tu nus pa che ba mang po da lta'ang yod gsung / des rdo rje'i glu mang du blangs shing sems can gyi don byas te mkha' spyod du bzhud de/ ḍombi pa nyid la he ru gas lung bstan pa'i phyag rgya de yin no/ /༈ de la mi thub zla bas zhal gzigs kyi sgo nas zhus so/ /de ni paṇḍi ta shin tu mkhas pa yin/ ḍombi'i slob brgyud mang po la thos pa mdzad/ phyis ḍombi rnal 'byor ma'i slob brgyud gcig la gdams ngag zhus/ o rgyan du rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas ḍombi pa yum dang bcas pa mjal/ gdams pa stsal/der dur khrod du thod skam gyi spyil bu chung ngu brtsigs/ rnal 'byor ma gcig gis sgrub g.yog byas/ slob ma gcig gis 'tsho ba bskyal gyin bsgrubs pas mthar rtogs pa khyad par can skyes/ he ru ku'i zhal mthong / thun mong gi dngos grub thob/ de nas lan cig tshogs 'khor chen po byas/ mkha' 'gro ma dang phra men ma kun tshogs la bkug/la hor gyi yul na gzugs can ma gcig khyim gyi shing 'bras bu can thams cad rtsa ba bton nas khyer/ tshogs 'khor la yang phyin pa na/ de'i khyos nub mo mi sdod par shes/ skyed tshal gyi a mra'i yal ga'i phag tu gab bsdad pas/ shing de rang yang rtsa ba nas bton nas khyer/ de ltar tshogs gral du sha chen sogs bza' ba dang / rnal 'byor can rnams dang lhan cig spyod par
gtum mo'i bka' babs/ 55shes nas/ tshogs pa la ma mgu/ slob dpon na re/ rang re'i tshogs 'di na gsang ba la 'khu ba yod pas sgrol dgos gsung / tho rangs mos shing khyer nas rang gnas su btsugs/ nang par bdag po la khyod la slob dpon du rdza ya tsand+ra'i bka' gcig yod de khyod bsgral zin byas pas der shi /de sogs nus pa dpag tu med/ de la de'i rig ma su bho gas zhus/ de la dā na shrīs zhus/ de la rdo rje gdan pa bar pas zhus/ de la ku sa lis zhus pa'ang yod mod/ tshig brgyud gtso che/ yang spyod pa pas sing ga ga'i rnal 'byor ma la bshad/ de la mi thub zla bas zhus/ de la rā hul wadzdza gyis zhus pa'ang yin/lha rā hul wa4 de ni chung ngu nas yi dam zhal gzigs/ rigs rgyal rigs/ bi kra ma'i dge slong paṇḍi ta yin/ der gsang sngags sgom zhing bla mas kun spangs gyis shig gsung / 'on kyang nga rgyal gyi dbang las bka' bcag ste re zhig kun spangs ma mdzad/phyis de'i sdig pa sbyong ba la rtse gcig tu bsgrubs kyang cang ma 'grub/bla ma gu no ka ra na re/ lce dang yan lag chod gsung / ljags dang yan lag bzhi bcad pas spyan ras gzigs dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ nag po chen po/sgrol ma ste bzhis dngos su zhal bstan/ byin gyis brlabs/ de nas bla ma dzñā na sā ga ra na re/ khyod chu 'dir zhag bdun lus spyings la sdod gsung / de ltar byas pas/ lus kyi khrag srin bu pad pa mang pos 'jib nas 'chi la khad par song / de gnyis kyis bla ma'i bka' bcag pa'i sgrib pa dag skad/de nas lho phyogs su bsgoms pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob/ shing gi ri zer ba ri nag po'i khong seng na bzhugs skad/ shing gi ri (581)zhes pa mon mtshams kyi 'di min lho phyogs na yod do/ /de la dā na shrīs zhus
56 bka' babs bdun ldan/pa yan gong bzhin yin mod/ 'di dgyes rdor gyi gtum mo kho na yin yang gsung / ra ta badzra ni nā gzhwa'i paṇḍi ta zhig yin snang yang / rnam thar rgyas par mi gsung / yang tsarya pa kha cig /birū pa chung ba/ nag po spyod pa/ ḍombi he ru ka /mi thub zla ba/ ku sa li bha dra zhes brgyud pa 'ded pa'ang yod mod kyi/de ni ma dag gsung / rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ gtum mo brgyud pa'i gtam gyi skabs te gnyis pa'o// //
bka' babs gsum pa/las kyi phyag rgya'i bka' babs/༄༅/ /gsum pa ni gas kyi phyag rgya'i bka' babs yin no/ /de yang sangs rgyas dngos kyi zhal mthong ba'i rgyal po ind+ra bhū ti chen po de ni ngo bo gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje yin/ gsar brnyes dang gdod ma gang yin bsam par mi nus/ bstan pa 'di la gsang sngags pa thams cad kyi gtso bo yin/ de yang o rgyan gyi rgyal po ste rgyal srid 'byor zhing bde bar yod pa'i skabs/ston pa'i 'khor dgra bcom pa rnams gling gzhan la 'phur te 'gro 'ong byed pa rgyal po ind+ra bhū tis gzigs pa na thag ring bas cha ma phyed de/ blon po rnams la bya dmar po'i khyu 'di rnams ci yin dris pas/ blon po rnams na re / lha cig /'di ni bya ma lags/ drang srong chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos lags so byas pas/ rgyal po sangs rgyas lta 'dod pa la blon po rnams kyis thag ring bas mi 'byon zer ba na/ rgyal pos gsog ba btab pas nang par gdugs tshod la sangs rgyas 'khor dgra bcom pa lnga brgya dang bcas pa byon pa la rgya cher mchod nas sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs zhus pas/ rgyal po 'dod yon spongs la bslab pa gsum dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sten cig gsungs pas/ rgyal pos bdag bud med kyi tshogs dang lhan cig 'dod pa lnga la longs spyod pas sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs cig 'tshal lo/ /
58 bka' babs bdun ldan/dzambu'i tshal ni nyams dga' bar//wa skyes nyid du gyur kyang bla'i//'dod yon spangs pa'i thar pa ni//nam yang mi 'dod go ta ma// zhes zhus pas/der nyan thos kyi tshogs rnams mi snang bar thal te/'di na gang zag brgyad med cing //nyan thos rang rgyal 'ga' yang med//byang chub sems dpa' rtsa'aphrul che//de dag de yi gzugs su sprul//zhes nam mkha' nas sgra yang byung / der dkyil 'khor chen po mtha' yas par gyur/ rgyal po la dbang bskur bas de nyid du zung 'jug gi sku grub ste/de la bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang rgyud thams cad gtad do/ /des kyang o rgyan gyi skye bo thams cad la rgya cher bstan/ rgyud rnams glegs bam du byas/mthar btsun mo'i tshogs dang lhan cig mi snang bar gyur te/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur gyur mod/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas zhing du spyod cing gsang sngags thams cad kyi sdud pa po'i tshul mdzad do/ /de'i dus rgyal po 'khor bcas su ma zad o rgyan gyi yul mi dang / 'byung po dang / srog chags dud 'gror gyur pa 'bu srin yan chod thams cad bde ba chen po'i lam gyis dngos grub thob cing 'ja' lus su song ngo / /de dngos kyi zhal mthong ba'i mkha' 'gro ma phyis bzhugs pa ni dpal ldan bde ba'i rol pa mo yin/
las kyi phyag rgya'i bka' babs/ 59༈de yang sa hwa dza sirnyi ste lhan cig skyes grub kyi rol pa mo dang gcig gsung / 'on kyang brgyud pa'i khyad par mi 'dra ba ni byin (583)rlabs kyi brgyud pa tha dad pa dang gdams ngag mi gcig pas yin gsung / de la rnal 'byor ma de'i lo rgyus ni/ lhan cig skyes grub kyi 'grel pa ltar na/ de ni o rgyan gyi yul phyogs zhig gi rgyal po'i bu mo ste/ de yang cher skyes pa na 'khor bu mo lnga brgya dang lhan cig nags tshal rnams su rgyu ba na/ o rgyan gyi phyogs zhig na byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje de drang srong 'gro ba dbugs 'byin pa zhes bya bar sprul te bzhugs pa las/ bu mo rnams kyis de mthong ba na/ drang srong skra 'dzings pa 'jigs 'jigs ltar 'dug nas 'dre yin no snyam phyir bros pa na/ rol pa mos khyed rnams ma 'jigs shig 'di ni mthong ba tsam gyis nga'i yid la dga' bde'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skyes pas na 'di ni bdag nyid chen po zhig go/de nas 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas te de'i zhabs la phyag byas te/ drang srong des kyang bu mo bde ba'i rol pa mo'i mgo bor phyag bzhag pas sngon skye ba gzhan du dbang bskur ba'i ye shes kyang dran/ rang gis sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa mngon sum du rtoṭa te rang gi 'khor rnams la yang bstan pas/de thams cad kyang rnal 'byor ma chen mor gyur ces 'byung ste/ de thams cad mthong ba'i chos de nyid la sa bcu gang rung re thob pa yin te des padma badzra chen po la bshad/ des dpag med rdo rje la bshad/ des yan lag med pa'i rdo rje phag tshang pa la bshad do/ /des padma badzra bar pa mtsho skyes la bshad/ des ind+ra bhu ti 'bring po la bshad/ des dzā landha ri pa la bshad/ des nag po spyod pa pa la bshad/ des dge ba'i mgon po la bshad/des ku sa la bha dra la bshad do//
60 bka' babs bdun ldan/༈ de la padma badzra chen po ni/ nub phyogs ma ru'i yul du rigs bram zer 'khrungs/ sde snod gsum dang bstan bcos thams cad la shin tu mkhas par sbyangs pa zhig yin la/ o rgyan gyi yul du song nas gsang sngags phyi'i rgyud mang du bslabs shing mkhas par mkhyen pa la/ de rnams bsgoms pas gnod sbyin mo dang bcud len la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub thob kyang / de kho na nyid ma shes par o rgyan gyi phyogs shig tu song nas de 'ba' zhig sems par byed pa la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mngon sum du mthong ba'i slob dpon zhig gis dbang bskur bas rang bzhin gyi gnas tshul mthong nas/ phyag rgya'i dbang gi ye shes ni de kho na nyid mtshon par byed par mkhyen mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'di nyid gtso bor ston par byed pa'i sde snod cig mthong na ci ma rung snyam du de nyid sems par byed pa na/ bu mo bde ba'i rol pa mo 'khor rnal 'byor ma brgya stong du ma dang lhan cig tu slob dpon gyi drung du byon te/ phyag rgya bzhi'i man ngag dang / gsang ba 'dus pa gtso bor gyur pa'i bla med kyi rgyud sde du ma bshad pas/ de rnams kyi don mngon sum du rtogs te de nyid du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par gyur cing / mthar gyis zla ba bcu gnyis na rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang brnyes pa yin gsung / des kyang gdams ngag bstan pas o rgyan gyi yul du skye bo dpag tu med pa mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub la bkod/gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad do//༈ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje ni/ rigs ngan skal ba dang ldan pa zhig yin pa la/ slob dpon padma badzra gyis legs par gdams pa bzhin lo
las kyi phyag rgya'i bka' babs/ 61bcu gnyis su ko taṃ pa'i ri la (585)bsgoms pas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub nyams su chud kyang / bdag nyid kyi bya ba slob dpon la zhu dgos par shes te zhus pas/ khyod phag rdzi mo bsten cing / phag rdzi'i spyod pas rim gyis rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur gsung / de nas o rgyan gyi byang phyogs grong khyer zhig tu phag rdzi'i spyod pas sems can gyi don mdzad cing / skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la dbang bskur nas phyag rgya bzhi'i gdams ngag bstan pas smin cing grol bar mdzad pa yin no/ /dpal phag tshang pa zhes grags so//༈ de'i slob ma ni slob dpon sa ro ru ha zhes pa bod skad mtsho skyes zhes pa yin te/ de yang rigs rgyal rigs/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la mkhas pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po gsang sngags kyi rgyud mang po mkhyen pa zhig yin/de rgyal po'i mchod gnas mdzad/ 'khor mtha' yas pa la chos ston cing yod pa la/ shing thun rgan mo zhig phyogs der shing 'thu ba'i zhar la 'ong bas res dgod/ ris ngu ba zhig mthong / phyi zhig na slob dpon gyis de'i khyim du song ste dris pas/ dgod pa ni khyod chos ston pa rdo rje 'chang chos gsung ba 'dra bas dgod pa yin/ ngu ba ni rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa ltar mi 'chad pas ngu ba yin zhes zer ba la/ 'o na bdag gi the tshom gcod par zhu zhus pas/ ngas gcod par mi nus kyi dpal phag tshang pa la zhus gsung / de ga na bzhugs dris pas byang phyogs kyi grong khyer ngan pa zhig na yod gsung /der slob dpon gyis 'tshog du bzhud pas byang phyogs kyi grong khyer re rul zhig nas/ dpal phag tshang pa de phag gi khyu chen po gcig gdong
62 bka' babs bdun ldan/du ded/ rigs ngan mo dang lhan cig tu shing khur chen po gcig khur nas byung ba dang mjal nas/ de dag kyang brda ru shes te shing khur thogs pa ni zhe sdang ma spangs rang gnas su dag pa'i brda/ rigs ngan mo dang bcas pa ni 'dod chags dag pa dang / phag khyu bdas pa ni gti mug dag pa'i brdar go ste rjes su gzung bar zhu zhus pas/ nga rigs ngan klog kyang mi shes pa la gdams ngag dgos zhes smra ba nyid 'tshol ba yin zhes gsung khro zhing brdeg go /grong khyer ba'i phag kun 'jug pa'i ra ba'i phug btsog btsog ltar snang ba zhig tu bzhud do//der mtshan mo them pa la mgo gtad nas sgo drung du sa the btsugs te 'dug pa na/ nub kyi ring la phag rnams 'thab pa dang / slob dpon gyi chas la gnod pa bskyal bas phag rnams brdungs/ dzo mo rigs ngan rgan mos zlog par byed cing / shin tu dman pa'i spyod pa ltar bcos pas so ma bsod do / / der nyin zhag mang po'i bar du 'dug pa na/ gan cig tho rangs kyi tshe slob dpon na re/ sgo drung na yod pa'i mi 'di ci zhig don du gnyer/ jo mo na re/ de kho na nyid kyis rjes su gzung bar zhu zer gyin 'dug zer ba na/slob dpon gyis/ 'di kun paṇḍi ta bya ba nga rgyal che bas de kho na nyid kyi snod du mi rung gsung / der bdag gi don rnams nges par grub bo snyam ste/ yang dang yang du gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur zhing gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa mtha' dag stsal/ slob dpon nyid kyi sras mo ngan ngon ltar snang ba zhig stsal nas 'di rig mar gyis la sgoms shig gsung //de nas slob dpon yang sngar gyi rgyal po'i mchod gnas kyi bya ba yang mdzad cing / yid gzhan du ma gyur par rtse gcig tu (587)bsgoms pas
las kyi phyag rgya'i bka' babs/ 63lo bcu gnyis na phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud do//de yan chad du gsang ste spyod pas gnas pa la/ de phyin chad 'jig rten pa'i mngon du yang spyod pas skye bo kun gyis rigs ngan mo bsten pas slob dpon ma dag /slob dpon ma dag na rgyal po ma dag par 'gyur/ des yul phyogs thams cad ma dag cing nyams par 'gyur bas/ gang ma dag pa 'byung ba'i gzhi slob dpon rang dang rigs ngan mo me la bsregs na dag par 'gyur zhes rgyal po la yang dang yang du zhus/dus lan cig khang bzang gi rtse mo nas bltas pas slob dpon khang pa nas rigs ngan gyi bu mo dang bcas pa phyir byung ba mthong / der rgyal pos chad pa byed par brtsams te shing gi phung po chen po yang byas/ de la slob dpon yab yum bzhag /slar yang shing sprungs te me bus pas zhag bdun du me lce 'bar ba rgyun ma chad cing / brgyad pa'i nyin par thal ba'i phung por gyur pa mi rnams kyis thal ba bsal bas dbus na mtsho chung ngu zhig gi gung du padma shin tu rgyas pa la/ slob dpon yab yum he ru ka yab yum gyi sku gzi brjid dang ldan par mthong / der thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur cing /o ḍi yā na'i yul gyi mi de dag thams cad kyang rdo rje theg pa la bkod de rgyal po 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pas kyang dngos grub thob ces grags so//dus gzhan zhig na ma ru'i yul gyi phyogs shig tu byon te/ der mi zhig gis nyin gung bye tshan gyi thang la ri dwags shin tu grang bas nyen pa mthong bas/ der tsandan sa mchog yod par shes nas brus pas tsandan gyi sdong dum chen po byung ba slob dpon la phul bas/ de la he ru ku'i sku zhig byas na legs par mkhyen nas de brdar ba dang / brdung ba'i las byed pa yang bud
64 bka' babs bdun ldan/med padma can gyi rigs yon tan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa zhig dgos pa las/ de yang gzhan na med de yul de'i rgyal po mu stegs kyi lugs 'dzin pa zhig gi slas kyi btsun mo zhig kho na la yod par mkhyen nas/ de mtshan re bzhin ting nge 'dzin gyis bkug nas tsandan brdar du bcug pa na / gan cig rgyal pos de'i lag pa gas par mthong nas/ khyod skyid de bar 'dug pa la lus kyang rid/ lag pa ser kur song ba ci yin dris pas rgyal pos mi shes sam/ nub re bzhin ri'i phug cig tu btsun pa zhig gis tsandan gyi lde gu'i las kho na la bkol/nam langs su nye ba na slar 'di nyid du skyel zer/ de phyogs gang na yod dris pas mgo 'khor te phyogs ni mi shes zer/der rgyal pos kyang brtags pas mun sros tsam na rgyal po nyid kyang sems myos shing mgo 'khor ba ltar 'dug pa la/ btsun mo de ni mkha' la yer gyis song nas nang par gang nas byung med par khyim du sleb bo//phyi nub sindhu ra'i rkyal pa zhig lag tu gtad nas ci lcogs lcogs lam du gtor cig byas gtor bas/nang par rgyal pos sindhu ra'i rjes bcad pas slob dpon gyi drung du sleb/ rgyal po khros te 'khor dang bcas pa chad pa gcod du 'ongs/ der slob dpon gyis rdo rje gri gug gi sbyor ba byas te rje'i spyi blugs kyi mgrin pa bskor ba na rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi gdong ltag par blta bar song / der 'jigs nas zhabs la phyag btsal bas slob dpon gyis khyod sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs shig /ci ste mi 'jug na khyedrnams kyi mgo bo gcad par bya'o zhes gsungs pas (589)rgyal po yangsangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs/ he ru ku'i lha khang bzhengs pa gnyan cingbyin rlabs che bar grags pa/ dam tshig nyams pas sku de'i zhal ras mthong
las kyi phyag rgya'i bka' babs/ 65na khrag skyugs te 'chi ba dang / dus phyis rang stag gzig gi dmag gis bshig par brtsams pas/ stag gzig gi rta pa bcu gnyis dus gcig tu shi bas da lta yang shin tu gnyan gsung / slob dpon des sems can dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad de/ he badzra dngos kyi go 'phang thob pa yin gsung //de'i slob ma rgyal po ind+ra bhū ti bar pa ni/ gong du bshad ma thag pa'i slob dpon nyid me la sreg mkhan de yin te/ 'on kyang 'di'i lo rgyus rgyas par mi gsung / zur tsam zhig gsung ba lwa ba pa'i skabs su 'chad/ yang brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ ind+ra bhū ti des zhal bstan te padmā ka ra la gdams/ de la slob dpon ku sa las zhus/ 'di la ni ku sa la bha dra chung bas zhus pa yin no/ /'on kyang brgyud pa de'i lo rgyus ni 'og tu shes par bya'o/ /rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las gas rgya brgyud pa'i gtam gyi skabs te gsum pa'o// //
bka' babs bzhi pa/'od gsal gyi bka' babs/༄༅/ / bka' babs bzhi pa ni/ 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag yin te/ de yang slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas o rgyan du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams la dngos su zhus pa dang / yang ring brgyud kyi dbang du byas na slob dpon chen po rta mchog ces bya ba phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa/ 'od gsal bsam mi khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom zhing o rgyan gyi grong khyer zhig gi sgo drung dang nye bar spyil po byas nas bzhugs pa la/ rgyal po'i mi rnams kyis tho co'i spyod pas yang yang brnyas pas/ dus lan cig o rgyan gyi yul de tsam du che ba yang ri klung med pa rtas khyab nas zhing dang skyed mos tshal thams cad zos pas/ rgyal po'i mi rnams kyis rta rnams ded pas zin du nye ba nye ba la mi zin pa 'ba' zhig byung / mthar rta 'ga' zhig yod pa yang slob dpon gyi spyil por zhugs pa mthong nas spyil po la bltar song ba na rta gcig kyang med de/ der sprul pa yin par shes/ slob dpon grub pa thob par yang shes mod kyi/ 'on kyang slob dpon de rdzu 'phrul gyis mi ma yin gyi gnas su 'phur nas bzhud do/ /'on kyang rgyal po la sogs pas de'i slob ma bi nā pa ste pi waṃ zhabs la gdams ngag zhus//9 slob dpon bi nā pa de ni dang po rgyal rigs yin pa/ slob dpon rta mchog gis dbang bskur zhing gdams pa gnang ba na/ bdag gis rgyal
'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ 67rigs kyi bya ba ni spang bar nus na/ 'on kyang pi waṃ gi sgra spang bar mi nus pas ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ pi waṃ gi sgra nyid la sems 'dzin pa'i gdams ngag gnang ste/ des kyang bsam mi khyab kyi dngos grub thob pa yin skad/de'i slob ma ni chang 'tshong ma wi lā su badzra yin te/ bod skad du sgeg mo rdo rje zhes bya'o//9 smra lā su badzra de ni o rgyan yul gyi rgyal po zhig gi chang sbyor mkhan yin pas/ des lo bcu drug lon pa'i tshe slob dpon ḍombi he ru ka phyogs der byon nas chos gsung ba na/ rgyal po de mu stegs la dga' bas thul bar ma gyur pa la/ slob dpon gyis chang 'tshong ma de'i sar byon de la dris pas sprul gyis bsdigs na thul zer/ der slob dpon gyis dgongs pa btang bas sbrul gdug reg pa dug can gyis rgyal po'i khyim bskor ba na rgyal po 'jigs te skyabs gzhan med pa la/ chang 'tshong (591)ma na re/ mu stegs kyi slob dpon 'di rnams kyis skyob par mi nus kyi ḍombi pa la gsol ba thob ces smras/ rgyal pos kyang snying nas gsol ba btab pas slob dpon der byon pa na/ sbrul gdug pa can 'og tu song / rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa yang sangs rgyas pa la dad par gyur/ slob dpon la yang yun ring du mchod pa byas skad//der chang 'tshong ma de snod dang ldan par gzigs nas ḍombi pa dang /bī na pa gnyis kyis dbang bskur zhing gdams pa yang gnang / nus pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor mar gyur pa na lcam larmi ka ras bde ba chen po'i gdams ngag bstan/ slob dpon bī na pas bsam mi khyab kyi gdams ngag bstan pas 'od gsal rdo rje'i sems dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi gtso
68 bka' babs bdun ldan/mor gyur/ 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad de rnal 'byor ma tsisto zhes kyang grags so//༈ des ni rdo rje dril bu pa la gdams pa yin te/ slob dpon (rdo rje dril bu ba ste badzraktakaka )de ni o ḍi sha dang nye ba'i rgyal rigs shig /nā land+rar rab tu byung / blo gros snying po'i dpal zhes mtshan btags/ phyis mkhas pa chen por gyur nas mu stegs kyi rgol ba tshar bcad pas dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha zhes grags/ nā land+ra'i mkhan por yang lan cig mnga' gsol skad/ de nas grub thob dā ri ka pa dang mjal/ dbang bskur dang de kho na nyid zhus nas sgom zhing yod pa la/ o rgyan du song dang dngos grub 'byung zhes lung bstan pa byung nas o rgyan du song bas/ der rnal 'byor ma bi la su badzra phag rdzi ma'i tshul bzung ba dang mjal nas/ des kyang phyag rgya chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dod chags chen po'i tshul bstan pas de kho na nyid thams cad khong du chud nas/ shar phyogs o ḍi sha'i nags khrod du bsgoms pas rim pa gnyis kyi rtogs pa khyad par can skyes pa na/ yul gyi rgyal po de nags la ri dwags bshor du 'ongs pas mthong ste/ dge slong 'tsho ba med pa snying re rje snyam nas grong khyer du 'byon par zhus pas/dngos rnams rab tu shes pa'i mkhas pa dag la brnyas par mi bya ste//de ni tswartse chung ngu bas kyang chung ba'i 'byor pas 'ching bar nus ma yin//rgyun mi 'chad par chang 'dzag pa yi 'gram lang nag por gyur pa yi//glang chen rnams ni padma'i skud pa phra mos 'khyig par mi nus bzhin//
'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ 69zhes slob dpon gyis brjod pa las/ der rgyal pos dge slong 'dis nga la brnyas so/ /'di la lan dma' dbab bo snyam nas grong khyer du dril bsgrags te / nags gseb kyi dge slong 'di lta bu su zhig gis 'bebs par nus pa de la bya dga' chen po ster byas pas/ der chang 'tshong ma zhig gis khas blangs so//de nas des slob dpon la rtag tu 'tsho ba skyel bar byed/ dus gzhan zhig na chang 'tshong ma'i bu mo padma can zhing skyes kyi mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba zhig yod pa phyag rgya mor bzung ste bsgoms pas/ lo bcu gnyis na slob dpon de ni phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang thob bo / / der grong khyer ba rnams ma mos pa bzlog pa'i phyir dang / ma 'ongs pa'i sems can gyi bsod nams kyi zhing du spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo sku rang byung bzhag pa dang / gsang sngags kyi bstan pa rgya cher spel ba'i phyir lan cig khye'u gcig dang bu mo zhig kyang sprul lo/ /rgyal pos gtam de thos nas chang 'tshong ma (593)la slob dpon grong khyer du bos shig ces bsgos/grong khyer gyi shar sgor skye bo mang po bsags/ slob dpon nags tshal nas grong khyer du byon pa na lam du chang bum mang po bltar du bcug /yum gyis de nas rwa bshor du 'dren gyin sprul pa'i khye'u ni g.yas nas rgyug /bu mo ni g.yon nas rgyug go/de nas grong khyer gyi shar sgor sleb pa na/ yul mi rnams kyis sngon rgyal po la brnyas pa'i tshig de glur blangs shing / rgyal pos spyan drangs na mi 'ong / chang 'tshong mas bos na 'ong ba 'di ci zer gyin thal mo brdabs pas/ der slob dpon gyis rwa'i bshor zhag sa la 'phangs pas sa 'og bdun phug ste chu chen po phyung ngo //
70 bka' babs bdun ldan/slob dpon yab yum ni he ru ka yab yum du gyur/ khye'u dang bu mo ni rdo rje dang dril bur gyur pa phyag tu bsnams te nam mkha' la bzhud/ skye bo rnams kyang chus nub pa tsam du song ba na slob dpon la gsol ba btab pas/ spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba thob gsung / skye bo thams cad kyis na mo lo ke shwa rā ya/ zhes brjod pa na/ chu'i dbus su spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo sku rang byung du byung / chu yang de la lan bdun du bskor ba byas nas sa 'og tu song ngo / /der slob dpon gyis yul de na gnas pa rnams la rdo rje theg pa rgya cher bshad de dngos grub thob pa'i slob ma yang dpag tu med pa byung ngo //sto des ni lwa ba pa la gdams pa yin te/ slob dpon lwa ba pa de ni rgyal po'i sras shig yin pa/ 'di'i yul yang o rgyan gyi nang tshan zhig yin gsung / 'ga' zhig o ḍi bi sha yin yang zer/ cher skyes pa na/ gtsug lag khang zhig tu rab tu byung zhing / sde snod gsum la yang mkhas par gyur/ phyi zhig na shar phyogs su 'ongs pas slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa dang mjal te 'khor lo sdom pa la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ ji ltar gdams pa bzhin du bsgoms pas ye shes mchog thob par gyur nas nub phyogs o rgyan gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas su song ba na/ mu stegs kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis me tog gi phreng ba zhig lag tu gtad de de blangs pa na/sangs rgyas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams byung ste/ bu me tog blangs pa ma legs/de mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor ma yin/gang me tog blangs pa de'i rjes su 'jug dgos zer/ 'o na khyed rnams kyis srung ba byed dgos byas pas/ gnas 'di
'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ 71na phyi rol pa dang / nang pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams me tog phog pa su snga ba de'i rjes su 'jug dgos pa'i chad mdo byas pa yin zer//der slob dpon gyis ting nge 'dzin sgom zhing bzhugs pas nam phyed kyi dus na/ thug chom gyi sgra chen po byung nas bltas pa na/ mu stegs kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis pha bong gi char chen po phab/ bskyed rim bsgoms pas srung 'khor ji tsam bsgoms pa'i bar gnod pa ma byung bas/ bskyed rim gyi mthu yang 'di 'dra na/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i mthu bstan par bya'o snyam ste mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas rdo thams cad nam mkha' la chags so/ /nam mkha' la rten med pa pha bong zhig dang / brag me long ltar 'jam pa'i ngos la rdo dam dum mang po rten med par chags pa da lta'ang yod/ der mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi bar chad kyis ma tshugs so/ /de nas bsod snyoms spyod cing bzhugs pa na grong khyer gyi sgo drung du yang yang rgyal po dang 'phrad pa na/ 'phrad res bzhin rgyal pos dri ba re byas pa la/slob dpon gyis (595)lan ci yang ma btab bo//gan cig rgyal pos dge slong blun po mi shes pa khyod/ yang yang 'gro zhing 'dug pas ci byed/ de bas ring du gnyid log na rung byas pa na/slob dpon gyis rgyal po'i sgo drung du lo bcu gnyis su gnyid thun gcig gis 'khyongs pa log bzhin 'dug pa na/ der 'gro ba'i mi kun yang slob dpon la phyag ma byas na byin pa rangs 'gro bas rgyal po la sogs pa thams cad phyag 'tshal zhing 'gro 'ong byed do/ /lo bcu gnyis na sad de / rgyal pos slob dpon de tsam ci'i phyir gnyid log /slob dpon na re/lha nyid gsung ngo zhes gsung / de nas rgyal po yang shin tu dad par gyur
