72 bka' babs bdun ldan/cing / yul gyi skye bo mang po rdo rje theg pa la bkod/ rgyal po de ni ind+ra bhū ti bar pa yin gsung //de nas slob dpon dur khrod na kun tu spyod pa'i tshe/ o rgyan gyi yul gyi sngags 'chang ma'i gtso mo lnga brgya dur khrod nyul du song / de la sngags 'chang ma zhes pa ni mant+ra bā di ste lhan cig skyes pa dang / byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags kyi mthu can dmod pa grub pa'i phra men ma yin no/ /des na de rnams kyis slob dpon la bar chad byed par 'dod nas slob dpon btsal ba na/ slob dpon gyi shul na na bza' lwa ba gcig ma gtogs gzhan ma mthong nas/ kye ma dge slong 'di'i sgyu ma la ltos/ rang gi lus lwa bar bsgyur ro / / de bas na 'di gtubs nas so sor bza' bar bya'o zhes zer te/ lwa ba dum bu lnga brgyar bgos nas so sor med do/ /der slob dpon gyis lus snang bar byas te de rnams la dmod pa bor bas sngags 'chang mo lnga brgya po lug ma mo lnga brgyar song ngo / /der lug ma mo rnams rgyal po'i drung du song ste/ dge slong dur khrod pas bdag cag 'di ltar du byas pas rgyal pos sgrol ba'i thabs mdzod ces zer ro/der rgyal pos slob dpon la zhus pas slob dpon gcer bur byung zhing / rgyal po khyod kyi yul gyi sngags 'chang ma rnams kyis dge slong gi nor lwa ba zhig yod pa'ang zos so/ /de bas na sngags 'chang ma rnams khug cig gsung / der gsum ma gtogs thams cad bkug nas re re bzhin thams cad la sdigs mdzub re byas pas/ mgo brnyan sna tshogs su song nas lwa ba'i dum bu so sor skyugs/ de dag tshem bu byas pas cung zad ma 'grig ste/ da dung gsum yod pas khug cig gsung / der btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang na
'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ 73gsum yod pa yang der 'ongs pa la/ snga ma ltar lwa ba skyug tu bcug /de nyid sku la gsol bas rje btsun lwa ba pa zhes yongs su grags so//der rgyal po ind+ra bhū ti la dbang bskur te/ de'i gdams pa bsgoms pas rgyal po'ang dngos grub thob/ de nas slob dpon brag phug cig tu lo bcu gnyis su mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgom bzhin du 'od gsal gyi lam gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa na skye po rnams smod par byed de/ gti mug chos su smra ba zhes zer/ rgyal po ind+ra bhū ti de zhag re bzhin bud med lnga brgya dang lhan cig spyod pas mi rnams smod par byed pa la/ dus gzhan zhig gi tshe rgyal pos btsun mo zhig gi lag tu tshod ma ku ba gang gtad/ 'di ma grang ba la slob dpon lwa ba pa la phul zhig byas pa na/ des nyi ma mang po chod pa'i lam du tshod ma ma grang ba ga la 'ong byas pas/ rgyal po na re de la ni sngags yod de/ khyod mig tshums la 'di skad spros shig /slob dpon lwa ba (597)pa gnyid spangs pa'i dka' thub la gnas pa 'di bden na/ da lta nyid du ko taṃ bhi ri'i brag phug tu phyin par gyur cig /ces brjod cig gsung / des kyang de bzhin byas pas mig gdangs tsam na slob dpon gyi mdun du sleb 'dug skad//der slob dpon ni slob ma 'ga' la lung 'bogs pa'i bya bas g.yengs nas yun ring rab cig 'dren rgyu ma byung / slar drangs pa phal cher gsol nas lhag ma cung zad drod yod pa nyung shas shig gtad nas/ 'di drod ma yal ba rgyal po la thengs pa gyis gsung / dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi lam yod pas ma grang ba ga la 'ong byas pas/ slob dpon na re/ rgyal po ind+ra bhū ti tshangs par spyod pa'i mchog yin pa bden na/ da lta nyid du rgyal po'i
74 bka' babs bdun ldan/drung du phyin par gyur cig /ces brjod cig dang myur du sleb 'ong gsung /des bsams pa/ slob dpon 'di yang thun du smra ba zhig ste/ 'di ltar skye bo thams cad kyi mngon sum dang 'gal ba'i tshig 'di la su zhig yid ches snyam mo/ /'on kyang de bzhin du byas pas yud tsam gyis lam rnams chod 'gro yin 'dug nas dan rtags rnams khyer zhing 'ongs nas/ rgyal po mdun khang du skye bo brgya stong gi dbus na yod pa'i drung du sleb ste tshod ma'i lhag ma gtad/der sngar gyi lo rgyus byas/ko taṃ bhi ri'i brag phug gi btsag dang /grub pa'i chu bo zhes bya ba chu dmar ser 'bab pa zhig yod pa gas rkang gdub gang dang / i lo'i ri la yod pa'i grub pa'i sman sna tshogs pa dang / kā dza kha dzu ra'i nags nas 'bras bu gsum/ skyu ru ra'i nags nas kyang 'bru gsum/grub pa'i mtsho'i nang nas me tog padma gcig rnams bden pa'i rtags can du khyer ba'ang skye bo rnams la bstan pas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur cing /gdod rgyal po yang dngos grub thob par shes so//slad kyis rgyal po dang slob dpon gnyis kyi o rgyan gyi mi rnams la gdams pa bstan pas dngos grub thob pa dang rnal 'byor can sha stag tu gyur te/ o rgyan gyi yul de tsam du che ba yang stongs su nye bar gyur skad/gtam 'di sa hā dza siddhi'i 'grel pa bod na yod pa 'di'i gtam rgyud dang cung zad mi mthun mod/ dper na mdo gas thams cad sgrol gyi lo rgyus 'dra min mang po 'byung ba bzhin ind+ra bhū ti lwa ba par gyur pa mdzad spyod phyogs mthun pa gzhan cig byung na ni mi 'gal lo//yang bod rang na yod pa lhan cig skyes grub kyi 'grel pa'i dpe 'ga' na gtam rgyud de med pa'ang snang bas rgya dpe la la na'ang med par snang
'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ 75zhing / lar rgya gar na yang bstan bcos kha 'phangs dang / tshig sna ring thung 'dra min mang bas deb ther sngon po sogs na dgag sgrub yod de snying po med do/ /rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ 'od gsal brgyud pa'i gtam gyi skabs te bzhi pa'o// //9 slob dpon ind+ra bhū ti dang / lwa ba pa ste slob dpon de gnyis car la grub thob dzā lanta ri pas 'od gsal dang bde ba chen po'i gdams ngag zhus te/ slob dpon de (dzālandharipa)gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ nub phyogs sindhu'i grong khyer na ga ra tha ṭha zhes bya ba zhig tu rigs dmangs rigs su skyes te/ 'on kyang bsod nams kyi mthus longs spyod chen po dang ldan no//phyi zhig na gtsug lag khang zhig tu dge slong byas/ slob dpon lwa ba pa la gdams ngag zhus nas sgom zhing yod pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' las sgra byung ste/khyod o rgyan du song la sgoms shig /der 'dod pa'i dngos (599)grub 'thob par 'gyur zhes byung bas/ o rgyan du song ste rgyal po ind+ra bhū ti dang /lcam lasgri ka ra dang / slob dpon ka tstsha pā da rnams la rgyud thams cad kyi gdams ngag thos shing / der bsgoms pa'i tshe tshes bcu'i dus shig na dur khrod du song bas/ der dpal he ru ku'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mjal zhing / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma mang pos dbang bskur bas de nyid du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang thob po/de nas ring zhig tu yul de nyid du 'dug nas sems can gyi don ci rigs par mdzad do/ /lan cig ko taṃ bha ra zhes pa'i grong khyer zhig na yod pa na grong khyer gyi mi rnams kyis slob dpon la yang yang co dris pas yun ring po'i bar du slob dpon khro bar mi byed/ dus gzhan zhig na grong
76 bka' babs bdun ldan/khyer gyi rigs kyi gtso bo gsum zhig bzhi mdor song / slob dpon ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa mthong ba na/ gcig na re/ rnal 'byor pa 'di long ba zhig zer/ gzhan gcig na re/ 'di ni rnal 'byor pa ma yin lkugs pa zhig go / yang gcig na re/ 'di ni shi ba'i ro zhig go zer ba la/ slob dpon gyis khyed rnams de bzhin du gyur cig ces dmod pa bor bas/ gcig ni mig long / gcig ni ngag lkugs/ gcig de nyid du shi 'o/ /der skye bo thams cad 'jigs shing grub pa thob par grags so/ /de rnams kyi gnyen rnams 'ongs shing gsol ba btab pas slar gsos/ de nas slob dpon yul dzā landhar rdo dang chu la me 'bar ba'i gnas su bzhugs te/yun ring po lon pa na mtshan la'ang yul gyi ming thogs te grub thob dzā gandha ri pa zhes zer ro//dus gcig na rang byung gi mchod rten dang nye ba'i bal yul gyi sa phyogs shig na dbang phyug gi liṅga cho 'phrul shin tu che ba/ zhag bdun du sa the btsugs nas gsol ba btab na mig mthong gi mngon shes dang / dbang dang rgyas pa'i las phra mo mang po dang / khyad par drag shul spyod pa'i las 'phral du 'grub pa zhig yod pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bar du gcod pa zhig byung ba de 'dul ba'i don du sa phyogs der byon/ res gcig tsa na liṅga de mchod pa la rgyal po yang gsum tsam 'dus shing / skye bo brgya stong du ma tshogs pa'i dbus su slob dpon yang byon te/ liṅga la sdigs mdzub bstan pas mgo zhabs log /phus btab pas cha du mar zhig go /der yang skye bo thams cad kyis grub pa thob par shes te zhabs la phyag byas//de nas lan cig yul tsam purṇar bzhud de/ de na sdig spyod kyi rgyal po zhig gis gtsug lag khang mang po bshig par brtsams pa na rgyal po'i sgo
'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ 77drung na pi waṃ mkhan mkhas pa zhig byung / pi waṃ mkhan zhig rgyal po la sems shing 'dug ces sgo bas rgyal po la sbran pas nang du bos pa na/ glu dang pi waṃ gi sbyor ba mang po byas pas rgyal po 'khor bcas dga' bar gyur pa la/ pi waṃ mkhan de ni rnal 'byor par 'gyur nas song ngo / /der rgyal pos sangs rgyas pa 'di kun sgyu mas slu bar byed cing zhes smras pa la/ slob dpon gyis sangs rgyas pa'i bsngags pa brjod/ mu stegs pa rnams dang / khyad par rgyal po de rang la smad pas/ rgyal pos 'khor rnams la 'di mgo chod ces byas so / / der mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnun pas slob dpon gyi sku la gcig kyang ma gnod/ mi lnga brgyas 'ching bar brtsams pas kyang sku 'gul ba (601)yang ma byung / slob dpon gyis thal mo brdabs pas rgyal po'i pho brang phyed mar gas/ rgyal po'i 'khor rnams kyang lta stangs kyis rengs par byas pas shin tu 'jigs shing / rgyal po nyid kyis slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag btsal te/bdag gis ci zhig bgyi zhes zhus pas/sngar gyi sdig pa bshags pa'i don du gtsug lag khang sngar bas nyis 'gyur du gyis/ der gnas pa'i dge 'dun yang nyis 'gyur gyis lhag pa tshugs/ ma shi bar du dge 'dun la mchod pa gyis/ bu la sogs pa bdun brgyud kyi bar du dge 'dun la mchod pa gyis shig ces zangs kyi glegs bu gyis gsung / des kyang de bzhin byas so//yang gan cig yul ma la ba na/ rgyal po legs sbyar la bharta ha ri zhes bya/da lta 'phral skad bha ra thā ri zhes bya ba rta 'bum phrag bco brgyad dang / bud med stong dang bcas pa 'byor zhing rgyas par gnas pa la/ de 'dul ba'i dus yin par mkhyen nas grong khyer dang mi ring ba'i phyogs shig tu bzhugs pa na/mtshan mo'i dus shig chom rkun pa mang po byung / de rnams kyis slob dpon la
78 bka' babs bdun ldan/bskor ba byas/ grong khyer 'joms pa la song bas nor mang po thob/ de rnams phan tshun du deng gnod pa med par nor mang po thob pa ni rnal 'byor pa de'i mthu las yin gyi de bas na thams cad kyis mchod pa bya'o zhes mu tig gi do shag srang brgya stong ri pa la sogs pa mchod pa du mas mngon par mchod nas song ngo / /der mi rnams kyis rgyal po la zhus pas/ rgyal pos kyang rtog pa'i mi btang bas slob dpon nor mang po dang bcas pa mthong bas/ slob dpon rkun po yin snyam nas rgyal po la phul/ des kyang ma brtags par shing gi gsal shing la bskyon no/ /der nyin par ni sku lus gsal shing gis phug pa'i tshul du 'dug /mtshan mo ni de gas babs te ting nge 'dzin sgom zhing bzhugs/ de ltar zhag bdun thal ba na rgyal po yang de'i drung du song ngo /der gsal shing gis phug bzhin pa la gsal shing bcag nas chu klung gi 'gram du khrus mdzad du byon pas/ rgyal po'ang ngo mtshar skyes te bzod par gsol nas rjes su bzung bar zhus pas/ rgyal srid spongs la a wa dhū ti gyis shig /de'i tshe gdams ngag sbyin par bya 'o gsungs pa bzhin du rgyal srid kyang yongs su spangs te slob dpon gyi phyi bzhin du 'brang song ba na/dus gzhan zhig na slob dpon gyis gdams ngag kyang gnang ste bsgoms pas ring po mi thogs par rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tu gyur te/ phyis 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas nas mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /sngar gyi 'phros la/ slob dpon dzā landha ri pa ni phal cher byis pa lta bu'i spyod pa mdzad pas/ bā li pā da ste byis pa'i zhabs zhes grags so//de nas dus phyis shar phyogs pa rnams 'dul bar bzhed nas/ bhang ga la'i tsā ṭi gra ma zhes pa'i grong khyer gyi sung kha 'chag pa'i ha ḍi pa'i tshul
'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ 79bzung zhing yod pa gas/ yul de'i rgyal po gzhon nu go bi tsand+ra zhes bya ba rgyal srid la 'khod nas ring po ma lon pa zhig yod pa/ rang gi gzugs mdzes pa la yongs su chags te me long la blta zhing byi byad 'chos pa la/lan cig gi tshe rgyal po de'i mas tho rangs bltas pa na/ slob dpon rgyal po'i bza' shing gi ra bar song nas shing rnams kyi rtsa bar 'dug nas/ na ri ke la bhikṣa a wo zhes brjod pas shing 'bras rnams slob dpon gyi (603)drung du byung / khu bcud gsog zin pa na/ na ri ke la u par dza hi/ zhes gsungs pas shing 'bras rnams snga ma bzhin du 'byar nas 'gro ba yang yang mthong bas/ rgyal po'i mas grub pa thob par shes nas/ 'dis rgyal po 'dul bar 'gyur ro snyam ste lan gcig bu'i drung du mchi ma phyung ba na/ rgyal pos smras pa yum ci zhig nyis/ des smras pa/ khyod kyi pha gzugs dang stobs dang blo gros thams cad khyod bas bcu 'gyur gyis lhag kyang / mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin bstan/ khyod kyang 'chi kha'i chos las ma 'das zer/rgyal pos smras pa/ 'o na mi 'chi ba'i thabs ma mchis sam/ mas smras pa / rang re'i ha ḍi pa 'di la yod ces smras so/ /rgyal po ha ḍi pa'i drung du song ste khyod kyis nga la mi 'chi ba'i gdams pa ster dgos byas pa na/ des gdams pa yod de/ rgyal srid ma spangs na mi 'grub ces gsung / der rgyal pos smras pa/ 'o na thog mar gdams ngag zhus la phyis rgyal srid spang ngo zhes byas nas/ nags tshal dben pa zhig tu rgyal po dang slob dpon gnyis kho na song ste/ slob dpon gyis rgyal po la rdza'i bum pa stong pa zhig gtad de / der lag pa chug gsung bcug pa na/ ci 'dug myur ba myur bar smros gsung / der rgyal pos cang mi 'dug brjod pa na/ de kho na 'chi ba med
80 bka' babs bdun ldan/pa'i lam yin gsung / lan gsum du rgyal pos dris pas kyang de bzhin du gsungs nas/ rgyal po yid ma ches par 'di ni g.yo can zhig go zhes sa'i dong gting ring por bcug /tsher ma'i shing gis bskor/ glang po che'i lci ba dang / rta'i sbangs kyis bkang ste sbas nas bzhag go /de yang slob dpon gyis sku'i bkod pa gnyis bstan pa yin te/ yul dza landha ra na yang kun spangs kyi spyod pas sems can gyi don mdzad/ bhang ga gar yang de ltar bstan pa yin no//de nas phyi zhig gi tshe slob dpon nag po spyod pa lho phyogs ka ta li kṣe tra chu shing gi zhing zhes bya/ phal skad du ka tsa li zhes zer bar byon pa na / slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i slob ma rnams kyis lam du rnal 'byor pa mang po 'dug pa rnams la/ longs longs grub thob nag po spyod pa pa phebs kyi yod byas pas/ gzhan rnams kyis langs/ grub thob go rakṣa ni ldang ba mi mdzad do/ /der slob dpon yang byon te go rakṣa dang gtam mdzad pa na/ji zhig na go rakṣas khyed kyi bla ma gang yin dris pas/ dzā landha ri pa yin gsung / go rakṣas/ 'o na dzā landha ri pa ni rgyal po go bi tsand+ras sa dong du bskyur nas lo bcu gnyis lon zhes gsungs pas/ spyod pa pa 'khor stong bzhi brgya dang bcas pa shar phyogs su song nas go bi tsand+ra'i sgo drung du khros nas bzhugs so/ /der rol mo rnams la yang sgra ma byung / rta dang glang po che yang sgashing mi za/ bu chung rnams kyang 'o ma mi 'thung ngo //de slob dpon gyi mthu yin par shes nas rgyal po gcom chung ngus phyir byung nas/ slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa nang par zas la 'byon par zhu zhus pas/ slob dpon na re/ de la 'khor stong dang bzhi brgya yod pas
'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ 81tshims par bya mi nus gsung / rgyal po na re/ ngas dmag mi 'bum phrag du ma la rtag tu 'tsho ba sbyor nus na slob dpon 'khor bcas la ci'i phyir mi nus/ slob dpon na re/ 'o na slob ma ma hi la dang / bha dal gnyis sngon la gtong gi tshims par gyis shig /de tshims na phyis kho bo cag kyang 'ong ngo zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal pos kyang 'bras khal lnga brgya tsam bya na (605))dang bcas pa sbyar ro//der ma hi la dang / bha da la gnyis byon/ zas de dag thams cad khong gnyis kyi ku bar blugs kyang ma khengs pas rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes te/ slob dpon gyi drung du song nas/ 'chi ba med pa'i lam 'tshal lo zhus pas/ der slob dpon gyis grang po che bcu gnyis kyi rgyab khal non pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad blangs te rgyal po la dbang bskur ba'i tha mar/ sngar ha ḍi pas bstan pa'i gdams ngag de nyid bstan pas rgyal pos 'di ni bdag gis sngar yang thos zhes sngar gyi lo rgyus bshad do/ /der slob dpon na re/ 'o na khyod la 'chi ba med pa'i grub thob ga la 'ong / de ni nga'i bla ma dzā landha ri pa yin no gsung / der rgyal po grub thob kyis dmod pa 'ong zer shin tu 'jigs pas/ slob dpon gyis thabs bya'o gsung / rin po che sna brgyad bsres pa'i 'jon dmar la rgyal po'i gzugs brnyan gsum byas so//der nag po spyod pa'i slob ma rnams kyis sa sogs nyal nyil thams cad bsal/ rgyal po'i gzugs dong gi khar khyer nas grub thob ha ḍi pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal du bcug pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas 'di su yin gsung /rgyal po go bi tsand+ra yin zhus pas/ bi ṭu ma ro thal bar gyur cig gsungs pas gzugs de thal bar song / yang gzugs gnyis pa phyag 'tshal du
82 bka' babs bdun ldan/bcug pas kyang snga ma ltar song ngo / /de bzhin du gsum pa yang song ngo / /der rgyal po 'jigs te 'khor dang bcas pa snying 'gas pa tsam du gyur skad/slar slob dpon gyis rgyal po khrid de bzod pa gsol du bcug go /der grub thob dzā landha ri pa'i gsung gis/ bu atna pa khyod la slob ma du yod gsung / stong dang bzhi brgya yod zhus pas/ 'o na nga la tsha bo mang du yod par 'dug /nga lo bcu gnyis su ma zos ma 'thungs bkres shing skom pas na nang par gnyis khrus gyis la shog /za ba yin gsung / nang par slob ma gsar pa bdun cu tsam khrus byed du bcug pa las gzhan rnams khrus thon pa na bros/dha ma pa dang dhu ma pa gnyis 'dug pa gas/ de gnyis dzā landha ri pa'i drung du khrid de mdun du sdod du bcug nas/ chu gris yan lag gi sha rnams gcod par gzas te bla ma gang nas gsol zhus pas/ grub thob dzā landha ri pa rgya cher bzhad de/ ha ha nga sdom brtson mi sha ci la za/ mig 'phrul mkhan 'dra ba kun bzhud cig gsung / der phyag gnyis dha ma dhu ma'i mgo bor bzhag pas de gnyis kyis kyang mchog gi dngos grub thob bo//de nas rgyal pos slob dpon dpon slob gnyis yun ring du bsten cing / rang gi sems rgyud kyi dri ma yang rim gyis byang / zla ba drug tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mthar/ grub thob dzā landha ri pas rgyal po la do ha rdo rje'i glus gdams pas rgyal po 'khor stong dang bcas pa sems rnal du gnas pa mtshon nas/ thams cad kyang srid bor te kun spangs kyi spyod pas rgyu zhing rnal 'byor pa chen por gyur to/ /de la rgyal po bharta ha ri ni rgyal po go bi tsand+ra'i zhang po yin no/ /de nas re zhig na dzā landha ri'i phug pa zhig tu slob ma rnams la zhal mi ston par bzhugs/ gan cig gi tshe slob ma blun
'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ 83po mang po phug der 'tshangs nas 'ongs pa la/ slob dpon hūṃ zhes gsung bzhin phug gi steng phug ste mi snang bar bzhud/ nam mkha' nas slar yang mi'i yul du lan drug 'byung ngo zhes pa'i sgra byung ngo / /phug de da lta yang byin rlabs che gsung / yang dus phyis shig lho phyogs ra me shwa ra dang nye ba'i nags tshal zhig tu (607)ma mo'i rten rang byung zhig byung ba/ der mkha' 'gro ma dang sha za mang po 'dus te phyogs de'i lam la 'gro ba'i skye bo thams cad kyi bla tshe rku bar byed pa la/ lan cig gi tshe tshong pa lnga brgya rnal 'byor pa gcig dang bcas pa phyogs der song ba na/ bud med dang bram ze 'ga' zhig byung nas khyed rnams do nub gzhan du mi sleb kyi/nags tshal 'dir 'dug na nadang shing 'dzom la/ gcan gzan dang sbrul gyi gnod pa yang med/ de bas na 'di dang 'dir 'dug ces mi re shing re'i rtsar bzhag go/de rnams de na yod pa'i tshe/ yang bud med gzhan gnyis byung nas/khyed rnams 'dir sdod ces ston pa de mi shes sam/ mi shes byas pas/ de dag ni mkha' 'gro ma dang srin po yin te des khyed rnams bcings so/ de bas na do nub za bar 'gyur bas de'i thabs soms shig ces de nyid du mi snang bar song ngo / /der rnal 'byor pa gcig po de dzā landha ri pa'i slob brgyud yin pas/ des slob dpon dzā gandha ri pa la skad phyung zhing gsol ba btab pas/ nam zhig na phyogs der 'gron btsun zhig byung ngo //de yang der 'dug pa la khong rnams kyis sngar gyi lo rgyus bshad pas/re zhig 'gron btsun de cang mi smra'o/ /nam srod pa na sha za'i mkha' 'gro ma dang srin po rnams mngon du byung bas/ re res mi re bcings nas khrid nas
84 bka' babs bdun ldan/ma mo'i gnas su bzhag ste za bar brtsams pa na/ 'gron btsun des phuṭa ces zer zhing gar byas pas mkha' 'gro ma dang srin po rnams brgyal zhing 'gyel/ ma mo'i rten yang dum bu gsum du gyes te/ der slob dpon gyis phyin chad sems can la gnod pa mi byed par bka' bsgos/ 'gron btsun de ni grub thob dzā landha ri par snang ste/ tshong pa lnga brgya po de thams cad kyang rnal 'byor pa byas te bsgoms pas mthar lnga brgya po thams cad dngos grub thob pa yin zer skad//der slob dpon gyis lo gsum tsam du lho phyogs kyi yul du 'gro ba'i don mdzad par grags/ dus der gsungs pa'i gdams ngag kyang mang du yod par snang ngo / /yang dus phyis shig nub phyogs ma ru'i yul du slob dpon dzñā na gupta zhes bya ba 'khor mang po la chos gsung zhing yod pa'i skabs shig /der rnal 'byor pa ngo mtshar can zhig byung nas su yin dris pas/ dzā landha ri pa yin gsung / yid kyis dri ba mang po byas pa la/ de thams cad kyi gan shar shar btab byung bas yid ches nas rjes su gzung bar zhus pas/ thod pa rnam snang gis gang ba zhig gnang ba slob dpon dzñā na gupta'i rnam rtog med par gsog bas de nyid du mi snang bar yal//der dge 'dun rnams kyis yang dang yang du gsol ba btab pas zla ba gsum tsam du de nyid du bzhugs te/ de rnams la rjes su gdams pa bstan/ de nas rab tu byung ba dang dge bsnyen pho mo yan chad yo bsdoms pas stong tsam yod pa las/ thams cad kyang rdo rje theg pa'i snod du gyur pa yin pas/ de rnams la khyod rnams lo gsum du gsang ste nyams su long / lo gsum nas thams cad kyang sngags kyi spyod pa spyod bzhin 'tsho ba ci bde
'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ 85bar song zhig /thams cad kyang dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs te mi snang bar gyur to/ /der shar phyogs nas rnal 'byor pa drug gis slob dpon dzā landha ri pa dngos su bzhugs nas chos ston zhes thos pas gtsug lag khang der 'ongs pa'i tshe/ slob dpon gshegs nas mi 'dug /yang der sa the btsugs te gsol ba btab pas/ zla ba drug nas dngos su zhal bstan nas gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa stsal te/ zhag bdun song ba na nyan thos senta pa zhig der 'ongs/gang zhig rtog ge la dga' ba//gang dag dge slong dngos gnas dang //mi gang rgan por gyur pa ste//de la de nyid bstan mi bya// zhes gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur skad/gtsug lag khang der nyan thos sendha pa mang du 'ongs shing gnas pa la/sngar gyi dge 'dun rnams lo gsum 'das pa'i rjes su sngags kyi spyod pas phyogs gzhan du rgyu zhing song ba na/ nyan thos rnams kyis yongs su smod par byed do/ /'on kyang ring por mi thogs par thams cad kyis dngos grub sna re thob pas grags pa ma yin pa sangs skad/ rnal 'byor pa drug po des 'chi ba med pa'i dngos grub thob/ rgan shos ni bi bhū ti dā sa yin gsung / 'di bod la yang byon te bu ston rin po ches kyang chos zhus so/ /da dung slob dpon mi'i 'jig rten du lan bzhi 'byon par grags/ slob dpon 'di'i slob ma grub pa brnyes pa ni nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa dang por byung ba nag po spyod pa dang / phyis byon pa sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs gnyis yin/ gzhan
86 bka' babs bdun ldan/yang grub chen tanti pa/ birū pa chung ba/ rgyal po bha ra thā ri/ go bi tsand+ra sogs yongs su grags pa mtha' yas pa zhig yod do//lha skabs 'dir slob dpon de nyid kyi slob ma'i mchog /dus 'khor rgyud phyi mar/kha ṭwāṃ ga dang rus pa'i rgyan cha chang snod cang te'u thogs pa nag po'i ming can no/ /zhes lung bstan pa nag po spyod pa pa'i lo rgyus ni/ sngon gyi bod rnams yul kurṇar 'khrungs pa yin zhes gsung ba dang / da lta yang rgya gar ba'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi kha skad la bibya na ga rar 'khrungs zhes zer te/ de yang bibya na ga ra dang kurṇa ni 'khris nas 'khris kyi yul yin pas/ snga rabs kyi gtam de yang rgya gar ba'i kha skad tsam yin no/ /gsung las rigs bram ze yin gsung zhing / rgya gar la kha skad kyang de bzhin du grags//bod snga ma rnams rje rigs yin zer yang slob dpon nyid kyi do ha las/ reg gin reg gin 'gro ste bram ze'i bu/ /zhes bram ze'i rigs su gsal/ de nang don la sbyor yang phyi dang mthun pa'i brda mdzad pa yin pas so/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis lung bstan pa yang yul u ru bi sha yin la / kho bo'i bla mas gsung pa yang yul u ru bi sha de ni bhang ga la dang nye bar yod gsung / lung bstan ni nag po chen po'i rgyud mgon po mngon 'byung rtsod bral rwa chos rab kyis bsgyur ba las/ de ltar yul u ru bi sar yang mtshungs par nges pa'o/ /der skyes bu brtson 'grus chen po'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa/ rā ma ṇa'i bka' dang mtshungs pa/ sde tshan dang po'i dang po la dbyangs yig dang pos brgyan pa/ sde tshan bdun pa'i bzhi pa cung zad na la zhon pa'i ming can rnal 'byor dbang po gcig pu 'dis dngos grub
'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ 87brgyad thob par 'gyur ro/ /dzambu'i gling du ma byung zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro ༈ / de'i slob ma drug gis lus kyi dngos po spangs pa'i phyag rgya chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes yul dang mtshan dang dngos grub dang slob ma rnams zhib mor gsungs pa'o//slob dpon chen po 'di'i lo rgyus ni rnam thar logs su 'byung ba las blta bar bya'o/ /slob dpon de la sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa'i slob ma drug ni/ bzang po'i zhabs/ ma hi la/ bha da la/ dge tshul tshim bu pa/ dha ma pa / dhu ma pa sogs so/ /kha cig bha da la/ bha dra pa bzang po pa dang gcig zer nas logs su mi bgrong / 'dir bgrong rgyu e ya la par 'dod/ rnal 'byor ma yang me kha la dang / ka na kha la dang / pan dhe pa la sogs (611)ba de rnams ni/ slob dpon nyid bzhugs pa'i dus su mchog gi dngos grub thob pa yin gsung / blon po ku sha la nā tha/ rgyal po lī la tsand+ra dang / dpag med rdo rje/ rgyal bu la ba yi la sogs pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / bram ze dpal 'dzin pa la sogs pa dus phyis mjal ba'i dngos grub brnyes pa yang byung ngo //slob dpon bha dra pas antar pa la gdams/ des nag po spyod pa chung ba zhes kyang grags pa la gdams/ des bhu ba ri pa la gdams/ des bod du 'khrungs pa bhu ba blo ldan la gdams/ des ku sa li bha dra chung ba la gdams pa'i lugs kyang yod/ yang nag po spyod pas gu hya pa zhes grags pa bzang po'i zhabs la gdams/9 slob dpon (bzang po'i zhabs te bhadra pād )'dis bla ma la bar chad byed pa'i mkha' 'gro ma bā hu rī zhes pa de zhing thams cad du mngon shes
88 bka' babs bdun ldan/kyis btsal yang re zhig ma rnyed/ phyi zhig na de wī ko ṭa nyid na shing shim pi la'i sdong po zhig gi khog nang na rdul gcig tu brdzus nas 'dug pa mkhyen nas de'i co to nas bzung / shing sdong gi nang nas phyir phyung ste grub pa'i ral gris bsnun nas tshar bcad do/ /des slob dpon tilli pa la bshad gsung / bod na sngar grags pa la gu hya pas anta rga la gdams/ des tilli pa la gdams par 'dod//skabs 'dir mi gsung yang spyir gyi dus bsgrig pa dang brgyud pa'i babs la de dngos 'thad par snang ngo / /yang spyod pa pas dge ba'i mgon po la bshad de/ de ni re zhig blon po'i bya ba byed cing bsgoms pas mngon shes cung zad thob ste/ rgyal po'i drung du 'dug pa'i tshe/ rang gi lha khang du zho'i rdzi'u zhig bzhag pa byi gas ldags pa mngon shes kyis mthong nas de skrod pa'i brda byas pa/ rgyal pos ci yin dris pa na/ drang por smras pas dngos grub thob par shes te mchod gnas su bkur/ ring por mi thogs par rgyal pos kyang mngon shes lnga grub/ blon po ni rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen por gyur to/ /des kyang tilli pa la bshad do//9 slob dpon tilli pa ni/ shar phyogs tsa ṭi gha po zhes bya ba'i grong khyer du bram ze'i rigs su skyes te/ cher skyes pa na bram ze'i lugs kyi bstan bcos thams cad shes shing / yul 'ga' zhig tu slong mo la phyin pa'i tshe/ mthar gtsug lag khang zhig na dge 'dun rnams spong bas gnas pa mthong nas der dad de rab tu byung / sde snod gsum gyi tshul yang shes/ sngar smos pa'i slob dpon gnyis la dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang / gdams pa mtha' dag mnos nas bsgoms pas ring por mi thogs
'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ 89par ye shes khyad par can skyes te grub pa'i skyes bu mtha' yas pa'i zhal yang mthong / de rnams dang gtam 'dri zhing rjes su gdams pa yang thob/dpal he ru ka dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rtag tu zhal mthong bas de rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rkyen gyis kyang ye shes gong nas gong du 'phel bar gyur te/ zhing gi rnal 'byor ma til rdung mkhan gyi bu mo zhigi dang lhan cig tu spyod pas dge 'dun rnams kyis ghanas gzhi nas bskrad/ grong khyer du til rdung gi bya ba mdzad pa la/ sngar bram ze paṇḍi ta dge slong du gyur pa yin pas rnyed bkur chen po yod pa yang nyams te/til rdung ma'i bdag por gyur pas tilli pa ste til rdung mkhan zhes ming yang 'gyur ro//de nas zhing sna tshogs su spyod cing gnas pas/ o rgyan la sogs pa'i yul rnams su mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi gdams pa thams cad thob/ des na til brdung ba'i bya ba mdzad pas tig la mar khu 'byung ba bzhin/ bla ma'i man ngag gis lus la (613)gnad du bsnun pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'byung bar mkhyen pa sogs bya ba thams cad kyis kyang rang la ngo sprad par song ste mchog gi dngos grub thob/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhal yang cig car mthong ngo / /der rang gi rtogs pa de gzhan la ston par bzhed nas/ dus gzhan zhig na grong khyer gyi tshong 'dus rnams su rtogs pa glur blangs pas skye bo thams cad the tshom du gyur/ lan cig bhang ga la'i grong khyer cig tu skye bo brgya stong du ma slob dpon la bltar 'ongs pa la/ slob dpon rig ma dang lhan cig mi gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la til rdung bzhin 'dug go /mi res dri ba re byas pa la/ gan du rtogs pa'i glu re
90 bka' babs bdun ldan/blangs pas/ der 'tshogs pa'i skye bo phal cher gyis kyang don rtogs nas dngos grub thob pa yin skad//der grub thob tilli pa zhes grags shing / yun ring por 'gro don mdzad nas sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du bzhugs pa yin no/ /de'i slob ma ni rol pa'i rdo rje dang / nā ro pa gnyis yin/ snga ma'i gtam rgyud 'dir mi gsung ste mi tra dzo gi'i skor na 'dug pa de yin par mngon/ mar do dang /pu rangs lo chung gi lugs kyi bde mchog gi lo rgyus dang / dpyal pa'i dges rdor lo rgyus na go ta ma shi ṣyo yang slob ma mchog tu bshad do//sto na ro pa ni kha che'i yul du bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas mu stegs kyi paṇḍi tar gyur pa la/ der mu stegs pa'i gsang sngags pa byas nas bram ze'i rigs kyi spyod pa bor/ a ba dhū ti byas so/ /lan cig chang 'tshong ma zhig gi nang du phyin pas/ de nas sangs rgyas pa'i paṇa chung zhig yod pa/ nā ro pa'i zil ma bzod par bros song ba/ de'i shug du mdo'i dpe zhig lus 'dug pa gzigs pas chos la shin tu mos te yul dbus su song nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ste paṇḍi ta ches chen por gyur pa na/ nā land+ra dang / bi kra ma shī la'i byang sgo srung bar mdzad/der mu stegs rnams tshar bcad kyi nyan bshad rgya cher mdzad pa las/rang sems ba 'jo ba'i yun tsam yang mi gnas par 'dug nas mtshan re bzhin 'khor lo bde mchog rtag tu bsgoms pas mkha' 'gro ma mang pos zhal bstan te/ shar phyogs na slob dpon tilli pa zhes bya ba yod pas de'i drung du songs shig /dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro zhes bskul/ shar phyogs su song nas phyogs thams cad du tilli pa btsal bas ma rnyed/ lan cig
'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ 91gtsug lag khang zhig na dge 'dun rnams zas la 'dus te sgo nang nas bsdams//nā ro pa rung khang na yod tsa na/ mi sngon po btsog btsog 'dra ba zhig byung nas nya gson po mang po me mdag la bsreg gin 'dug nas/ der nā ro pas bzlog kyang ma thub/ de rjes dge 'dun rnams byung nas gshe ba la/de na re/ khyed rnams mi dga' na slar yang chu la btang bas chog gsung ste / nya mes tshos pa rnams chu la pho bas 'phyong zhing song skad/ nā ro pas de grub thob yin par shes nas phyi bzhin song ste zhabs la phyag byas gsol ba btab pas/ khro zhing brdeg pa las tshig rnal ma tsam yang mi gsung / tilli pa yin nam snyam pa'i tshe yin yin gsung / min nam snyam pa'i tshe min min gsung / der gzhan sems mkhyen pa dang tilli pa yin pa shes/ yang res 'ga' rnal 'byor pa'i spyod pa ltar ston/res 'ga' skyon par ba②yin snang /der yang nā ro pa la rnam rtog skyes/ lan cig grong khyer na bag ma len pa'i sa shig nas tshod ma mang po blangs te slob dpon la drangs (615)pa na/slob dpon de la zhen zhen ltar mdzad cing 'dug pas/ bla ma 'di lam nyes so snyam ste slar yang sngar gyi sar song //de yang rgya gar na nyi ma gcig la mgron du gan gnyis bsgru ba'i srol med pas/ tshod ma'i snod brkus te khyer 'ongs pa mi rnams kyis ded pas/dbyug pa dang rdo mang po lus la phog kyang snod ma shor bar tshod ma rnams bla ma la drangs/ yang lan cig srin bu dza lu ka ste pad pa mang po yod pa'i chu kha zheng chung ngu zhig gi 'gram na bla ma phar tsam tshur tsam mdzad/ der nā ro pas/ bdag chu'i dbus su zhugs nas zam pa bgyi'am zhus pas/ rung
92 bka' babs bdun ldan/gsung / de ltar byas pas nā ro pa'i mgo bor zhabs bzhag nas mtshongs te phar byon/ da myur du ldog 'ong bas de khar sdod cig gsung / bla ma yun ring bar ma byung / tshur lam yang bla mas snga ma bzhin byon/ der srin bu pad pas lus kyi khrag thams cad 'jibs te 'chi ba la thug par song //yang rim gyis gsos nas bla ma'i phyi bzhin song ba na/ lam du rgyal po'i bu mo 'do li la bteg nas byung ba dang 'dzom pas/ tilli pa na re/ rgyal po'i bu mo 'di phrogs shig gsung / nā ro pas bram zer brdzus te shis pa brjod pa ltar byas nas/ bu mo'i mgo bor me tog bzhag ste stobs kyis khrid nas bros pas/ g.yog rnams kyis nā ro pa brdungs te ldang mi thub par sa la ro bzhin song / de slob dpon gyi thabs kyis gsos nas/yang lam du song ba las/blon po'i chung ma 'gro ba dang / bag ma zhig 'gro yin 'dug pa la yang snga ma ltar gsungs nas gsos pa'i bar gong bzhin/ der bla ma bud med bzhed par 'dug snyam ste/ rigs mtho ba'i bu mo zhig pha ma la rin byin te nā ro pa rang gis blangs nas nang par bla ma la 'bul snyam ste/de nub rang gis bsten pas nang par bla mas nā ro pa'i rtags rdo'i bar du bcer/ der nyin zhag mang por shin tu na bar gyur pa na bla mas sngags btab pas gsos/ der bud med de slob dpon la phul ba las/ gan cig bu mo de nā ro pa la blta rgod byed pa la/bla mas khyod nga la mi dga' bar 'di la dga' ba zhes de dang nā ro pa gnyis car brdungs so/ /de dag kyang nā ro pa'i dad pa brtan mi brtan brtags pa yin pa las nā ro pa ma dad pa ma skyes par ma zad dad pa phyir zhing 'phel lo//yang lan cig dpon slob gnyis khang bzang gi rtse mo zhig na yod pa la / 'di na mar mchongs nus pa gcig byung na nga dga' ste gsung ba la/ bla
'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ 93ma'i thabs kyis myur du gsos 'ong snyam ste/ nā ro pas mchongs pas yan lag rnams chag /der bla ma nyin zhag mang por byon ma byung / da yongs 'chi ba las 'os med snyam pa la/ bla ma byon te sngags btab pas gsos/ de ltar lo bcu gnyis su dka' ba dpag tu med pas bla ma bsten kyang tha na tshig legs pa zhig kyang ma gsungs skad/ de nas lan cig thang stong pa zhig tu da ngas gdams ngag bstan gyi maṇḍal phul gsung / 'di na chu dang me tog mi 'dug zhus pas/ khyod kyi lus la khrag dang sor mo yang med dam gsung /khrag gtar te khrag gis chag chag btab/ sor mo rnams bcad de tshom bur bkod//der tilli pas/ nā ro pa'i sor mo rnams bsdus nas/ 'jim pa dang mchig ltam nā ro pa'i gdong la brgyabs pas yug cig dran med du song /sangs tsa na chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid mngon sum du mthong / sor mo'ang gsos so/ /slar yang gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa mtha' dag stsal/ der nā ro pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tu (617)gyur pa la/ tilli pa na re/ da khyod rtsod pa ma byed/ slob ma ma bsten/ bshad pa ma byed/ de ltar na myur du mchog thob par 'gyur gsung / de nas phulla ha rir spros med kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa'i tshe gan cig mu stegs dang rtsod pa byed dgos byung ste / de yang dge 'dun gyi sde cig tu mu stegs kyi rgol ba mkhas po zhig rtsod par byung / de dang rtsod nus pa ma byung ba'i skabs rgan mo zhig na re/ dpal snyan grags bzang po gam yo na 'dug pa la zer ba dge 'dun rnams kyis btsal bas rnyed/ rtsod par zhus pas sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa la phan par dgongs nas/ de'i nang par rtsod pa mdzad tsa na rtsod pa cung zad pham pas/
94 bka' babs bdun ldan/nga lta bu'i smra ba'i dbang phyug ci phyir pham snyam bsams pas/ bla ma'i bka' dran te/ bla ma la gsol ba btab pas de ma thag rtsod pa yang rgyal//tilli pa mi thod khrag 'dzag pa thogs nas 'jigs 'jigs 'dra ba sprang po'i rnam par mngon sum du byon/ nā ro pas zhabs la phyag byas/ mu stegs na re/ khyod sangs rgyas pa snying rje can yin zer yang / snying rje med pa'i srin po 'di la phyag 'tshal ba rang gis khyod pham pa yin byas pas/tilli pas mu stegs pa'i lha khang la sdigs mdzub mdzad de/ pham mo pham mo zhes bro brdungs pas lha khang zhig ste/ der rtsod pa dang nus pa gnyis ka sangs rgyas pa rgyal lo/ /bla ma'i bka' cung zad bcag pa des sku tshe de la mchog gi ngangos grub ma thob/ sku lus bor ma thag tu sangs rgyas pa yin gsung / slob dpon 'di ni phag cher phulla ha ri nyid du bzhugs/ skabs skabs su yul sna tshogs su rgyu zhing dbang bskur ba dang / rgyud dang gdams ngag gsung ba dang / mu stegs can rtsod pas tshad gcod pa la sogs pa mkhas pa'i bya ba mang po'ang mdzad/ gtso bor las chen bcu gnyis thogs med du grub pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad/ yi dam gyi lha thams cad kyi zhal rtag tu gzigs pa/ thun mong gi dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud pa'i sgrub pa po chen po yin no//slob dpon 'di'i slob ma ni/ rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa shānti pa la sogs pa sgo srung gi paṇḍi ta dang / jo bo rje a ti sha la sogs pa bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mang po yod/ thun mong ma yin pa'i slob ma'ang / bshad rgyud 'dzin pa la pha rgyud la mkhas pa bzhi/ ma rgyud la mkhas pa bzhi ste brgyad do/ /dang po bzhi ni/ nag po 'jigs med rdo rje/ pi phyo ha du/ dza yā ka
'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ 95ra / kha che ā ka ra siddhi'o/ /phyi ma bzhi ni/ ma na ka shrī/ dharma ma ti/ paṃ ting pa chen po/ pradzñā rakṣi ta'o/ /de rnams kyang nus pa la mnga' brnyes pa sha stab/ go ༈ yang kha cig pi ṭu ha du/ dharma ma ti dang gcig /snga ma bzhi la dzñā na garbha bgrong zer/ grub pa brnyes pa'i slob ma bzhi ni/ dpal mchog ḍo bi pa/ ri ri pa / kunta pa/ ka so ri pa ste thams cad kyang dngos grub thob pa'o/ /slob ma bzhi gsum bcu gnyis 'di bod na sngar grags pa ltar bkod pa yin no//༈ dpal mchog pa ram ḍo tra pa ni/ dang po rgyal po'i ba glang mang po'i rdzi bo yin te klog kyang mi shes pa yin pa la/ nā ro pa dgon pa zhig na bzhugs pa la mos pa skyes nas yang nas yang du 'o ma dang mar drangs so//de nas slob dpon nā ro pas sems bskyed pa zhig kyang bslabs/ dges pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas sgom thabs shig kyang bslabs/des kyang sgom bzhin yod (619)pa'i tshe/ gan cig chus khyer bas nya zhig gis mid/ nya'i khog nang du he ru ku'i dkyil 'khor zhal mthong ste gnod pa med par phyir phyung //de nas slob dpon gyi drung du kun spangs kyi spyod pa byas te rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas mchog gi dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud de chos thams cad dang / khyad par rdo rje theg pa thams cad la blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas/ slob ma mang po la yang bshad pas dngos grub thob pa byung / der bstan bcos mang po rtsom dgos pa byung nas yi ge slar bslabs pas/ mu stegs dang / nang pa'i paṇḍi ta thams cad co 'dri ba chos kyi gtam gyis tshar bcad/ phyogs thams cad du snyan pa'i grags pas khyab/ a ti sha'i yang bla ma yin/ bod
96 bka' babs bdun ldan/rnams dzo bos dngos su ma mjal zer yang / mi g.yo ba don dam pa sgrub pa zhes pa dzo bos mdzad par yang ḍombi pa la dngos su gsan par bshad cing / des mdzad pa'i bstan bcos de nyid bzhi pa la sdo bos mdzad pa'i 'grel pa yang snang ba der yang chos de dag dngos su thob pa'i tshig snang ba dang / rgya gar mkhas pa rnams mjal bar mdzad kyin 'dug /'grel pa de'i glegs bam gyi rgya dpe yang slob dpon ni rpā ṇa shrī'i phyag na 'dug pa kho bos kyang mthong ngo / /slob dpon ḍombi chung ba de la ku sa li bha dra chung bas zhus pa yin no//9 slob dpon ku sa li bha dra de ni rgya gar nub phyogs me bar zhes bya bar 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas rig pa'i gnas mang po mkhyen/ mu stegs kyi bla ma chen po cig la rab tu byung bar zhus pas des ma khrid/ 'o na mu stegs 'di rnams thams cad sun phyung dgos snyam nas dpal rdo rje gdan pa'i drung du rab tu byung / sde snod thams cad la shin tu mkhas par sbyangs/ slar kā ma dra'i yul du bram zer brdzus te phyin nas mu stegs kyi paṇḍi ta dang bram ze drug tsam la mu stegs kyi grub mtha' thams cad mkhas par bslabs/ kā ma dra'i yul gyi sgyu ma dang / bi dzo gi ri pa'i lugs kyi sngags mang po dang /mkha' 'gro ma'i ngan sngags mang po dang / shyang nga ri'i sngags kyi rigs mang po bslabs shing grub par byas/ sngar gyi nub phyogs na yod pa'i mu stegs kyi paṇḍi ta rnams kyi rtsa ru song / rgyal po kurṇa zhes bya ba gcig yod pas dpang por bzhag /sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang paṇḍi ta ni nyis stong tsam 'dus/ mu stegs ni brgyad stong tsam 'dus nas rtsod pa byas pas/ slob dpon rig pa bzang zhing mu stegs kyi rgyus yod pas re re bzhin du thams
'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ 97cad sun phyung / der cho 'phrul 'gran par byas pas/ mu stegs pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig gis nam mkha'i skar ma gnyis sa la phab pa ltar snang ba na/mi mgo'i gzugs can khang pa tsam nag po gnyis 'dug skad//de ni slob dpon gyis mig 'phrul yin par shes nas de bshig pa'i sngags bzlas pas/ de gnyis sol ba rdog po gnyis su song / mi thams cad kyis mig 'phrul du go /mu stegs 'ga' res lus la me 'bar ba sogs ston pa la/ der chu phab pas me mnal ba sogs re re nas sun phyung ste thams cad sgyu mas sgyu ma bcom pa yin gsung / mthar mu stegs kyi gtso bo bzhi slob dpon gyis sngags btab pas byi gar song / shyang nga ri'i sngags kyis der tshogs pa'i mu stegs thams cad kyi khyim gyi yo byad thams cad sa rdor btang / der mu stegs rnams pham ste re zhig yul der sangs rgyas pa shin tu dar bar byung / da ltar yang mang bar yod gsung / der slob dpon gyis bsams pa/ nga'i 'di kun ②(621) 'phrul ni ma yin/ rig sngags sna tshogs kyis mi rnams kyi mgo bskor ba yin pas nyes pa che zhing / sngon chad thos bsam thams cad chags sdang gi dbang du gyur pas da ni kun spangs bya'o snyam nas tsarya pa'i rnal 'byor pa byas/ thugs dam mdzad kyin yod pa gas slob dpon dpal mchog ḍombi pa dang mjal/ bde dges kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhus nas gdams ngag thams cad kyang thob par byas//de bzhin du gong du brgyud pa so so'i skabs su smos pa'i bla ma thams cad kyi drung du song ste snga ma bzhin du bla ma thams cad mnyes shing /gdams ngag kyang thob/ yun ring du bsgoms pas grub chen nag po spyod
98 bka' babs bdun ldan/pa dang / birū pa dang / byā da li pa la sogs pa sngon byon gyi grub chen mang po dang yang mjal te/ de rnams kyis kyang gdams pa re yang gnang / khong nyid kyis lo bcu gnyis su shar phyogs sa ra bhang ga'i nags tshal du 'dug ste kha zas kyi 'khri ba bcad nas chu kho na gsol zhing bsgrubs pas rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa skyes/ g.yang sa la bya bzhin du bzhud pa dang / zla ba tsam gyi lam chu tshod gcig gis bgrod pa dang / gcan gzan gtum po rnams kyis bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / 'byung po bran du 'khol ba dang / yi dam gyi lha du ma'i zhal gzigs pa dang /sems can rnams kyi bsam pa shes pas de dang mthun par chos ston pa yin no/ /dus de tsam na rgya gar tsam na yang gdams ngag che/ grub thob par grags//lan cig slob dpon nag po spyod pa dang dngos su mjal nas/ khyod spros bcas kyi spyod pa gyis/ nga'i rjes su 'brang ba tsarya pa thams cad kyi gtso bor 'gyur/ ngas byin gyis rlob bo zhes lung bstan/ 'khor rig ma nyi shu tsam dang bcas te yul sna tshogs su spros bcas kyi spyod pa lo bcu gsum mdzad/tsarya pa'i rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyis zhabs la gtugs/ mthar de wī ko ṭa'i dgon par lo bdun cu don gnyis bzhugs/ slar slob dpon 'dis lo brgya lnga bcu rtsa bdun bzhugs pa yin gsung / phyis kyi tsarya pa rnams kyi sde sgrigs bkod can 'di 'dzugs mkhan slob dpon 'di yin no//༈ de'i slob ma ni mang yang / 'dir slob dpon a si ta gha na yin te / de yang thog ma mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor pa zhig yin/ yul ni pra yā gar 'khrungs/ sgra dang rtog ge la mkhas/ lha dbang phyug chen po bsgrubs pas grub pa'i dngul chu byin/des mi ma yin gyi gnas mang por 'gro ba dang / lus mi
'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ 99rgas pa la sogs pa byung / ma mo dang 'byung po'i sngags mang pos drag shul spyod pa grub/ der nga rgyal che bar yod pa la/ tsarya pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig dang nus pa 'gran pas dngul chu'i dngos grub kyang nus pas phrogs/khong gi drag shul spyod pa'i mthu gcig kyang ma song bas der sangs rgyas pa la mos nas/ paṇḍi ta pra bha badma dang / slob dpon chen po ratna rakṣi ta dang / bi bhū ti tsand+ra dang / de wa a ka ra la sogs pa mang po la gdams ngag zhus/ rgyud kyang bde dges 'jigs byed gdan bzhi 'dus pa ste lnga zhus shing mkhyen/slar slob dpon ku sa li bha dra chung ba dang mjal/ bka' babs kyi gdams ngag thams cad kyang gnang / rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ 'dod yon gyis sems la gnod par gyur nas nags su lo bdun dka' ba spyod cing bsgoms/ der lū yi pa dang / byā da li pa la sogs pa sngon gyi grub thob mang po dang dngos su mjal te gdams pa yang thob/ khyod grong khyer du (623)songs shig 'dod pa'i don 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs te nang par grong khyer du song bas/ de na glu gar mkhan mang po glu gar rtse ba mthong bas rkyen byas te sems rgyud yongs su grol nas dngos grub thob/ der rdzu 'phrul gyis bzhud nas skye bo rnams la chos mang du bstan//de nas yul sna tshogs su skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas cung zad ston cing snying po'i don bshad pas skye bo rgyud grol ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ngo / /lo nyis brgya tsam sku lus de gas bzhugs/slob dpon 'dis rtogs pa don gyi glu blangs pa dang / rgyud sde'i bstan bcos chung ngu mdzad pa yang mang du snang ngo / /des ye shes bshes gnyen la gdams te/ paṇḍi ta mkhas brgyud byas na rnam grangs mang mod kyang zhib par
100 bka' babs bdun ldan/mi gsung / byin rlabs bka' babs kyi brgyud pa 'di'i dbang du byas na/slob dpon ku sa li chung ba dang / a si ta gha na dang / ye shes bshes gnyen gsum gyi ring la paṇḍi ta'i brgyud pa ded na bla brgyud bco lnga nyi shu yong bar snang ngo //9 slob dpon de (ye shes bshes gnyen te dzñānamitra )ni rigs dmangs rigs/ yul ti pu ra/ shar phyogs dza gad da la'i gtsug lag khang du rab tu byung / sde pa ni mang pos bkur ba yin/ de'i lugs kyi 'dul ba dang mngon pa'i sde snod kyang mkhyen/ theg pa chen po'i gzhung lugs kyang mang du mkhyen/khyad par gsang sngags la mkhas pa'i slob dpon mang po la thug nas 'dus pa gshin rje'i gshed/ bde dgyes/ zla gsang thig le/ phyag chen thig le/dus kyi 'khor lo rnams mkhas par mkhyen/ yang dharma pa'i slob brgyud kyang yin/tsarya pa yang yin pa zhig la ma hā mā yā dang gdan bzhi zhus/ de rnams ci rigs rigs sgom zhing yod pa'i tshe grub thob a si ta gha na dang mjal/bka' babs gsum gyi gdams ngag ma lus pa gnang / der rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa khyad par can skyes shing bla ma la zhus pas/ da ste lo bcu gnyis na ye shes grub pa'i slob dpon zhig zla ba'i gling du 'byung / nga'i gdams ngag gis rgyu byas/ de'i gdams ngag gis rkyen byas te/ khyod kyis phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur gsungs nas/ slob dpon ni o rgyan du 'gro gsung ste nam mkha' la gya gyur bzhud do//bar der lo bcu gnyis bsgoms pas rtogs pa bzang po skyes te/ da ni spyod pa cig bya snyam pa la da lta mu stegs mang bas mi kun gyis tho cor mthong na bstan pa la gnod snyam re zhig bshog/ der lan cig zla ba'i gling
'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ 101du byon pa zhig la/ slob dpon dga' byed skyong des 'og dpal gyi sgo nas thon te gling der byon pa dang mjal/ der phyag rgya bzhi'i gdams ngag zhus pa / phyag rgya gzhan gsum gyi skabs gdams ngag nga rang che snyam/ de nas phyag rgya chen po bshad pas bla ma de ye shes kyi skur gzigs/ sems rang bzhin gyi lhan skyes bde chen gyi don mngon sum du mthong / the tshom thams cad chod cing chos thams cad kyi gting sleb//slob dpon dga' skyong dpal gyi sgor bzhud nas lo phyed dang nyis brgya na shar phyogs su 'thon/ a si ta gha na dang mjal/ de nas lo nyis brgyar nye ba'i mtshams su slob dpon 'di dang mjal ba yin/ de nas slob dpon 'di spyod pa spyod par bzhed de sngar gyi dge 'dun gyi gnas der ma bzhugs/ tsarya pa'i gnas rnams su spyod cing rab tu byung ba'i rtags ni ma bsgyur/ spyod pa ni spros bcas kyi spyod pa gtso bor lo gsum mdzad cing /(625) spros med kyi spyod pa yul sna tshogs su rgyu ba shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa dang bsres kyin lo drug tsam mdzad de phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang grub//lan cig o ḍi sha na mu stegs kyi lha khang dza gad nā tha zhes bya ba lha khyab 'jug gi rdo sku rang byon cho 'phrul shin tu che ba yin pa la/ slob dpon rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang bcas nas lha khang gi sgo drung na bzhugs nas dkon gnyer la lha khang mjal bar zhus pas/ des kyang gnas gzhi'i bdag po mu stegs kyi bla ma zhig la smras pas/ de na re/ sangs rgyas pa 'di kun 'o skol gyi lha la ma dad mod kyi/ de khyim btsun zhig yin snang bas yul lha'i 'du shes kyis mjal ba yin yong / de thong zer/ der slob dpon
102 bka' babs bdun ldan/lha khang du byon pa na/ slob dpon ri mo la blta bzhin du yun ring du 'dug go / dkon gnyer bas dbyug pa brdegs pas/ der slob dpon gyis rwa dung bus pa na/ dza gad nā tha la sogs pa lha khang de'i rdo sku thams cad yan lag dang dbang po thams cad brug te sngar gyi cho 'phrul rnams chung du song / sngon gyi sangs rgyas pa'i sde zhig pa rnams kyang slar gsor btub pa byung ste/ bar skabs su rgyal po gsum tsam gyi bar la lo brgya tsam du o ḍi shar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa shin tu dar bar byung / da lta yang tho re ba yod gsung /slob dpon 'di yang lta stangs bzhi thogs pa med par grub nas sems can gyi don mdzad cing / khyad par gnas lugs kyi don mngon sum du gzigs nas rgya cher bshad pas rtsod pa'i dus kyi tha mar gyur pa yin kyang / nam mkha' lta bu'i rtogs pa brnyes pa stong du longs pa byung skad//thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa yang mang du byung / mchog gi dngos grub mngon gyur du thob pa ni slob dpon dharma ka ra zhes bya ba zangs gling du 'ja' lus thob pa zhig dang / rnal 'byor ma zla 'od ces bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma bha dza ru ru zhes bya ba ste snga slob gsum mo/ /phyi slob grub chen zhi ba sbas pa ste bzhi'o// rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las 'od gsal la sogs pa bka' babs bzhi gcig tu 'dres pa'i gtam gyi skabs te lnga pa'o// //
bka' babs lnga pa/bskyed rim 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i bka' babs/༄༅/ /bka' babs lnga pa ni/ bskyed pa'i rim pa phrin las dang bcas pa yin te/de yul dbus kha bi zhes pa'i nang tshan grong khyer rdo 'jog ces par/bram ze'i slob dpon shin tu mkhas pa zhig yod pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la lhag par dad de/ nā land+rar dge 'dun phal chen pa'i sde la rab tu byung ste / buddha shrī dzñā na zhes bya ba sangs rgyas dpal ye shes zhes mtshan btags so ༈ / kha cig na/ slob dpon 'di rgyal rigs klog pa po zhig yin zer ba'ang 'dug /der slob dpon seng ge bzang po la theg pa che chung gi chos mtha' dag legs par bslabs/ gu ṇa mi trā zhes bya bas gsol ba btab ste shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa'i 'grel pa sogs bstan bcos kyang mang du byas/ gu ṇa mi trā 'di bod pa'i phar phyin gyi chos brgyud la bzhugs/ dge slong ma yin par zhal lung 'grel pa las bshad do//de nas nub phyogs o rgyan du song / slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang /rnal 'byor ma gu ne ru zhes bya ba la gsang sngags phyi nang gi chos mang du zhus/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po thob/ o rgyan gyi byang phyogs na gdol pa'i bu mo dzā ti dza la zhes bya ba lcam dpal mo dang rgyud gcig pa zhig la zla ba brgyad bsten/ dzambha la'i lung thob pa tsam gyis rig sngags grub/ yul dzā landha rar slob dpon byis pa'i zhabs te/ bā li pā da (627)zhes bya ba
104 bka' babs bdun ldan/la shes rab kyi rgyud zhus/ 'di grub thob dzā landha ri pa'i sku'i rnam 'gyur ka yin par grags/ der shes rab rgyud la chu bo rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin thob/ de nas lho phyogs kong ka na zhes bya ba shing nam mkha' na skye ba zhig na/ slob dpon pā li ta pa da ste slob dpon srung ba'i zhabs zhes bya ba rtsa'aphrul dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnal 'byor pho mo bco brgyad tsam dang bcas pa la yo byad thams cad ni nor rgyun mas sbyor/ de la gsang ba 'dus pa zhu zhing lo dgu bsten/ rgyud tshar bco brgyad nyan/ 'on kyang de kho na nyid cung zad ma rtogs nas bla ma la zhus pas/ kho bos kyang ma rtogs gsung //der mā la mo di zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya zhig yod pa 'dus pa'i glegs bam du bsgyur te mgul du btags nas/ rdo rje gdan gyi rgyab ku ba'i tshal zhes bya bar sgrub pa lan gsum spyad pas zla ba bco brgyad dang / drag shul spyod pa zla ba drug tu bsgrubs pas lung bstan pa byung ste/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la the tshom chod zer/ 'o na 'jam dpal rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga na bzhugs pas der 'gro dgongs te dpag tshad bcu tsam byang shar du song ba na / nyi ma ma phyed tsam gyi dus shig tu khang pa dkar po zhig gi drung na khyim btsun rgan po sham thabs bye ba/ chos gos kyi thod byas pa zhig bud med ngan ma gcig dang lhan cig zhing mod pa mthong ste cung zad ma dad/ de dang nye ba na khyi mo dkar mo ngan ma gcig kyang nyal nas 'dug go/der nyin mo'i dus tshod bsod snyoms kyi dus la babs pas na kha zas bslangs pas/ yur ba nas nya zhig bzung khyi mo la byin/ des skyugs pa slob dpon la drangs pas rnam rtog gis ma gsol/der khyim btsun na re/'dzam bu gling pa rnam rtog che/ zas bzang po drang zer nas gzhan zhig tu song ngo / /der
bskyed rim 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i bka' babs/ 105bud med des 'bras chan dang / zho bzang po drangs pa gsol nas 'byon par chas tsa na/ de ring grong du mi sleb nang par song zer bas der bzhugs te gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud bton pas/ the tshom gyi gnas gang yin pa der bud med de mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur re byed kyin 'dug nas/ 'di gzhan sems shes pa'o dgongs nas bdag gi the tshom gcod par zhu byas pas/ngas mi shes/ da ci'i khyim btsun de 'dus pa la shin tu mkhas/ nyi ma phyi phred na sleb 'ong / de la the tshom chod zer ba ltar phyi phred na chang gis bzi nas 'khyer bzhin byung / der sngags kyi spyod pa can du shes te ma dad pa spangs te zhabs la phyag btsal nas the tshom rnams zhus pas/ dbang bskur dgos gsung / sngar gzhan la thob zhus pas nga'i chos ston pa la nga rang gis dbang bskur dgos gsung / dkyil 'khor khang pa zhig tu zhugs so//nam srod kyi dus su slob dpon nang du bos pa la/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i drung na/ sngar gyi sprul pa'i dge slong bud med dang khyi mor bcas pa yang snang ste/ su la dbang len gsung / de rnams ngo bo gcig par shes kyang / rnam pa dkyil 'khor la mos nas dkyil 'khor las 'tshal zhus pas/ 'o na long gsung ste/ de gsum khang chung gzhan zhig tu song / dkyil 'khor yang mi snang bar gyur/ der slob dpon thugs skyo bas tho rangs kyi dus/ khyod ni sems can kun gyi yab ste zhes sogs gsog ba btab pas/ dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin du sprul te dbang bskur nas/ 'jam dpal zhal lung bshad/ der slob dpon dgongs pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ chos thams cad kyi (629)gting sleb/ dang por zas nya sha khyis skyugs pa dang / khyim btsun gyi spyod pa gnyis
106 bka' babs bdun ldan/dang / rjes su rnam pa khyim btsun rgan po la ma dad pas 'ja' lus ma grub/bar dor dngos grub mchog brnyes par 'gyur ba'o//de nas rang gi rtogs pa thabs rim gnyis khyad par can dang bcas pa rgya cher spel bar bzhed nas/ chos kyi myu gu zhes bya ba'i gnas/skye bo mang po 'du bar rung la/ bsam gtan dang yang mthun pa/ sngon gyi byang chub sems dpas bsten pa zhig yod de/ der dzam bha las yon bdag byas/ snod dang ldan pa mang po la chos bshad pas/ phyogs bzhi'i mkhas pa paṇḍi ta la sogs pa'i slob ma mang du 'dus pa la/ 'jam dpal gyi dgongs pa rgya cher bshad pas snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng thams cad khyab/ lung dang mthun pa'i chos bcu bzhi mdzad/ slob dpon pā li ta pa des kyang 'jam dpal gyi lung gi gdams ngag rnams zhus pas mchog gi dngos grub thob bo//rdo rje gdan mchod pa'i lo rgyus ni/ lan cig slob dpon rdo rje gdan dang nye ba na spyil po mdzad nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rgyal po dharma pā la rdo rje gdan la mchod pa la 'ongs pas/ sangs rgyas pa'i slob dpon gzhan thams cad mchod pa la byon/ slob dpon 'di mchod pa mi byed par mthong nas chad pas gcod dgos snyam ste/ slob dpon gyi spyil por zhugs pas/ de na slob dpon mi bzhugs par 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sku zhig mthong /phyir 'ongs te 'khor rnams la dris pas/ 'di nyid na yod zer//yang nang du 'ongs pas slob dpon du snang / der khyod mchod pa mi byed pa ci yin dris pas/ nga 'di nyid nas mchod pa 'bul gsung / des ji ltar 'bul dris pas/ slob dpon gyis dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag
bskyed rim 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i bka' babs/ 107pas/ rdo rje gdan gyi lha sku thams cad mngon sum du slob dpon gyi drung du mgron du bos pa ltar byung ste/ slob dpon gyis de la rgya chen po'i mchod pa byed par mthong / der rgyal po yid ches nas dbang bskur ba zhus te yon gzhan med nas/ rang nyid btsun mo dang bcas pa 'bangs su phul/ nang par pho brang nas khong rang thams cad kyi lus tshad dang mnyam pa'i gser bslus mar phul lo//bi kra ma shī la'i rab gnas kyi lo rgyus ni/ yang bi kra ma la shī la dang /o tanta pu ri dang / shrī nā gzhwa dang / sau ma pu ri ste gtsug lag khang bzhi po de so so'i bar bar na nyin lam mang pos chod pa yin cing / bi kra ma gsar bzhengs yin/ sau ma pu ri zhig gsos yin zer/ gzhan gnyis na'ang rgyal pos lha khang gsar du bzhengs pa mang du yod pa rnams la rab tu gnas pa zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi sku'i bkod pa bzhi sprul te/ gtsug lag khang bzhi car la rab tu gnas pa dus gcig tu mdzad/ de skabs bi kra ma shī gar/rab gnas kyi zhal bsro chen po yod pa'i skabs/ mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor ma dpon g.yog gnyis kyis sgor 'ongs pas/ dge tshul ma rungs pa rnams kyis brdungs so/ /g.yog mos 'di la nus pa ston dgos zhes yang yang gsog ba btab pas/ dpon mos sngags bzlas pas/ rab gnas kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'og nas chu brdol/ der slob dpon gyis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la btegs pas/ des char drag po phab bo/ /de yang slob dpon gyis phyag bkab ste bsrungs pas/ dkyil 'khor la gnod pa ni ma byung zhing / rab gnas legs so/ /phyis kyang lo re'i dus la de'i nyin par mu stegs kyi gnod pa re yong / tshugs ni mi tshugs so//
108 bka' babs bdun ldan/nā land+ra btul ba'i lo rgyus ni/ der slob dpon chen po des nā land+ra dang /bi kra ma la shī la'i gnas kyi bdag po yang mdzad/de skabs o tanta pu ri na gnas pa'i nyan thos sendha pa rnams dang / rnam par rtog pas g.yengs pa'i dge slong rnams kyis ngan du zer zhing / slob dpon nā land+rar bzhugs pa'i skabs shig na/ dge slong de rnams kyis sangs rgyas ye shes tshul khrims dang mi ldan pas dge 'dun gyi mkhan por rung ba ma yin zhes yang yang rgol ba dang / gsang sngags la gshe zhing / rdo rje gdan gyi sendha pa sing ga la pa mang pos he ru ku'i sku brnyan dngul las bsgrubs (grub )pa bshig ste rnyed par byas so//rgyal pos rdo rje gdan gyi sing ga la pa mang po bsad/ sendha pa gzhan rnams ga'ang chad pa gcod par brtsams pa na/ slob dpon gyis thugs rje chen pos de rnams rgyal po'i gnod pa las legs par bskyabs so/ /ma dad pa bzlog pa'i phyir du sa 'og tu rdzu 'phrul gyis gshegs pa dang / yang skabs 'gar mi ma yin mang po slob dpon la mchod pa dang / ya ma zung gi cho 'phrul mang du bstan/ der sngags kyi spyod pa mchog gi bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad pa las/ nyan thos kyi sde snod dang yang mi 'gal ba bsgrubs so / / sngon 'jam dbyangs sprul pa a ba dhū ti'i spyod pa can de la ma dad pa gtan nas ma skyes na/ de nyid du 'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur gnas 'gyur ba yin pa las/ der ma gus pa'i rnam par rtog pa cung zad skyes pas dgung lo brgyad cu lhag cig bzhes pa na rnam par smin pa'i sku lus bor te/ zung 'jug gi sku brnyes pa yin no/ /de'i slob ma ni mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan las 'das pa'i slob ma bzhi/ rgyal tshab kyi sa la gnas pa zhes bya ba skye ba
bskyed rim 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i bka' babs/ 109gcig gis thogs pa dang / bar dor sangs rgya ba'i rigs can bco brgyad/mkhas pa paṇḍi ta dang / rnal 'byor pa ku sa li grangs las 'das pa byung ngo //slob dpon 'di'i rdo rje'i spun grogs slob mar gyur pa ni kong ka na'i chos kyi 'byung gnas dang / ri bo sa byaṃ gyi gtsug tor rdo rje'o zhes dpal 'bras rdo rjes bshad//slob ma'i mchog bzhi po ni/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ rab zhi bshes gnyin/ bde ba chen po padma ka ra/ rgyal rigs sgra gcan 'dzin no/ /slob dpon chen po 'di'i dngos slob/ yang slob/ nying slob kyi bar du dzam bha la grub pas yo byad sbyor ba dang / nor rgyun mas yo byad sbyor ba dang / rgyud las 'byung ba ltar khye'u dang bu mo la ye shes phab nas dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang /rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yang dkyil 'khor dngos su ston nus pa dang /bden stobs brjod pas rdul tshon gang dgos su 'phel ba sogs yod do/ /de rjes rgyal po ma hā pā la'i gzhug gcig la dge slong gi rten dang cha byad can la sngags spyod mngon gyur pa bkag pas de phyin chad de 'dra mang po ma byung ngo //༈ de la mar me mdzad bzang po ni rgya gar nub phyogs su sku 'khrungs/rig pa'i gnas thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros brnyes/ rten ni dge slong / sde pa ni 'di yang dge 'dun phal chen pa yin gsung / de yang dpal nā land+rar mkhas pa thams cad kyis bkur ba yin/ slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang mjal nas/ rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du zhugs/ rgyud sde yang mtha' yas
110 bka' babs bdun ldan/pa gsan/ 'on kyang man ngag thob dka' bar byung nas/ re zhig lho phyogs kyi yul du byon nas lo gnyis gsum du sngags rgyud kyi (633)sbyor bas sems can la phan btags/ der 'du ba dang longs spyod rgya chen po byung ba de thams cad slob dpon la mchod pa'i yo byad du dril nas/ slob dpon gyi drung du lha 'bangs kyi khyim drug cu dang / gser srang stong / mu tig gi do shal sum brgya la sogs pa yo byad dpag tu med pas mchod cing / khyad par bdag nyid slob dpon gyi bran du khas blangs te slob dpon gyi drung du lo gsum tsam du tha na grong khyer nas dam rdzas sha chang len pa tshun chad kyi bya ba'ang mdzad/ der slob dpon gyis man ngag thams cad kyang gnang //phyogs gzhan zhig tu song nas bsgoms pas rtogs pa khyad par can skyes te slob dpon gyi drung du 'ongs pa bla mas kyang dbang bskur bas/ de nyid du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang thob ste/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs gas kyang rtogs pa mtho ba yin no skad/slob dpon 'dis drag po'i las kyi sgo nas mu stegs kyi rgyal po tshar bcad pa'i gtam rgyud snang ste/ rgya gar mtha' 'khob sindhu'i yul du bzhugs pa'i skabs shig /yul de'i rgyal pos slob dpon gyi slob ma rnams la rtag tu 'tshe ba byed pa zhig yod/ gzhan yang rgyal po des sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa la shin tu gnod pa byed pa zhig yod pa/ lan cig slob dpon dang lam gcig tu mjal bas/ rgyal pos slob dpon la mdung thung 'phangs pas sku la ma gnod/ slob dpon gyis sdigs mdzub mdzad pas rgyal po yo byad dang bcas pa thul gyis tshig nas thal bar song / der rgyal po'i mi mu stegs la dga' ba thams cad 'jigs te/ dge slong mgo bregs 'di kun nus pa
bskyed rim 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i bka' babs/ 111'di tsam zhig ces phyin chad mi rabs mang por nang pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams la 'tshe ba mi byed do//lo rgyus 'ga' las rgyal po de tu ruṣka'i rgyal po bhū ṣā na zhes pa yin te / de dus yul dbus na tu ruṣka med pas/ lta ba log pa rnams la mu stegs zhes zer ba'i skabs nas mu stegs kyi rgyal po zer ba byung ba yin gsung / yang nub phyogs ma la ba'i yul na mu stegs kyi rgyal po khyab 'jug chen po la ltar 'dzin pa zhig yod pa des sangs rgyas pa'i lha khang mang po bshig /dge slong rnams yul dbus su bskrad/ dge bsnyen rnams la yang sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa ster bas/ lan cig slob dpon yang de'i yul du byon pa zhig la slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyis byin rlabs mdzad pa'i lha khang zhig yod pa der bzhugs/ der slob dpon la rgyal po des nyid mang po btags/ slob dpon gyis phyis nyin par dgongs pa zhig btang bas rgyal po chung mar bcas pa nad kyis btab//yang blon po mu stegs la dga' ba zhig dang slob dpon lam du mjal bas/ blon po na re/ rgyal po la ngan thabs byas pas khyod la chad pas gcod zer ba la/ slob dpon gyis mchan khung nas ras la bris pa'i ling ga zhig bton te/ ngan pa de da rung ma shi'am gsungs nas ling ga phyed mar gshags pas rgyal po lus tshal par gas nas shi /blon po de la sngags btab pas rengs/ yang mu stegs kyi slob dpon sā gar nanda zhes bya ba zhig yod pa las/ des phra men ma'i rig sngags mang po bsgrubs te sangs rgyas pa mang po la gnod pa byed pa zhig yin pa las/ lan cig lam sung dog po zhig tu slob dpon dang 'phrad pas lam bzur res ma byung / der mu stegs na
112 bka' babs bdun ldan/re / nang par khyed rnams ma shi na kho bo cag gi lugs mi bden zhes ngan sngags kyi dus btab nas song / nam srod kyi dus su song ba na slob dpon gyi gnas rnams su thug tshom (635)chen po byung //slob dpon gyis dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag pas/ mu stegs de rnams nyid kyi lha khang spyil po dang bcas pa thams cad zhig ste/ der sā ga ra 'khor dang bcas pa yang de nyid du dus gcig la shi /dus de'i tshe sā ga ra ni mu stegs kyi sngags mkhan thams cad kyi gtso bo yin no/ /slob dpon des sman pa zhabs la gdams te/3 slob dpon de (rlubyo pād ste sman pa zhabs )ni mtha' 'khob zhig tu bram ze'i rigs su skyes nas/ mu stegs kyi chos lugs la mkhas shing nus pa yang grub pa yin pa la/ phyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad nas/ yul dbus nā land+rar slob dpon mar me mdzad bzang po dang / mar me mdzad bzang po'i yang bla ma dpal sangs rgyas ye shes gnyis la pha rol tu phyin pa nas brtsams te/ gsang sngags phyi nang gi bar gyi thos pas rgyud sbyangs/dbang bskur zhing gdams pa mtha' dag gnang / khyad par 'dus pa dang he ru ku'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i tshe me tog khro bo hūm̐ mdzad la phog /yun ring du bsgoms pas rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skyes/ khyad par zla ba drug tu sgrub pa byas pas dngos grub thob par shes nas/ de'i sgrub pa'i rten du gdol pa'i bu mo utpal sngon po'i kha dog lta bu rdo rje'i rigs kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig dgos pa phyogs zhig nas btsal bas rnyed nas/ pha ma la bslangs pas de rnams na re/ bram ze'i slob dpon khyod smyo ba yin nam/ nged gdol pa'i rigs yin pas khyod nyid
bskyed rim 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i bka' babs/ 113dang nged rnams la yang chad pa mi 'ong ngam zer ba la/ nga la sgrub pa'i rten du dgos pas tha mal gyi rigs nyams pa sogs kyi chad pa mi 'ong byas pas/'o na bu mo'i lus dang mnyam pa'i gser dang dngul dgos zer/ der slob dpon gyis skad cig la sa 'og gi gter phyung ste de rnams la byin//de nas slob dpon phyag rgyar bcas pa ri phug cig tu zla ba drug sgrub pa byas pas yar ngo'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs kyi dus su nam mkha' la hūṃ gi sgra chen po grags/ dpal he ru ka la sogs pa dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang mngon sum du mthong / phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang yang thob/ 'dus pa gtso bor gyur pa'i lam gyis 'gro ba mang po la phan btags/ bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad nas/ mthar sku lus de nyid kyis sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing du khyung gi rgyal po 'phur ba ltar bzhud do//'di rnying ma ba la grags pa'i slob dpon hūṃ ka ra dang gcig par grags/ de lta na 'khrungs yul bal po yin/ rgyal po sad na legs kyi dus bod du yang byon par rig go /de la slob dpon a ba dhā ti pa zhes bya ba zhig gis zhus/ de la ratna ā ka ra shānti pas zhus/ de la rdo rje gdan pa chen pos zhus/ de la ku sa li pas zhus pa'i brgyud pa'ang yod gsung / 'on kyang bka' babs gtso bor gyur pa ni sman pa zhabs la o rgyan gyi slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal zhi bas zhus/ de la rdo rje gdan pa chen pos zhus/ de la rdo rje gdan pas sau ri pa yang zer/ ratna ā ka ra gupta yang zer/ rdo rje gdan pa bar pas zhus//yang slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas la bshad/ 'di la padma badzra phyi ma'am chung bar
114 bka' babs bdun ldan/grags/ rnam thar rgyas pa logs su yod pa las shes so/ /padma che chung du grags pa ni dus snga phyi la btags pa yin no/ /slob dpon des kā ma ru'i yul gyi a ba dhā ti'i rnal 'byor pa ratna shī la zhes bya ba la gdams/ de la ka yastha bṛddhi ste yig mkhan rgan po zhes bya bas zhus te/9 slob dpon ka yasga shuddha ste yig mkhan rgan po bgres po de ni rgyal po dharma pā la'i yig mkhan yin pa la/ lo brgyad cu lon nas nā land+rar rab tu byung / gsung rab bslabs pas/ de dang nye ba na rgyal po ma hi pā las lam du 'gro ba mthong ste shing gi yal ga skam po zhig slob dpon la bstan te / khyod kyis sde snod rnams shes pa'i tshe/shing 'di la'ang me tog 'byung nges zhes dpyas so//slob dpon gyis bsams pa/ da ni sgrub pa bya'o snyam nas kā ma ru'i a ba dhū ti pa la gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhus nas bsgoms pas lo gsum nas bskyed rim gyi lam mtha' dag rdzogs/ chu gling zhig tu maṇḍal byas nas sgrub pa mdzad nas zhag bdun song ba'i tho rangs 'jam pa'i rdo rje rma bya la chibs pa mngon sum du zhal bstan nas byin gyis brlabs pas chos thams cad kyang skad cig gis shes/ dngos grub kyang thob par gyur/ rgyal po'i drung du song ste ngas ni sde snod gsum shes na / rgyal pos sngar gyi shing de la me tog ston dgos byas pas/ rgyal po yang ngo mtshar skyes nas bla mar bzung / slob dpon des gsang sngags kyi lha khang yang mang du bzhengs/ gtso bor bskyed rim dang sgrub thabs bshad/ kye rdo rje'i 'grel pa kha sbyor dri med mdzad mkhan de yin no/ /'grel pa 'di la snga 'gyur khyung po rnal 'byor gyis zhus nas glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur
bskyed rim 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i bka' babs/ 115ba la mdzad byang la yang ga ya stha bgres pos mdzad ces 'byung la/ shong blo brtan gyi 'gyur la ni ḍi ga da shas mdzad ces 'byung ste slob dpon gcig po de'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin par sems so/ /'grel pa de ni slob dpon de'i gsung rgyun slob mas bkod pa yin nam sems/ 'di dang slob dpon bha ba skandha gcig par grags so/ /slob dpon des dur ha ri zhes bya ba la bshad/ des rdo rje gdan pa snga ma la bshad/ de la rdo rje gdan pa bar pas zhus dus/ /9 slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa chen po (ma 3wadzdzas na pa )ni yul ma la par sku 'khrungs/ rigs bram ze/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas/ phyis nā land+rar rab tu byung / gsang sngags phyi nang thams cad la mkhas shing / khyad par gdams ngag shin tu che/ byang chub kyi thugs 'byongs pas ma ga dhā pa la shin tu bkra shis shing 'gro don che ba byung / a ti sha bzhugs pa'i dus tsam na rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan por mnga' gsog ba yin no / / phyis bi kra ma la shī la'i mkhan po yang mdzad//༈ de'i slob ma rdo rje gdan pa bar pa ratna ā ka ra gupta ni shar phyogs go ra'i yul du 'khrungs/ rigs ni bram ze/ chung ngu nas mdo sngags thams cad la mkhas shing / bsnyen pa yang grub pas rdo rje slob dpon du byed cing / rten dge bsnyen yin yang dge slong mang pos mtha' bskor te chos ston cing yul dbus su 'ongs pas/ rgyal po'i blon po dad pa can zhig na re/ khyed dge slong gyis shig /gzhan du na dge slong sde snod gsum pas dge bsnyen la phyag 'tshal ba 'di bstan pa la gnod pa yin zer/ nga la ma
116 bka' babs bdun ldan/rgan mo zhig gso dgos pa yod pas dge slong mi byed byas pas/ des ma'i 'tsho ba la gser srang drug cu byin/ de mas slob dpon bi kra ma la shī lar dge slong mdzad/ der paṇḍi ta dang rnal 'byor pa gdams ngag che tshad la gtugs/ slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa'i dbang rgyud gdams ngag thams cad kyang thugs su chud/ phyis rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po rgyun ring mdzad//de nas lho phyogs kyi rgyud du 'byon par bzhed nas dpon slob sum cu tsam gyis sau rir byon/ sau ri'i rgyal po'i rmi lam du rdo rje gdan gyi ma hā bo dhi'i zhal (639)nas/ nga'i bstan pa lho phyogs su ma gtong zhes gsung ba rmis pa la/ nangs par slob dpon 'khor bcas lho phyogs su 'byon pa'i po ti dang / sku gzugs sogs gdan 'dren pa'i 'u lag dgos zhes byung bas rmi lam gyi don go nas/ der rgyal pos bzhugs par yang yang gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon shin tu thugs rje che bas sau ri nyid du bzhugs pas mtshan yang sau ri par grags/ slob dpon 'di yang bskyed rim mthar phyin/ yi dam gyi lha mang po'i zhal mthong / khyad par rgya gar gyi yul rang na gdams ngag che bar byed/ des slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas la gdams pa yin/ des shu bhā ka ra gupta la/ des shā pā la la/ des rnal 'byor pa badzra shrī la/ des rtsod pa'i dus kyi slob dpon thams cad mkhyen par grags pa chos 'byung dpal/ des sangs rgyas grags pa la/ des rin chen grags pa/ des rā ti gupta la gdams te/ de dag gi bar gyi lo rgyus rgyas par mi gsung / rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ bskyed rim brgyud pa'i gtam gyi skabs te drug pa'o// //
bka' babs drug pa/tshig gi brgyud pa'i bka' babs/༄༅/ /bka' babs drug pa ni tshig gi brgyud pa yin te/ de yang tshig gi brgyud pa byas kyang rgyud kyi bshad pa'i brgyud pa yin gsung / de la rgyud mang po zhig gi bshad bka' nā ro pa dang / me tri pa gnyis la bzhugs/ yang 'ga' zhig ni klu sgrub kyis ārya de ba la bshad/ des sgra gcan 'dzin la bshad/ des zla ba grags pa la bshad/ des 'od zer 'byung gnas la bshad/des ye shes grags pa la bshad/ des shānti pa la bshad/yang rgyud kyi bshad pa mang po zhig ni 'jam dpal bshes gnyen (mañdzu shrī mi tra)gyis bram ze ye shes rdo rje la bshad nas de las brgyud pa dang / byang chub rdo rje las brgyud pa dang / yang dpal ye shes zhabs kyis rab zhi bshes gnyen la bshad/ des dpal sde dang / tsi lu pa dang / nag pa skyes dang / sman pa zhabs te bzhi la bshad/ de bzhi la 'jam dpal ye shes kyis zhus/ de la don yod rdo rje chen pos zhus/ de la siddhi bī ras zhus/ de la a ti shas zhus/de la bshes gnyen gsang bas zhus/ de la rdo rje gnad pa che bas zhus pa'i skor dang / yang mang po zhig ni/ tsi lu pa/ tha ga na/ shānti pa/ dzñā na shrī mi tra/dzo bo rje/ rdo rje gdan pa snga phyi rnams nas brgyud pa'ang yod la/ yang slob dpon la li ta badzra ste rol pa'i rdo rjes o rgyan nas rgyud mang po spyan drangs/slob dpon lī la badzra la bshad/ des 'jam dpal ye shes la bshad/ slob dpon 'dis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor gyis brdung stangs byas pas
118 bka' babs bdun ldan/stag gzig gi rgyal po glang po che dang bcas pa phye mar song ba'i gtam rgyud yod/ des ni don yod rdo rje chen po la gdams pa yin no//༈ yang slob dpon spyod pa pa dang / slob dpon bram ze dpal 'dzin zhes bya ba phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa/ lho phyogs bai darbha na dge slong sde snod gsum pa chos smra ba chen po zhig mu stegs kyi rgyal po gcig gis mgo gcod par rtsom pa la/ slob dpon rgyal po'i drung du byon te/'di mgo ma gcod byas pas/ 'o na khyod rang gi mgo slus mar thong zer bas slob dpon gyis dbu bcad nas byin/ der ma he'i mgo zhig bslan pas 'byar ba'i cho 'phrul bstan/ slob dpon ma he'i dbu can du grags so/ /des ha ri ke la la gdams/ 'dis ni phyag rgya byi lar bsgyur bas bhi ra ḍi pa zhes grags/ des kyang 'jam dpal ye shes la gdams so//༈ yang rgyud kha cig ni slob dpon ku ku ri pas spyan drangs pa yin te / de yang shar phyogs bhang ga ga'i yul du 'khrungs/ nā land+ra'i paṇḍi ta dge slong zhig yin pa nags tshal dben pa zhig tu rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/der thun mong gi dngos grub mang po yang thob/ bskyed rim yang brtan par gyur/ nang gcig phug pa'i nang du khyi gu mo zhig byung / nyin zhag 'ga' re zas kyis gso zhing yod/ der lha rnams kyis slob dpon spyan drangs te sum cu rtsa gsum du 'dug pa la/ ji zhig na sngar gyi khyi gu de dran te/ lha rnams yang 'dzam bu gling du 'gro byas pas/ ci yin zer/ khyi gu de ltogs te 'chi ba yod byas pas/ lha rnams na re/ khyed yun ring du ting nge 'dzin bsgoms na/da dung yang khyi gu'i rnam rtog kyang ma zhi'am zhes zer bas bden snyam/ slob
tshig gi brgyud pa'i bka' babs/ 119dpon gyis lo bcu gnyis lha'i gnas su bzhugs/ de nas rang gi gnas su 'ongs pa na/ sngar gyi khyi gu de ni che ru ma song bar 'dug skad/ brag gi phug la khyis brus pas chu mig kyang brdol snang ba/ khyi gu lag tu blangs pas bud med rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig tu gyur skad/ de ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin te/ de dang lhan cig tu spyod pa spyod cing / skye po'i mngon du khyi mor sprul pas slob dpon ku ku ri pa zhes grags/ des mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas nas rgyud mang du spyan drangs/ padma badzra zhes pa la bshad/ des tilli pa la/des nā ro pa la/ des shānti pa la/9 slob dpon shānta pa de ni ma ga ṅgā'i yul du bram ze'i rigs las 'khrungs te/ rig byed dang / rig byed kyi yan lag rnams dang / brtag pa brgyad la sogs pa la chung ngu nas mkhas par sbyangs so/ /kha cig rje rigs su 'dod pa'ang yod gsung / o tanta pu rir thams cad yod smra'i sde la rab tu byung / nyan thos kyi sde snod gsum po thams cad thugs su chud/ bi kra ma shī lar byon te dze tā ri chen po la sogs pa mkhas pa mang po la theg pa chen po'i mdo dang bstan bcos phal cher gsan/ gnas brtan slob dpon chen por gyur te sau ma pu ri'i mkhan por yang mnga' gsol/ lo 'ga' gtsug lag khang de nyid kyi gnas brtan mdzad do//de nas rin chen grags pa dang / nag po dam tshig rdo rje dang / tha ga na la sogs pa bla ma mang po bsten cing / rgyud brgya rtsa gsan cing thugs la bzhugs par grags so/ /de nas ma la bar phebs te/ lo bdun du thugs dam la bzhugs pas 'jam dbyangs dang / sgrol ma dang / mi pham mgon po
120 bka' babs bdun ldan/rnams kyi zhal gzigs shing dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi gsol ba las de kun yang thogs med kyi gzhung lugs dang mthun par gsung ba byung bas/slob dpon 'di 'phags pa thogs med kyi lugs mthar thug tu mdzad do//de skabs slob dpon gyi mnal lam du 'phags ma sgrol mas sing ga'i gling du bzhud cig par lung bstan no//sing ga la'i rgyal po'i rmi lam du yang / 'dzam bu'i gling na slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba yod pas de spyan drongs shig /khyod kyi yul du theg pa chen po dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa byung bas/ slob dpon bhang ga lar phebs pa dang / sing ga la'i pho nyas bhang ga lar sleb pa dus mtshungs byung / theg pa chen po'i mdo sde nyis brgya tsam spyan drangs te sing ga lar lo bdun chos gsungs/ theg pa chen po'i dge 'dun lnga brgya tsam byung / mdo sde de dag shin tu dar bar gyur to/ /de sngon sing ga lar grub chen ni mang du byon mod kyi/ dge 'dun thams (643)cad nyan thos yin par mngon no//de nas 'dzam bu gling du phebs pa'i lam du rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'khrugs pa dang / gzings la bskyod pa'i chom rkun byung ba rnams sngags bzlas pa'i bye ma gtor ba tsam gyis chom rkun rnams dbang du 'dus/ rgya mtsho'i rlabs zhi / de nas rgya gar lho phyogs kyi yul tha dad brgyud/ rim pas rdo rje gdan du phebs/ phyis rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa la bzhud par dgongs pa'i tshe/rgyal po'i rmi lam du sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal ba zhig rmi ba/ nangs par slob dpon byon pas/ rgyal pos bi kra mar bzhugs par gsol ba btab pas bi kra ma shī la'i shar sgo ba mdzad pa yin no//
tshig gi brgyud pa'i bka' babs/ 121lo rgyus 'ga' zhig tu/ rgyal po 'di ma hi pā la yin zer ba dang / kha cig las de'i tsha bo rgyal po tsa na ka yin zer ba gnyis las/ phyi ma dag par mngon no/ /der mu stegs kyi paṇḍi ta nyis brgya tsam dang snga phyir rtsod pa mdzad pas thams cad las rgyal te snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs thams cad du khyab/ sangs rgyas pa'i nang du yang mkhas pa la 'gran zla med de rgyal po'i bla mar bkur/ rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa zhes mtshan du gsol/ lha yul nas dgra bcom pa dngos su byon nas chos nyan par grags//de ltar nyin mtshan du dam pa'i chos kyi bya bas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / nam zhig na nā ro pa chen po dngos grub brnyes pas/ de la gdams pa cung zad gsan/ dgung lo brgyar nye ba'i gnas skabs kyi tshe nyan bshad kyi bya ba ma lcogs nas/ gsol chas rags pa spangs te dben pa zhig tu bzhugs pa na/ sngon rang gi slob ma zhing pa zhig dus der grub pa thob nas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'ongs nas phyag byas pa bla mas ma mkhyen/ de nas lus snang bar byas te slob dpon la phyag 'tshal lo zhus pas/ khyod su yin gsung / dngos zhing pa tog tse pa lags zhus pas/ ngas de yang brjed nas mi dran mod kyi/ da khyod kyi gdams pa de nga la byin ces gsungs pas tog tse pa des gdams pa phul/ de'i don bsgoms pas rdo rje phag mos zhal bstan te grub pa thob bo/de nas sku lus kyang nyams stobs dang ldan par gyur te slob ma rnams la chos kyang ci rigs par gsung zhing bzhugs pa las/ lan cig srod kyi dus na bud med bzhis gdan gyi mtha' nas bteg ste yud tsam pa zhig la o rgyan gyi gnas su dngos su spyan drangs/ zhag mang du bzhugs te dpa' bo
122 bka' babs bdun ldan/dang mkha' 'gro ma'i dbus su tshogs kyi 'khor lo chen po mdzad/ rdo rje'i glu mang du blangs/ tshogs kyi gtso bo rdo rje phag mos mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa 'grel pa'i mchog tu dbugs dbyung ba mdzad//de skabs ma ga dha'i slob ma dang skye bo'i tshogs kyis slob dpon gar byon cha med/ mi snang bar gyur pa yin nam snyam ste/ dus kyi mchod pa bya bar brtsams pa las/ slar yang khri'i steng du slob dpon nyid gang nas byon cha med par phebs/ slob ma rnams la rtogs pa brjod pa dang / lo rgyus gsung bar mdzad pas phal cher ngo mtshar du gyur cing / 'ga' zhig yid ma ches par yod pa las/ dus nam zhig na o rgyan gyi mi mang po zhig rdo rje gdan du mchod pa dang tshong byed pa la byung ba la ma ga dha pa rnams kyis gtam dris pas/ o rgyan gyi dhu ma ṣṭi rar dngos su phebs/ yun ring du bzhugs/ chos kyang mang du bstan cing / nged rnams kyis kyang chos thos zhes zer bas rtsod med du gyur to/ /de nas kyang 'gro ba'i don ci rigs pa mdzad/ dgung lo (645)brgya dang brgyad lhag tsam na sku 'das te/ slob ma rnams kyis bsil ba tshal du sku gdung zhugs la bzhen par brtsams pa na/ me cung zad 'bar ba na sku gdung mi snang bar gyur skad/ slob dpon 'dis rgyud sde mang po la rang stobs kyis 'grel pa mdzad cing / 'khor lo sdom pa la mdzad par rtsom pa na rdo rje phag mos bka' ma gnang ngo / /o rgyan gyi gnas su tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs pa na/ grub thob gzhan yang lnga bcu rtsa gsum tsam 'dus te/de thams cad dang chos kyi 'gro (bgro )ba mdzad par grags so//
