tshig gi brgyud pa'i bka' babs/ 123༈ yang rgyal po ind+ra bhū ti bar pa'am/ slob dpon ku ku rā dza zhes pa nyin mo khyi stong la chos 'chad par byed cing / mtshan mo dam tshig gi kun tu spyod pa byed pa zhig yod de/ de la slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis zhus pa sogs rgyud mang po'i bshad rgyud byung mod kyi/ da lta ni bklags lung tsam las cher med gsung / yang 'dir a ti sha'i lo rgyus yod kyang grags che bas ma bkod do/ /yang dus 'khor sogs rgyud sde mang po zhig ni/ slob dpon pi ṭo pa ste bsod snyoms bya ba zhig la phyag na rdo rjes lung bstan te rdzu 'phrul gyis sham bha lar byon/ rgyud mang po spyan drangs/ ratna gi rir slob ma mang po la bshad/ pi ṭo pa nyid mthar mi snang ba'i dngos grub brnyes so//slob ma drug yod pa las/ gsum gyis rdo rje'i sku grub ste mi snang bar gyur/dge slong a ba dhū ti pa dang / bo dhi shrī dang / nā ro pa gsum gyis dar bar mdzad do/ /yang a ba dhā ti pas sau ri pa la bshad do//sto de la pi ṭo pa ni rgyal po ma hi pā la'i dus su byon yang / a bhi yukta ka nas kyang brgyud de/ de dag ni brgyud pa 'di'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de ltar bla ma sna tshogs las brgyud nas bshad pa'i rgyun de dag thams cad slob dpon chen po snyigs dus kyi sangs rgyas 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa la mnga' 'o//9 slob dpon de ('jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa ste abhayānaragupta)ni rgya gar lho phyogs o ḍi sha dang nye ba dza ri khaṇḍa zhes bya bar pha rgyal rigs dang /ma bram ze'i rigs te/ gzhon nu nas rig byed yan lag dang bcas pa dang / sgra dang rtog ge la shin tu mkhas shing / chen por gyur pa na mu stegs
124 bka' babs bdun ldan/kyi rgyud dang gzhung lugs thams cad mkhyen/ skyed mos tshal zhig tu sngags bzla bzhin yod pa na/ rang gi mdun du bu mo mdzes ma zhig byung / nga gdog pa'i bu mo yin/ khyod dang lhan cig spyod par 'dod zer ba la/ de ltar ga la rung zhes bzlog nas/ nga rigs mthon por gyur pa yin pas grags pa ma yin pa 'byung / 'dir ma 'dug byas pas/ de yang phyir song ste brtags pa na sgo rnams rang gis nang nas bsdams pa de kho na ma zhig par 'dug nas/lha mo'am gnod sbyin mo'am su yin snyam pa las/ rang gi grogs mched sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yod pa la dris pas/ de ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa la/ dngos grub ma blangs pa ma legs kyi/ khyod sangs rgyas pa'i rigs su 'dug pas shar phyogs su song la sangs rgyas pa gyis gsung bas de bzhin du byas/ bhang ga la'i yul du mdo sngags thams cad la mkhas par sbyangs/ slob dpon so so la dbang bskur ba yang mang du zhus/ dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa chen por song nas 'dul ba 'dzin pa thams cad kyi slob dpon du bskos//gan cig lha khang gi khyams cig na 'dug pa la/ bu mo gzhon nu zhig gis ba glang gi sha khrag 'dzag pa zhig khyer byung ste/ de slob dpon la gtad de / nga gdol pa'i bu mo yin/ 'di khyod kyi don du bsad pa yin pas zo zer (647)ba la/ nga gtsang ma'i rigs kyi dge slong / ched du bsngos pa'i ba glang gi sha ga la za gsungs pas/ de phyir ldog nas khyams smad du mi snang bar song / der yang rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos grub gnang ba ma blangs pa yin no/ /der slob dpon sde snod gsum gyi mnga' bdag yin yang /man ngag gis yid ma tshims par mthar thug pa'i man ngag gi bdag por
tshig gi brgyud pa'i bka' babs/ 125grags pa thams cad la man ngag sna tshogs gsan cing yul thams cad du byon/ nā land+rar yang mang du bzhugs/ sde pa bzhi'i 'dul ba thams cad dang /nyan thos kyi sde snod gzhan yang shas che ba rnams dang / theg chen sde gnyis kyi mdo dang / bstan bcos rigs mi gcig pa thams cad la shin tu mkhyen pa rgyas shing / nang pa'i rtog ge la sogs pa thun mong gi rig pa'i gnas rgya mtsho la mkhas/ khyad par du gsang sngags tsam la ches mkhas/ man ngag dang bcas pa yang thob//de nas dpal sau ri pa'i drung du phebs/ khong la mnga' ba'i sngags kyi chos thams cad zhus/ rtsa ba'i bla ma yang 'di la mdzad/ slob dpon nyid kyis sngon rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po yang 'di yin zer/ so ri'i dgon pa der bla ma'i man ngag sgom bzhin bzhugs pa'i skabs shig tshes brgyad kyi dus nam srod cig la/ slob dpon sau ri pa'i chu len g.yog mo bu mo dge bsnyen ma zhig yod pa de kho na 'dra ba zhig slob dpon gyi mun khang du byung ste/ snod chung ngu zhig nas tshogs rdzas mang po bton nas/ nga slob dpon gyis btang ba yin/ khyed dang lhan cig tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya zer/ ngas tshogs 'khor sngar ma byas gsungs pas/ de ltar yang / da res gyis zer/ der slob dpon gyis rnam par rtog pas ma mdzad pas/ de na re/ khyed rgyud sum brgya shes shing / de rnams kyi mthar thug pa'i man ngag thob nas sngags kyi spyod pa la rtog pa byar ga la rung zer/ tshogs rdzas rnams khyer nas phyir song / der mun nag tu gyur pa na/ sgrub khang gi sgo rim pa gsum la gzigs su byon pa na / sgo ni rang gis nang nas bsdams pa de kho nar 'dug nas the tshom skyes te / nangs par bla ma la mdang g.yog mo bdag la tshogs skyel du btang
126 bka' babs bdun ldan/ngam zhus pas/ khyod rnam rtog shas che bas ma btang / khyod kyis ci mthong gsung / lo rgyus zhus pas/ bla ma na re/ 'o na rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos grub bsgrubs pa ma blangs par 'dug pa gsung //der yi mug nas zhag bdun du kha zas bcad de gsol ba btab pas/bdun pa'i nub mo rmi lam du thog mar bud med rgan mo zhig byung / de rdo rje phag mor shes te bshags pa phul/ gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje phag mo dngos su gyur nas khyod kyis skye ba mang por nga la bzlas pa dang mchod pa byas pas/da res dngos grub lan gsum byin yang de ma blangs pa yin pas tshe 'dir mchog mi thob/ da ni bstan bcos mang du rtsoms/ gzhan la chos mang du shod/bar dor mchog 'grub po gsung //de nas dur khrod sna tshogs su sgom bzhin bzhugs/ der rgyal por ma pa la'i btsun mo zhig gis e ḍa pu ra zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang zhig bzhengs nas phul ba der yang ting nge 'dzin sgom zhing bzhugs pas/ zla ba drug tu ting nge 'dzin thun gcig la gnas pa yang byung / dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du bzhugs dus bu gcig po gces po zhig gi ro skyel du byung ba / nye du rnams sdug bsngag chen po 'dug nas/ bar do'i rnam shes bkug ste lus de la bcug nas slar gsos/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' nus pa can du grags nas (649)rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan por spyan drangs/der yang phyogs bzhi'i slob ma rnams la chos mang du gsungs/ rtsis kyis brtags pas mkhyen te bram ze dbul po zhig gi thab kyi 'og nas gter bton te byin/ tshom rkun srung ba dang / dug zhi ba dang / dmag zlog pa dang / gzhan yang rgyud nas gsungs pa bzhin gyi gas tshogs 'grub/ sapta na ga
tshig gi brgyud pa'i bka' babs/ 127ra zhes bya ba'i grong khyer chen po zhig la me shor ba bden stobs brjod pas zhi / de nas nā lend+ra dang / bi kra ma la shī la'i mkhan por spyan drangs/ rgyal pos kyang bla mar bkur/ der rmi lam du rdo rje phag mos bstan bcos rtsom par slar yang bskul bas/ bdag lta bu'i bstan bcos kyis sems can la phan mi thogs zhus/ khyod bstan bcos rtsom pa'i tshe nga nyid lus la 'jug gi gsung / de nas slob ma so sos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor brgyad stong pa'i 'grel pa brtsams pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis shis pa brjod/ phreng ba skor gsum las dkyil chog rdo rje phreng ba brtsams pa'i tshe me tog gi char babs/ man ngag snye ma brtsams pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum du bde dgyes dus 'khor gsum gyis shis pa brjod/ snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs thams cad du khyab//gzhan yang phar phyin la thub pa dgongs rgyan dang /mngon pa la 'jig rten bsdus pa dang /'dul ba la dge slong gi rig byed 'grel pa dang bcas pa dang / 'dul ba snang ba dang / dbu ma la dbu ma'i snye ma dang / gzhan yang yo ga'i rgyud 'grel pa med pa 'ga' re la 'grel pa dang / sgrub thabs grags pa can bzhi dang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i 'grel pa dang / ma rgyud mang po'i brgal lan dang / 'jigs med lam rim dang / mdor byas dang / rim lnga'i 'grel pa/ rtsis la 'jug pa/ dus 'khor gyi brgal lan/ dus 'khor gsal byed/ gzhan yang bstan bcos thor bu dang / sgrub thabs phra mo shin tu mang ba mdzad/ sgrub thabs sna tshogs bsdus pa yang bsgrigs/ nub phyogs kyi yul du gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i tshe lhung bzed nam mkhar bzed pas zas skom gyis khengs yong ba sogs mthun rkyen thams cad dzam bha las sbyar/
128 bka' babs bdun ldan/gzhan yang khri mon du bcug pa'i skye bo 'bum phrag du ma thar bar mdzad/slob ma yang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste/ 'di phyin chad phyis byung ba'i rgya gar theg chen pa thams cad slob dpon 'di la tshad ldan du rtsi bar snang / des shubha ka ra gupta ste dge ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pa la bshad/ des da sha bā la la bshad/ des rnam par grags pa'i lha la bshad//༈ 'di (rnam par grags pa'i lha ste wi krirti de wa )ni bhang ga la'i paṇḍi ta shin tu mkhas pa zhig yin pa nā lend+rar byon te/ chos dang gdams ngag thasam cad la shin tu 'dris par byas/ yul nas 'byon dus rtsa ba'i bla mas rab tu byung gsung yang / phyis sred pa shas che ba'i skyon gyis rab tu ma byung /chung ma blangs pas bu tsha ming sring gsum skyes//gan cig rmi lam du spyan ras gzigs kyi gsung nas khyod kyis bla ma'i bka' bcag pas da ste lo gsum nas tshad rims kyis shi nas dmyal bar 'gro gsung / der shin tu skrag ste mtshams bcad nas thugs dam mdzad/ lung bstan ni thog tu babs te/ lo gsum nas tshad rims kyis btab sku 'das/ slob dpon rang gi snang ba la/ gshin rje'i skyes bus thag ring du khrid pa na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs lha lnga nam mkhar byon nas/rta mgrin gyis gshed ma rnams brdungs/ 'phags (651)pas spyan chab nar gyis phyung nas 'di rang gi lus la skyol gsung / 'phags pa'i 'khor rnams kyis tshur bskyal ba'i snang ba la/ slar yang rang gi lus la zhugs te/de phyi chad rtag tu spyan ras gzigs kyis zhal gzigs shing / nus pa yang che/ rtogs pa yang bzang po brnyes/ grub pa thob pa yin/ grags pa yang che bar byung //
tshig gi brgyud pa'i bka' babs/ 129des kha che'i paṇḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra dang / buddha shrī bha dra dang / ratna rakṣi ta rnams la bshad/ de dag la mu ni shrī bha dras zhus/ des kā ru ṇa shrī bha dra la bshad/ des shākya rakṣi ta la bshad/ des su dza ta barmā la bshad/ des skambi la'i paṇḍi ta bi mukta de ba ste rnam grol lha la bshad/ des dza na gupta la bshad/ des ra ti gupta la bshad/ des da lta sa'i steng na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i grub chen zhi ba sbas pa la bshad do/ /rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ rgyud bshad brgyud pa'i gtam gyi skabs te bdun pa'o// //
bka' babs bdun pa/thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/༄༅/ /bdun pa man ngag thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs ni/ grub chen go rakṣa'i man ngag rnams kyi bka' babs yin te/ de yang sde tshan bcu gnyis kyi dzo gi rnams na re/ smru na pas lha dbang phyug chen po la brten te thun mong gi dngos grub thob/ de la go rakṣas rlung gi gdams ngag zhus te bsgoms pas phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes rang byung du skyes pa yin zhes zer ba sogs khungs med kyi gtam sna tshogs yod kyang re zhig bzhag go/'dir grub chen zhi ba sbas pa la sogs pa paṇḍi ta khungs ma rnams kyi gsung dang / kho bo'i bla ma sangs rgyas sbas pa'i zhal snga nas kyis bla ma go rakṣa'i gdams pa ma lus pa'i mdzod du gyur pa grub thob mang po dngos su zhal mjal/ nus mthu dang byin rlabs dpag tu med pa mnga' ba'i slob dpon 'bab stegs mgon po dang / nag po mgon po dang / bram ze mgon po ste go rakṣa'i rjes 'brang rnam pa gsum po de'i bzhed pa mthun par byung bas kho bo'i bla ma yang 'di kho na 'thad gsung //༈ de yang rgya gar shar phyogs su bram ze'i slob dpon byā li pa zhes bya ba zhig gis yo byad mang po bsags te lo bcu gnyis su dngul chu'i bcud len bsgrubs pas/ 'grub pa'i ltas gcig kyang ma byung / yo byad kyang zad/der dngul chu'i sgrub thabs kyi po ti chu bo gaṅgā la 'phangs te rang nyid ldum
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 131bu spyod cing song ba na/ ji zhig na o ḍi bi sha'i yul du slebs pa'i tshe chu gcig la khrus byas pas/ sngar po ti bskyur ba der (chu )ma god par rnyed/ de dngos grub thob pa'i ltas su shes nas/ slar rang yul du phyin pa na/ dngul chu ni g.yas su 'khor zhing sgra snyan po yang grag /me tog gi char yang 'bab par mthong nas/ nang mi rnams la ci yin dris pas sus kyang ma shes/ rang gi bu mo glen ma zhig na re/ khang pa 'dir kho mo rdul dang ldan par gyur te khrus shig byas/ de phyin chad 'di ltar byung / ci yin ni ma shes zer/ de brtags pas/sngon skyu ru ra dmar po ngo ma shes te/ de ni gzhon nu ma'i rang byung gi rdul yin pa gas/skyu ru ra mdog dmar po 'ba' zhig btab pas ma grub/dus der khrus byas pa'i khrag gi zer ma zhig song bas dngul chu grub pa yin no//de nas dngul chu'i cho ga'i lhag ma rnams zla ba drug tu byas nas zos pas byā li pa rang dang chung ma dang / bu dang bu mo dang mna' ma ste lnga/ rta gcig dang drug gis rdzas kyi rig pa 'dzin pa thob skad/ der dngos grub la ser sna byas te/ lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho'i gling gi gnas shig na phyogs bzhi car 'dam gyis (653)bskor ba'i dbus na brag ri chen po zhig yod pa der 'dug skad/ dngul chu'i rdzas gser 'gyur rtsi de gzhan slong du byung dogs te mis mi thar ba'i sar bros pa yin/ dngos grub sgrub pa ni nag po chen po'i rig sngags la brten nas grub pa yin skad//gtam de slob dpon klu sgrub kyis gsan te/ klu sgrub la mkha' 'gro ma'i rig sngags shig la brten nas mkha' la 'gro thub pa'i shing lo'i lham gnyis yod pa las gcig sbas shing / gcig gyon nas nam mkha' la 'phur te byā li pa'i drung du sleb/ der slob dpon gyis gser 'gyur gyi rtsi ster dgos
132 bka' babs bdun ldan/byas pas/ des kyang khyed kyi lham de nga la byin zhig /gser 'gyur gyi rtsi sbyin du rung ngo zer/ der dngul chu'i gdams ngag mang po dang / bcud len gyi rigs bye ba brgya stong du ma dang / gser 'gyur gyi rtsi grub zin pa de nas kyang byin/ lham gcig po de yang de la phul/ lham sbas pa de gyon te nam mkha'i lam nas 'dzam bu'i gling du 'ongs/ bcud len gyi gdams ngag rgya cher spel ba yin no//de nas ljongs mu nīnd+ra zhes bya ba rgya gar byang phyogs yul sa 'dzin na ri dhi ko ṭa zhes bya ba yod/ ri de gser dang dngul du bsgyur bar bzhed pa la/ 'phags ma sgrol mas ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams 'thab rtsod du 'gyur bar mkhyen nas gser dngul du bsgyur ba bkag nas lan tshwar 'gyur bar byin gyis brlabs par grags/ deng sang yul sa 'dzin la ṭi la zer/ der byā li pas da ni ser sna byas kyang don med do snyam nas 'dzam bu'i gling du 'ongs so/ /de'i lus ni rig pa 'dzin pa thob kyang / sngar nang gi mngon par rtogs pa ni cung zad kyang med pas/ slob dpon tsarla ṭi pa zhes bya ba phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa zhig la gdams ngag zhus te bsgoms pas/ ring por mi thogs par ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes te rtogs pa don gyi glu yang blangs/ sems can gyi don yang ci rigs pa byas skad do/ / khong gi bcud len gyi gdams pa thams cad slob dpon tsarla ṭi pa la drin lan gyi tshul du phul/sto bla ma (carba stupa )des kyang dngul chu'i bcud len gyi cho ga de cung zad byas pas 'phral du grub/ des sems can mang po la phan gdags par
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 133bzhed de/ tsamaṇa'i phyogs gcig na 'brog pa'i rigs shin tu mang ba yod cing / de na 'brog pa gcig shin tu nor che ba/ ma he dang / ba men/ ba glang /rta lug sogs stong phrag du ma yod/ der bu la mna' ma zhig blangs pa de la'ang khye'u zhig btsas/ lan cig yul du ston mo chen po zhig byung ba'i skabs mna' ma dang bu chung der 'dug /gzhan rnams song ba la/ grub thob tsarla ṭi pas zas slong ba la byon/ der slob dpon la zas thams cad drangs/slob dpon na re/ nang mi rnams mi khro na khyod sdod la nangs par nas kyang nga la zas mang po byin zhig /gal te khro na/ nga nags tshal ya gir me gtong gin sdod pas nga'i rtsar bros la shog gsung / der nang mi rnams 'khor ba na snod thams cad 'phro can du mthong nas/ de thams cad kyis mna' ma la 'thabs pas/ des bu chung thogs te bros/ slob dpon gyi drung du byung ba la/slob dpon gyis bcud len gtor bas ma smad gnyis rig pa 'dzin pa'i lus su gyur/ de'i rjes bsnyegs la skye bo mang po byung //de rnams la yang slob dpon gyis bcud len gtor bas skye bo sum brgya tsam rig pa 'dzin pa'i lus su gyur te don chen po dang 'phrad skad/der tsam pa'i (655)rgyal pos gtam de thos pas skye bo mang po dang bcas te slob dpon gyi drung du song / rgyal pos phyag byas pas/ slob dpon khros pa ltar byas nas zas kyi snod sa la brdabs pas/ sa 'og nas klu'i rgyal po'i bu mo byung ste des yo byad mang po rgyal po la bstabs pas/ rgyal pos kyang slob dpon grub pa thob par shes/ brag ri'i phug lha khang gi rnam pa can gnyis bcos te/ gcig tu ni slob dpon dang ma smad gnyis te gsum bzhugs par byas/ gcig tu ni sum brgya po gnas par byas so/ /khye'u des kyang dngos grub
134 bka' babs bdun ldan/mang du sbyin nus pa yin te/ mig nas mig sman/ rna ba nas ri lu/ kha nas ral gri/ sna nas rkang mgyogs/ rdo rje nas gser 'gyur me 'og sgo nas bcud len rnams 'byung / de gsum po stan gcig la 'dug ste/ ji srid byams pa ma byon gyi bar du 'gro ba'i don byed de gnas de la yang tsasba tsarla ṭi zer/ da lta yang gsog ba btab na dngos grub myur ba yin skad//༈ de'i slob ma ni grub thob kuklu ṭi pa yin te/ de yang slob dpon chen po lū yi pa la phyi'i dbang bskur ba rnams thob kyang zer/ lū yi pa yin par gcig tu yang ma nges par snang / de nas grub thob tsarla ṭi pa la gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa mtha' dag thob nas/ dur khrod rnams su spyod pa spyod cing bzhugs la/ rig ma bcu gnyis yod pa grong khyer du 'gro ba na khyim byar bsgyur te bzhud pas kuklu ṭi pa zhes grags/ lar kuklu ṭi pa yang mi gcig pa gnyis byung gsung / de'i slob ma ni sī na pa yin te/༈ de (smyu na pa )ni rgya gar shar phyogs kā ma rsha'i nya pa yin/ nya pas rlung cung zad goms pas/ lan cig nya la lcags kyu btab ste drangs pa la/ nyas khong phar drangs te mid/ der las kyi mthu dang nya pas rlung bsgoms pas ma shi ba la/ chu bo ro hi ta zhes bya ba da lta'i bod kyi gtsang po 'di kā ma rshar sleb pa de yin pa/ de la u ma gi ri zhes bya ba'i ri de'u gcig yod pa la/lha dbang phyug gis u ma la rlung gi rnal 'byor gyi gdams ngag bshad pa/chu de la nya song bas nya'i khog gi nya pas thos te bsgoms pas yon tan du ma thob/ gan cig nya pa rnams kyis nya de bzung nas bshas pas mi gcig byung /der sngar gyi rgyal po yang 'das/ sngon rang gi bu btsas ma thag pa yang der
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 135lo bcu gsum lon/ gar nya'i khog tu lo bcu gnyis bsdad/ de nas slob dpon tsarla ṭi pa'i drung du song ste pha bu gnyis gas gdams ngag zhus te bsgoms pas/ gnyis gas kyang grub pa thob ste pha ni grub thob smru na pa zhes grags/ bu ni grub thob ma tshin dra pa zhes bya'o//grub thob rmā na pa'i slob ma ni ha li pa ste zhing rmod mkhan/ mā li pa ste skyed mos tshal mkhan dang / tai bo li pa ste so rtsi mkhan te grub thob gsum byung / ma tshin dra'i slob ma ni tso rang gi pa dang / go rakṣa nā tha gnyis yin/༈ de yang dang po (coraṅgi pa )ni rgyal po'i bu zhig yin/ lan cig rgyal po yul gzhan du song ba'i dus shig na/ btsun mo chun ma zhig yod pa rgyal bu gzugs mdzes pa la chags te rgyal bu'i drung du yang yang 'ongs kyang /rgyal bus 'dod pa dang du ma blangs pas de khros te rgyal po byung ba'i tshe/gos ni dral/ mgo ni thal bas g.yogs/ yan lag nas khrag phyung ste 'dug pa la/ rgyal pos ci nyes dris pas/ 'di ni lha'i sras kyis byas te/ de kho mo'i drung du 'dod pa don du gnyer bar byung ba la/ kho mos 'dod pa dang du ma blangs pas 'di ltar bgyis (657)so zer//de nas rgyal pos ma brtags par rang gi bu nyes pa med pa rkang lag bcad de sa phyogs shin tu dma' ba skye bo mang po 'gro ba'i lam gyi 'og cig tu shing drung gcig gi rtsabar bor/ der slob dpon ma tshin dra pa byung ste/ de la lo rgyus bshad pas/ 'tsho ba ni ngas sbyor nus na/ khyod kyis lo bcu gnyis sgom nus sam gsungs pas/ des kyang nus par khas blangs/ de nas slob dpon ma tshin dra pas rang gi slob ma ba glang rdzi phyug po zhig yod pa la pha
136 bka' babs bdun ldan/gi'i shing drung cig na mi yan lag bcad pa zhig yod kyi/ de la khyod kyis lo bcu gnyis su zas skyol gsung / des kyang de bzhin du byas/ mthar lo bcu gnyis song ba'i dus shig na lam de la tshong pa mang po mtshan mo 'gro ba la/tso rang gi pas khyed rnams su yin dris pas/ de rgyal po'i sho gam pa yin gyis dogs nas/ nged rnams sol ba 'tshong mkhan lags byas pas/ de na re/'o na khyed rnams kyi yo byad thams cad sol bar gyur cig gsung //tshong pa rnams tshong 'dus su sleb nas zong bkram pa na thams cad sol bar song 'dug ste/ phan tshun du cis nyes zhes brtags pa na tso rang gi'i tshig gi nus pa yin par shes nas/ tshong pa de rnams kyis slar song nas tso rang gi pa la bzod par gsol zhing gsol ba btab pas/tso rang gi pa na re/ 'o na sngar bzhin gyur cig byas pas tshong pa rnams slar ldog nas bltas pa'i tshe yo byad thams cad snga ma bzhin du thams cad bzang por gyur nas 'dug /de slob dpon gyi drin yin par shes nas zong gi phud slob dpon la phul ba/ slob dpon ma 'dod de slar khong rnams nyid la gtad do//der rang gi yan lag sngar bzhin du gyur cig byas pas de bzhin du song ngo //'gro ba'i don yang ci rigs pa mdzad de mkha' spyod du bzhud skad//lta grub thob go rakṣa ni zas sbyor ba'i ba glang rdzi de nyid yin te/ ma tshin dra'i gdams ngag gis rnal 'byor thob nas/ phyi rol gyi bya ba gzhan spangs te bsgoms pas rju 'phrul dang dngos grub thams cad thob/ des bsams pa / nga'i rtogs pa 'di gzhan la spo snyam ste/ yul thams cad du skye bo mang po la gdams pa bstan pas thams cad grol/ sems can bye ba phrag gcig ma grol gyi bar du mkha' spyod du mi 'gro bar dmyo/ bcas/ sems can dpag
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 137tu med pa grol bar mdzad bzhin pa'o/ /'di'i lo rgyus mtha' yas pa ni bri bar ma lang ngo/ /de la slob ma'i gtso bo yang bcu gnyis yod mod kyi/ 'dir bka' babs pa ni grub thob kurṇa ri pa yin te/༈ de (karṇa ri pa )ni yul me ba ra'i rgyal po yin/ 'di'i btsun mo ping ga lā zhes bya ba zhig yod pa sleb nas lo 'ga' song ba na rgyal po la shin tu snying nye ba yin yang / rgyal pos brtag pa'i phyir rang nyid skyed mos tshal du song / stag gis zos so zhes shi brdzun byas pas/ sdug bsngal gyis de ma thag btsun mo ping ga lā shi nas lus dur khrod du bskyal/ rgyal po yang grong khyer du mi 'gro bar dur khrod de nyid du btsun mo shi ba'i ro'i drung du hā ha ba ping ga lā zhes zer zhing 'dug go/de ltar lo brgyad thal kyang skad/ bcu gnyis thal kyang zer te/ der grub thob go rakṣa byon te/ rdza'i chu snod ḍi pi gcig lag nas lhungs ma thabs su byas nas bcag ste/ de'i mya ngan byed cing hā ha ba ḍi pi zhes zer zhing bsdad pas/ rgyal po na re/ rnal 'byor pa blun po chu snod chag pa la ci'i phyir mya ngan byed gzhan zhig bcos pas tshog mod byas pas/ slob dpon na re/ 'o na khyed nyid blun gyi/ nga'i chu (659)snod chag pa da ltar shul yod la/ khyod kyi ping ga lā ni da ltar rdul tsam du song ste mi snang na/ da dung khyod nyid mya ngan byed pas so / / der slob dpon grub thob go rakṣar shes nas rjes su bzung ba zhus pas/rgyal srid spongs gsung / des kyang rgyal srid spangs nas phyi bzhin du 'brangs/lan cig gi tshe slob dpon sha chang la dga' ba ltar mdzad pas/des grong khyer du sha chang nyo bar song ba na/ bud med cig gis phag gi sha drug dang / chang
138 bka' babs bdun ldan/gi bum pa drug bsgrigs te/ rin du khyod kyi mig g.yas pa sbyin na 'tshong gi gzhan zong rnams mi dgos zer/ der slob dpon la mchod pa'i don du mig g.yas pa tsham tshom med par bton te byin no//de nas sha chang de rnams slob dpon gyi drung du phul bas/ khyod kyi mig g.yas pa gang du song gsung / slob dpon la mchod pa'i don du 'di rnams la btsongs pa yin byas pas/ khyod kyi de bden na mig g.yon pa yang nga la byin gsungs pa las/ g.yon pa yang phyung ste phul lo/ /der slob dpon mnyes te byin gyis brlabs pa lo gsum nas mig gnyis kyang sngon bzhin du gyur/ de rjes lo gsum na grub thob chen por gyur to/ /'di la be ra ga nā tha zhes kyang zer/ de'i slob ma ni nā go pa ste bod skad gcer bu pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /da lta'i dzo gi mang po rgyal po garna ri pa dang / rgyal po bhahra ri gcig par 'dod pa shin tu 'khrul gsung ngo //༈ de la grub thob nā go pa ni/ sku la snal ma gcig kyang ma gsol bas gcer bu ba zhes grags pa yin no/ /des lho phyogs kyi yul du bzhugs tsa na / lan cig kong ku na'i rgyal po'i btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du byon te gdams ngag gsungs pas/ rgyal po khros te slob dpon gyi yan lag lnga bcad nas phyogs bzhir bor ro/ /der 'grig pa la yang bcad/ de ltar gan bdun song ba'i tha mar slob dpon gyis dmod pa bor bas rgyal po yan lag lnga rang chad de shi /yang kun gyis gsol ba btab pas gsos so/ /de ltu bu'i nus pa yang bstan/ de nas ri bo bhin da pa la bzhud de da lta yang lus ma spangs par yod skad/
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 139༈de'i slob ma ni/birū pa chung ba'i slob brgyud go len nā tha ste rdzama'i mgon po zhes bya ba yin no/ /de yang dang po 'dus pa mang pos g.yengs pa la zhe bcad byas te/ rdza ma chen po gcig gi nang du zhugs nas dngos grub ma thob bar 'di nas mi ldang ngo zhes dam bcas nas/ rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas lo bcu gnyis na grub pa thob ste/ skal ba dang ldan pa la gdams ngag ci rigs pa bstan nas/ bla ma gcer bu pa bzhugs pa'i drung du song ste mi snang bar gyur skad//༈ de'i slob ma ni oṃ ka ra nā tha yin te/ yul dbus na rgyal rigs kyi bu chung zhig chung ngu nas pha 'das shing phu po'i khyim du gso ba las go len nā thas rnam 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs shig byin no/ /de tsam ma gtogs lo bco brgyad lon gyi bar du rig pa gcig kyang ma bslabs pas/ phu bo dang khyim bdag mos blun po khyod kyis ci rung zhes spyos nas phyir phyung bas/ yid 'byung nas gzhan gyi yul du slong mos 'tsho zhing rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub par byed/ mthar gyis lo bcu drug song ba na ting nge 'dzin bzang po yang skyes nas/ nub phyogs hi ga lā tsi lha mo u ma'i gnas su song nas lha mo'i rdo sku'i steng du zla ba drug gnyid kyi 'od gsal thun gcig bsgoms pas lha mo skrag nas/ rnal 'byor pa rid dhi de hi ki ni dhi de zhes zer ba na/ rnal 'byor pas rdzu 'phrul dang gter gyis ci byed/ ye shes kyi dngos grub sbyin na blang mod byas pas/ lha mos bdag la grub thob sbyin du med/ (661)go rakṣa las long zer ba gas/ des go rakṣa 'tshog du song ba na/ yul go dā ba ri na rnal 'byor pa grangs med pa 'dug pa'i grag gyi tha ma zhig na/ bzhin
140 bka' babs bdun ldan/shin tu mi sdug pa/ yan lag las rnag khrag lhung ba zhig 'dug pas de yin par shes nas phyag btsal zhing gsol ba btab pas/ des byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshod ma phul gang gnang ba 'thungs pas de nyid du shes bya'i yul kun la mnga' brnyes/ chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i grub thob chen por gyur nas chos bshad do/ /des paṇḍi ta chen po rā ti gupta la gdams pa yin no//༈ de (rā ti gupta )ni rgya gar lho phyogs su sku 'khrungs/ rigs ni tshong dpon gyi bu/ cher skyes pa na sangs rgyas pa'i sde la rab tu byung ste/ sde pa ni thams cad yod par smra ba yin gsung / blo shin tu rno bas 'dul ba 'bum sde dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'bum sde yang thugs la bzung / phyi rol gyi rig pa'i gnas la shin tu mkhas/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos 'tshol bar bzhed nas shar phyogs dang / rgya mtsho'i gling phran dang / nub phyogs kyi gnas mang por byon/ slob dpon chen po rin chen grags pa las dkyil 'khor bcu gsum du dbang bskur ba zhus/ yang slob dpon chen po dzñā na gupta la ra khang gi yul du dkyil 'khor drug cur dbang bskur ba zhus/ bal po'i yul gyi paṇḍi ta da shā ba lā la ping ha zhes bya ba la dbang dang gdams ngag mang po zhus/ rgyud kyi bshad pa yang slob dpon de gsum la zhus pa shas che//lan cig rgya gar shar phyogs su ston mo chen po zhig gi sa na/mu stegs ral pa can 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor pa hrul po gcig 'dug pa la/ de dang gtam 'dra byas pas/ gzhan sems shes par 'dug nas su yin dris pas/grub thob a si ta gha na yin gsung / der zla ba tsam bsten te gdams ngag
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/141kyang mang du gsan skad/ grub thob oṃ ka ra nā tha la yang gdams pa dpag tu med pa gsan/ de nas yul ru lu ra ti la sogs pa lho phyogs kyi yul gyi gtsug lag khang sum cu tsam gyi gnas brtan mdzad/ bskyed pa'i rim pa la brtan pa thob/ rgyud sde lnga bcu tsam mkhyen pa yin no/ /rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ gdams ngag sna tshogs brgyud pa'i gtam gyi skabs te brgyad pa'o//༈ de ltar bka' babs de thams cad ni grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po zhi ba sbas pa la mnga' ba yin te/ de la slob dpon 'di ni lho phyogs grong khyer dza la maṇḍal te chu'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya bar 'khrungs/ rigs ni rgyal rigs/ gzhon nu nas rig pa'i gnas phra mo mang po sgra dang rtog ge yan lag dang bcas pa rnams la sbyangs/ yab kyang rje btsun sgrol ma nyams la zhal mthong ba'i sngags pa yin/ de la sgrol ma'i dbang bskur ba dang sgrub thabs kyang gsan/dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa la rgya mtsho'i 'gram kong ku na'i yul du gser gyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i gnas gzhi zhig dus de tsam na btsun tshugs bzang ba/ chos grwa dar ba/ dge slong lnga bcu tsam/ dge bsnyen yan chad la 'dus che dus stong phrag tsam 'ong ba zhig yod pa der mkhan po rāti gupta la bsnyen par rdzogs/ dang por nyan thos kyi sde snod rnams dang / de nas dbu sems kyi gzhung lugs thams cad la mkhas par sbyangs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa dang / sems tsam mdo bzhir grags pa la sogs pa gsung rab du ma thugs nas bshad/ mkhan po la yon 'bul ba dang / rnyed bkur (663)chen po bya bar bzhed nas/ sing ga ga'i gling
142 bka' babs bdun ldan/du yug cig byon/ der nag po chen po'i rig sngags cung zad grub pa dang /chos bshad pa'i mthus rnyed bkur dpag tu med pa byung / de rnams bla ma'i drung du bsnams te rin po che sna bdun gyi phung po chen po byas te phul/dbang dang gdams ngag rnams zhus pas thun mong gi dbang thams cad bskur/ rgyud lnga bcu tsam gyi bshad pa phal cher yang gnang / 'on kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang dang gdams ngag rnams ni ma thob bo//de nas lo mang por bla ma'i tha na thal ba 'phyag pa tshun chad kyi g.yog mdzad cing / rang gi longs spyod chos gos gsum ma gtogs bla ma la phul/rang gi zas ni grong khyer gyi bsod snyoms kyis mdzad/ de ltar lo drug song ba'i rjes su bla mas kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang gong ma rnams dang /byin rlabs sna tshogs pa dang / gdams ngag thams cad gnang / de dag bsgoms pas nyams bzang po yang skyes/ der mkhan po sku 'das te/ gtsug lag khang de thams cad kyi bdag po yang mdzad/ dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan lo dgu'i bar mdzad//de dag tu yang mtshan mo ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig sgom bzhin bzhugs/ 'on kyang nyin mo dge 'dun gyi bya ba sna tshogs pa des ye shes mi 'phel bar mkhyen nas dge 'dun la yang yang gnang ba zhus kyang dge 'dun rnams kyis ma gnang ba la/ der slob dpon gyis chang gsog/ grong khyer gyi sung kha rnams su skad rigs sna tshogs kyis glu blangs/ sgo dang sgo ru gar sna tshogs mdzad pa/ dge 'dun rnams na re/ mkhan po chos mang po la mkhas pa yin pas chad pa mi byed kyi/ da khyed 'tsho ba gang bde bar song zhes zer bas/ da ni don thams cad 'grub snyam ste yul sna tshogs su brgyud/
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 143yul 6 ba la'i grong gcig gi 'dabs su spyil po zhig tu lo gsum sgrub pa mdzad/ de nas nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul du bzhud/ der yang lo gsum tsam bzhugs//lan cig chu 'gram zhig na smad 'tshong ma drug khrus byed cing 'dug /ji zhig na de rnams rtsig pa zhig gi phag tu song / 'di rnams ci zer dgongs te gsan pas/ gcig gis gcig la gtam gyi tshul gyis phyir zlog man ngag drug bshad kyin 'dug /de la sogs pa ngo mtshar du ma gzigs shing / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis grogs mdzad pas ye shes gong nas gong du 'phel yang / de kho na nyid kyi gnas ma rtogs nas de kho na nyid ston pa'i slob dpon sems bzhin yod pa la/ der chang 'tshong ma zhig gi sgor byon pas/ de rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par gyur nas/ shar phyogs kyi yul na slob dpon ye shes bshes gnyen zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ des khyod la 'dod pa'i dngos grub ster bar 'gyur gsung //de nas slob dpon rim gyis shar phyogs su byon/grong khyer gyi mi thams cad dang / phyi nang gi gnas thams cad du song ste ye shes bshes gnyen dris pas kyang bshad rgyu mi 'dug /tsarya pa'i sde rnams kyi nang du phyin te dris pas kyang gzhan su la'ang bshad rgyu med/ lan cig de na rnal 'byor pa rgan po zhig na re/ de ni nged tsarya pa'i slob dpon nus mthu tshan po zhig yin pa la / da gar gshegs cha med nas lo mang po lon zer/ de nas kyang yang yang btsal bas/ lan cig nags kyi grong dang nye ba'i mchod rten gcig gi grib ma la 'gron btsun khyim btsun gyi cha byad gcig nyal nas 'dug /de la ye shes bshes gnyen khyed kyis mthong ngam dris pas/ de'i zhag (665)nas/
144 bka' babs bdun ldan/shes te nga yang de'i drung du 'gro ba yin/ 'di nas shar phyogs na ti pur zhes bya ba'i grong khyer na yod gsung / bstan par zhu byas pas/ nga'i nor 'di rnams nags 'di la khyod kyis 'khyer thub na bstan gsung / der khur lci mo zhig 'dug pa bsnams te byon/ 'gron btsun de ni sngon la song / zhi ba sbas pa ni lam du tshom pos bzung / khur bshigs pas rdo 'ba' zhig byung ste rkun po rnams tshig pa zos te/ slar yang cher brdungs/ sa la ro bzhin 'gyel ba na yang slob dpon de byung ste/ chus bkrus shing sngags btab pas 'phral du gsos te 'gro thub par byung //ti pu rar byon pa'i tshe bla ma bstan par zhu byas pas/ mtshe'u gcig gi 'gram du khrid nas/ der bla ma rang gi gzugs brnyan shar ba la/ ye shes bshes gnyen ni 'di yin zhes gsungs/ des kyang ngo sprad pa bzhin du song nas ting nge 'dzin bzang po zhig kyang skyes/ 'o na bdag rjes su bzung bar zhu byas pas/ khyod spyi brtol che/ rnyed bkur med par rjes su bzung bar zhu zer ba gsungs nas khros shing mang du brdungs/ der khyim bdag nor chen po zhig la/ ngas khyod kyi las kyi g.yog byas na nga la gla ji tsam ster byas pas/de na re/ nyi ma re la gser di nar re re sbyin zer/ de'i g.yog lo gcig mdzad/ rgya gar ba'i zhing las kyi khol po ni shin tu sdug gsung //der gzhan yang yo byad mang dag ster mkhan byung ba de thams cad slob dpon la phul/ yang bla ma'i phyi bzhin song ba na/ gan cig nags gseb cig na ma he mo sna thag btags pa zhig 'dug /'di khrid cig gsungs/ bla ma sngon la gshegs/ zhi bas de khrid nas phyin pas/ bdag pos phyi bzhin bsnyegs pas zin nas des shin tu brdungs te thang la ro bzhin
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 145song ba la/ bla ma byon nas thabs mdzad pas gsos/ yang lan cig bla ma'i rdzas 'dra rtswa khyim pa 'dra la bcol te bzhag /dpon slob gnyis grong khyer la byon te ldog phebs pas/ rtswa khyim thams cad la me 'ur 'ur 'bar gyin 'dug /der bla ma rang gi rdzas la thugs khrag che che ltar mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ 'o na bdag gis blang ngam zhus pas/ long gsung / der me'i dbus su tsham tshom med par zhugs te bla ma'i rdzas rnams blangs pas rkang lag thams cad rus pa la thug gi bar du tshig /lus thams cad kyang chu bur du gyur/de la shi yang bla ma'i rdzas kyi phyir yin snyam ste 'gyod pa'i sems ni skad cig kyang ma byung / de yang rdzas 'gangs che ba med de chu snod gcig /na rī ke la'i phor pa gcig /shing gi maṇḍal gcig /ka pā la gcig rnams yin gsung / der nges par 'chi'am snyam pa la/ bla mas sngags dang sman mdzad pas ring por mi thogs par gsos//der zhi ba sbas pa'i thugs la/ bdag gi lus ngan pa 'di gso ba'i phyir du slob dpon gyi sman zad par byas pa ni ma legs/da yang slob dpon gyi phyir du bdag nyid dka' ba du ma byed pa ni rang gi don 'ba' zhig yin pas/ de la slob dpon las sngags dang sman blang ba shin tu mi rung bas/slob dpon nga'i g.yog tu mi bkol zhes dam bcas/ yang gan cig slob dpon ra khang gi yul du 'byon par bzhed nas grur zhugs pa na/ ji zhig ltar na chu'i dkyil nas nya mche ba can zhig nyang gis byung / des slob dpon la gnod par 'gyur gyis dogs nas de la mdung thung zhig bsnun/ nya des zhi ba sbas pa'i zhabs la rmugs/ (667) chu'i dkyil du nyas 'khyer la khad pa la/ bla ma dran par byas pas lha'i kha nas btang ste nya chu la song ngo / /der
146 bka' babs bdun ldan/rmas sdug bsngal bar gyur kyang slob dpon gyi rim gro byed pa la ma g.yel bar byas pas/ zhag bdun song ba'i tho rangs shig ci byas med par zug rngu rnams zhi//yang shar phyogs ra khang gi yul der slob dpon brag phug cig tu bzhugs/ zhi ba sbas pas grong khyer sna tshogs nas yo byad 'tshol ba sogs don mang po la 'gro dgos/ yul de ni chu klung shin tu mang bas yang yang rkyal zhing brgal dgos pa gas/ srog chags si sā ra ste 'dzin khri'i rigs su gtogs pa bod la chu srin spir du grags pas kyang lan gsum bzung mod kyi/ slob dpon rang gis kyang nus pa rnyed pa dang / bla ma dran par byas pas des kyang btang ba 'ba' zhig byung / gzhan yang srog chags kṣiṃ ka ra dang / nya dang chu'i sbrul la sogs pas zos shing phug pas rmas pa ni bgrang du med gsung / de thams cad la bla ma'i sngags dang sman gcig kyang ma blangs te / sngags dang sman sogs phan pa'i thabs thams cad gzhan gas bslangs/yul der slob dpon logs su ma bzhugs pa/ 'khor mchog gi rnal 'byor pa lnga/ rig ma bcu gnyis dang bcas te tshogs kyi 'khor lo yang dang yang du spyad pas/ zhi ba sbas pa ni rgyu 'grul gzhan pas mang ba mdzad dgos shing / yul de'i chu'i srog chags gzhan pas gdug pa che bas lo gsum du lus shin tu sbyong spyod che yang / thugs la skyo dub gcig kyang ma byung ngo / /de dus kyi 'khor de kun phyis dngos grub thob pa sha stag byung gsung //de nas dpon slob gnyis gru la brten te bhang ga lar byon/ dang po mjal nas de bar gdams ngag tshig gcig kyang ma gnang bas/ der gdams ngag gnang bar zhus pa na/
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 147rnyed bkur med par rjes su bzung mdzod ces//de nyid thob ma thag tu slob dpon la//lhag pa'am mnyam zhes 'gran byed mi de la//dpal chen rdo rje sems dpa'ang 'jigs zhes gsung //zhes bya ba yin gsungs te khros shing ma mnyes pa'i tshul bstan te bros nas bzhud do/ /der bang thag pa nas brgyugs kyang rjes ma zin/ zhag bdun du yul de'i phyogs thams cad du btsal yang ma rnyed/de nas thag ring por song nas grong khyer sna tshogs su mi rnams la dris kyang cha med/ de ltar zla ba gnyis su btsal yang ma rnyed pas/ gho ra ṭaṃ ḍa zhes pa'i grong khyer zhig tu zhag bdun ngu bzhin gsol ba 'debs kyin bsdad/ der yang ma byon pas/ da ni tshe 'dir skal ba med pa yin/ 'di nyid du shi bar bya snyam ste brag de'u gcig gi rtse nas mtshongs pas kyang yan lag bsnad pa sogs med cing gnod pa cang ma byung / der yid skyo bas cung zad cig bsdad pa na/ rig ma ngo shes pa zhig phyogs der byung ste/ slob ma bzang po ci byed kyin yod gsung / slob dpon gyi rig ma bla ma yin pas zhabs la spyi bos gtugs te/ kho bo ni skal ba med de bla mas bor bas 'chi bar sems byas pas/de na re/ khyod slob dpon gyis nges par rjes su 'dzin par rog gsung / der yid cung zad spro ba skyes te/ slob dpon gang na bzhugs dris pas/ bla ma ni nga'i khyim du byon nas zhag 'ga' bzhugs te da lta bal por bzhud gsung / bud med de mi snang bar thal lo/der zhi ba sbas pas lam du zhugs byon pa na/ brag rtse nas mchongs pa mthong ba'i mi rnams kyis ci'i phyir mtshongs zhes 'dri ba mang du byung ba
148 bka' babs bdun ldan/la lan ni ma smras/ kho bo bla ma ma rnyed pas sdug bsngal ba la/ 'di kun sos re dag na snyam tshig pa za bar byung skad/ de nas bal po'i yul du byon te grong khyer dang gnas gzhi so sor dris pas/ gzhan rnams su shod mkhan ma byung / yaṃ bu'i nag po chen po'i lha khang gi dkon gnyer na re/ de 'dir byung ste zhag 'ga' tho co'i spyod pa 'dra byas nas kā ma drar song zer/ de ma thag kā ma rū la gtad nas byon pas nags kyi lam rnams su chom rkun dang /stag dang / ma he dang / bse ru la sogs pa 'jigs pa ji snyed byung yang /bla ma 'ba' zhig dran par byas pas gnod pa ma byung / kā ma ru'i grong khyer ga ru ḍa gha ṭa na slob dpon bzhugs pa dang mjal/ dga' ches te lus sa la brdabs pa'i phyag brgya stong du ma byas so/ /der bla ma na re/ gal te khyod gdams ngag 'dod na/ nga'i bla ma a si ta gha na mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i sa/ he raṃ pa'i brag gi rtse de yin pas/ der so phag gi mchod rten mi 'greng lnga yod pa zhig bzhengs shig gsung //de nas yul der phyin nas gos zhig yod pa phag bre'i rin la sprad nas/ pha gu brdeg pa dang so gtong ba thams cad kyang zhi ba sbas pa gcig pus mdzad/ de nas khyim bdag dad pa can gcig gis grogs cung zad byas nas he raṃ pa'i rtse mor mchod rten bzhengs zin nas/ bla ma'i drung du 'ongs pa na khyim bdag la grogs bcol ba des mi rung zhes gsungs te/ de nas kyang lo gcig gi bar gdams ngag ma gnang //de rjes o ḍi sha'i grong khyer ka ṭa ka bha na ra si na bzhugs pa'i dus su bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyim zhig bstan te khyim 'di na gser mang du yod
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 149pa brkus nas nga la phul zhig gsungs/ de yang khyim de ni mgar ba nor che zhing ser sna dam pa/ phyi nang gi rab tu byung ba gang la yang sdang ba zhig yin te/ dang por de'i khyim du zhi ba sbas pas zhugs phyin pa na/ de'i sgo srung gis brdung rdeg mang po byung / der slob dpon sku'i stobs che bas sgo srung de phyag gcig gis mnan te nang du tshangs kyis zhugs pas/ mgar ba de lcags kyi las byed pa dang thug ste/ de shin tu khros nas lcags gong dmar 'bar ba zhig zhi ba sbas pa'i sku la 'phangs pas na bza' yang ma tshig /sku la yang gnod pa ma byung ste/ der khyi mche ba dug can mang po rbad byung ba de rnams kyis slob dpon la rmugs kyang sku la gnod pa ma byung zhing / thugs kyang g.yo ba med par 'dug pa des mthong nas cung zad dad par gyur te/ de na re/ khyod der rog zas drangs kyi zer zas ngan ngon zhig drangs/ der shin tu dgyes pa ltar gsol bas/ de yang cung zad ngo mtshar skyes shing / khyed zas 'di tsam gyis tshims na nangs par nas kyang shog cig zer//der yang dang yang du byon pas 'dris par gyur pa'i mtshams shig /de'i khyim dang yo byad kyi gnas tshul thams cad kyang slob dpon gyis shes nas/ des sdig pas bsgrubs pa'i gser srang stong phrag tsam yod pa su la yang sbyin par mi nus pa de/ lan cig khong rnams yengs pa zhig la slob dpon gyis brkus nas 'ongs te bla ma la phul bas/ bla ma na re/ bu de legs/ser sna can gyi nor 'di gzhan la sbyin dgos gsungs te/ ra khang gi yul gyi dge 'dun rnams la phul zhig gsung ba ltar 'bul bar byon//
150 bka' babs bdun ldan/phyis zhi ba dus gzhan lan cig grong khyer du song ba la/ sngar gyi mgar ba des zin te yul de'i rgyal po mu kunda de ba la gtad nas sngar gyi (671)lo rgyus rnams bsnyad/ der stes dbang gis skye bo mang po yang 'dus/ rgyal pos slob dpon nyid la dris pa la/ slob dpon gyis ser sna can gyi longs spyod ni brkus pa'am phrogs te gzhan la byin na/ de nyid bsod nams 'phel ba yin gsungs pas/ der mi thams cad kyis gad mos btab ste / 'di ni rkun po chen po zhig ste 'di'i spyi brtog la ltos/ 'di ltar rkun mo byas pa yang yon tan du rtsi'o zer/ der rgyal pos re zhig btson khang du zhog cig phyis brtags la chad pas gcod do zhes rgyal po skye bo dang bcas pa so sor gyes so//bar der slob dpon ye shes bshes gnyen gyis dgongs pa mdzad pas/ btson khang gi steng du bya rnam pa sna tshogs pa 'dus/ mtha' kho ra khor yug tu khyi dang ce spyang sna tshogs pas nyin mtshan bye brag med par bskor zhing skad 'byin pa byung bas the tshom du gyur pa la/ de'i phyir de'i nyin par de pho brang la yang de bzhin du byung bas der rtsis pas/ rnal 'byor pa btson khang du bcug pa zhig gi nus pa yin zhes byung / de nas zhag 'ga' zhig lon pa na btson khang gi sgor ye shes bshes gnyen byon nas btson srung rnams la bye ma gtor bas thams cad rengs/ sgo lcags kyang rang bye nas zhi ba sbas pa dang btson lnga stong lhan cig thar/ zhi ba sbas pas btson khang du zla ba phyed song / gser blangs pas bla ma mnyes pa re dga' snyam pa ma gtogs mi dga' ba dang yi mug sogs gtan nas ma byung / /de nas slob
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 151dpon gyi phyi bzhin du 'brangs te yul tri ling ga zhes bya ba'i grong khyer zhig tu byon/ grong khyer der phebs tsam nyid nas bla mas kyang gdams ngag mang du gsungs/ de nas lo gnyis tsam song ba na bla ma na re/ da dbang bskur bar bya dgos pas/ chu po'i pha rol gyi khyim pha gi na rigs dang ldan pa'i sngags can ma 'di lta bu zhig yod/ de 'dir khrid shog gsung //nangs par 'gro'am zhus pas do nub nyid khrid la shog gsung / der chu bo chen po zhig yod pa la rkyal nas song ste nyi ma nub tu nye ba na khyim der sleb/ khyim de ni rgyal rigs rgyal po'i glang chen gnas pa zhig yin/ grong khyer gyi ming yang lañdza ka ra zhes bya ba yin gsung / khyim der kho bo 'grul pa zhig yin/ yud tsam gnas g.yor gsungs pas/ des kyang nang du byon zer te byon/ der slob dpon gyis steng 'og kun tu brtags pa na/ bla mas lung bstan pa de ni khyim bdag de'i bu mo yin te/ de ni shin tu bsrungs pa yin pas thabs ci zhig gis thob par 'gyur sems so//de nas srod kyi dus su skye bo'i rgyu 'grul chad pa na/ slob dpon gyis rig sngags kyis ngag bcings te bud med de re zhig cang mi smra ba byas nas/ stobs chen pos phrag pa la bkag te/ sgo rnams kyang stobs kyis phye nas bros so/ /grong khyer gyi phyi rol du sleb pa na nang gi mi rnams kyis rjes bsnyegs kyang ma zin/ nub mo de nyid la chu bo la rkyal nas 'ongs/ bla ma'i drung du nam phyed kyi dus su sleb/ bla ma na re/ dus kyang la nye legs pa yin gsung / der tho rangs kyi dus su dbang bskur/ zhag bdun gyi bar du byin gyis brlabs pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa mtha' dag
152 bka' babs bdun ldan/stsal/ gnas de yang brag de'u gcig la yod de/ sngon slob dpon klu sgrub kyi phug pa yin gsung / glang chen gnas kyi rjes gcod kyi mi rnams kyang khong gnyis chus khyer bar bsams te phyogs der phyis ma byung //de nas bla ma sbyin sreg cig mdzad pa'i skabs slob dpon gyis las kyi rdo rje mdzad pa la (673)bya ba cung zad cig phul bas bla ma khros nas thab kyi me mang po gtor bas/ des rkyen byas te bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes nam mkha' lta bu mtha' dbus med pa mnyam nyid khyab brdal gyi ye shes mngon du gyur nas chos thams cad kyi gting sleb/ der rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen por gyur to/ /bud med des kyang rnal 'byor ma byas te spyod pa pa'i sde rnams su song bas/ rnal 'byor ma me na ka zhes bya bar grags/rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam/ lta stangs bzhi grub/ chu la mi bying / phyis dngos grub kyang thob bo/der bla ma ye shes bshes gnyen na re/ zhi ba sbas pa/ ngas khyod la gdams ngag thams cad ni bstan zin/ don chen po yang grub/ da khyod sau raṣṭar song la thog mar spros med kyi spyod pa gyis/ de nas gsangs te spyod pa gyis/ de nas spros bcas kyi spyod pa byed par gzhan zhig bskul bar 'ong bas de'i tshe spros bcas kyi spyod pa gyis shig /tshe 'di nyid la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang 'thob bo gsung / der zhi ba sbas pas/ bdag 'di ltar chos thams cad kyi gting sleb pa ni bla ma'i sku drin lags pas tshe 'dir dngos grub mchog ma thob kyang sla'i/ bla ma nyid kyi rjes su 'brang zhus pas/bla ma na re/ ngas khyod gcig pu'i phyir lo de snyed cig mi'i yul du gnas pa
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 153yin/ de bas na nga'i rtogs pa 'di skal ba dang ldan pa thams cad la khyod kyis smos shig ces gsungs te/ de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /der bla ma'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni bdag nyid kyis mngon du gyur pas som nyi thams cad ni chod mod kyang / bla ma'i gzugs kyi sku de mi snang bar song bas thugs rab tu gdungs par gyur te glu blangs so/ /der slob dpon ye shes bshes gnyen de lo bcu tsam bsten pa yin gsung //de nas gdung ba'i glu len pa'i tshul gyis zab mo'i don ston bzhin du rim gyis rgya gar nub phyogs sau raṣṭa zhes bya ba'i grong khyer zhig dang mi ring ba'i phyogs shig tu smra ba thams cad spangs/ yang nas yang du mnal zhing sad pa na yang mnyam par bzhag pa kho nas bzhugs/ lam du lan cig stag gzig mong gol zhig gis phyag zhabs me la bsregs pas kyang rdo sku'am shing sku me la bsregs pa bzhin du tshor ba med pa ltar bzhugs/ yang hin du'i rta pa zhig slob dpon la dad de gser dang dngul gyi me tog bre gang sku la gtor bas kyang snga ma ltar tshor ba med pa ltar 'dug /bdag gi bla ma'i zhal nas gtan ma tshor ba ni min/ stong pa nyid du gzigs pa yin gsung / de ltar lo gnyis 'das sam yang zer/ phyed dang gnyis song ngam yang zer/ phyi ma dag ste spyod pa zla ba drug tu spyod dgos pa/ da ltar gyi dus 'grub dka' ba yin pas lan gsum du bskyar ba yin gsung / de ni shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa'o//de las grol te grong khyer dang nags tshal rnams su rgyu zhing gsang ste spyod pa cung zad mdzad pa la/ ji zhig nas a ba dhā tī 'jig rten pa'i mngon du spyod pa smyon pa'i brtul zhugs zla ba drug tu mdzad de/ bar bar
154 bka' babs bdun ldan/du skye bo rnams la chos kyang bstan pas ye shes mchog skyes pa mang du byung /grong khyer gyi mi mang pos kyang slob dpon ye shes can du shes nas ci rigs par mchod pa la/ yul de'i rgyal po stag gzig gi rigs sngon sangs rgyas pa rnams la snyad 'tshol ba zhig yod pa/ yul der dge slong mang bas/ phyis dge slong rnams kyi btsun tshugs la dad de/ sangs (675)rgyas pa la mchod pa mang po byed pa zhig yin pas/ slob dpon gyis sngags kyi spyod pa byas pa la yid ma ches te slob dpon gyi drung du byung nas/ ka ye khyod thun du smra ba zhig /rab tu byung ba rnams sun 'byin par byed dam zhes zer ba la/slob dpon gyis kho bo cag ni 'dod pa la longs spyod bzhin du yid gzhan du gyur pa med do//rgyal po na re de brtag par bya'o zhes slob dpon pho brang gi nang du spyan drangs/ yang thog shin tu dben pa zhig tu bzhag /sku lus la na bza' med pas rdzas sbed pa'i gnas med/ nye 'khor du rtog pa'i mi ni nyin dang mtshan du gnas/ zas skom gcig kyang ma drangs par nyin zhag bdun 'das kyang sku lus snga ma bzhin du 'dug la/ der rgyal pos yul khams kyi bzhin bzang ma stong lhag cig kyang zer/ lnga brgya yang zer/ de tsam bsdus/ khyed sngags kyi spyod pa can yin na 'di rnams nyin zhag gcig tu spyod nus sam zhes slob dpon la gtad pa na/ spros bcas kyi spyod pa spyod par bskul ba 'byung zhes bla mas lung bstan pa de yin par mkhyen nas de rnams dang lhan cig tu rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod cing / bdag nyid kyi nus pa bstan pa'i phyir de rnams kyi lus ro bcud dang bral bar mdzad cing /bdag nyid nyin byed lta bu'i gzi brjid dang ldan pas nyi ma gnyis pa la
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 155pho brang gi yang thog nas rgyang grags tsam mkha' la gya gyur gshegs te thag ring po'i skyed mos tshal zhig tu bzhugs so/ /yul phyogs de yang zhing mchog tu gyur pa yin pas/ pho nya mo yang shin tu mang ba yin te tshogs kyi 'du ba khyad par can gyi spros bcas kyi spyod pa yang zla ba drug mdzad/ ghir na ri zhes bya ba'i ri la bzhugs pa'i dus shig tu phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang nyams 'og tu chud par gyur la/ de'i dus nam tho rangs kyi tshe sa g.yos/ sgra chen po byung / dri bzang pos khyab/ me tog gi char babs/ nam mkha' nas rol mo'i sgra bsgrags pa ni skye bo thams cad kyi mngon sum du byung / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhal cig car gzigs/ yi dam sna tshogs pa dang grub pa thams cad mngon sum du byon nas shis pa brjod/ zhag bdun du gnas gsum gyi mi ma yin dang / dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyun ma chad par byung / ri de la slar yang zla ba drug tu mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig la bzhugs//de nas lho phyogs kha gen dā zhes bya ba'i ri la bzhugs pa'i skabs shig /yul ptaṃ nāṃ gyi rgyal po dga' byed gtum po zhes bya ba ri dwags bshor du 'ongs pa na/ ri'i zur zhig na ri dwags hi raṇa zhig 'dug pa mthong / de'i rjes bsnyegs te phyin pa na/ hi raṇa de ni stag cig tu gyur/der yang cung zad brtags pas de yang me zhig tu dmar 'khyug ste song /lo ma'i spyil po zhig gi nang du zhugs so/ /rgyal pos de la blta ru song ba na dge slong gi gzugs gzi brjid che ba zhig 'dug nas/ khyed su yin dres pas/ gan gnyis su slob dpon cang mi gsung / lan gsum pa
156 bka' babs bdun ldan/dris pas/ sdig spyod kyi rgyal po ci zhig smra/ kho bo rnal 'byor pa zhig yin gsung //der lta stangs kyis zil gyis mnan pas rgyal po lhag par dad nas zhabs la phyag byas te yang dag pa'i gtam ci rigs pa gleng zhing yod pa'i tshe / 'khor rnams kyang der 'ongs te slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal/chos kyi gtam gyis dga' bar mdzad/ bram ze'i khye'u zhig la snying po'i don (677)bstan pas glu dang gar mang du byas shing mi snang bar gyur skad/de'i ming ni dzanma de ba zhes zer te/ slob dpon 'di'i slob ma grub pa thob pa sngon ma ni de yin skad/ der dge tshul paṇḍi ta kaṃ bhe ra ma ti zhes bya ba zhig slob dpon gyi drung du byung ste shin tu dad nas slob mar khas blangs te rim gro thams cad byed cing gnas so//de yang snod dang ldan par mkhyen nas dbang bskur zhing gdams pa gnang / des kyang bsgoms pas ring por mi thogs par rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub thob/ slob dpon rdzu 'phrul gyis gang du gshegs pa der des kyang bla ma'i rim gro byed pa la 'byon nus pa yin no/ /de nas slob dpon ma ru'i yul du byon nas mu stegs dang / tu ruṣka ste kla klo stag gzig rnams la rengs pa'i lta stangs kyis rengs par mdzad/ yul gyi mi dang gtso po rnams dbang du byed pa'i lta stangs kyis dbang du mdzad/ skye bo rnams la chos kyang bstan pas ye shes khyad par du gyur pa'ang mang du byung zhing / yul 'di na nang pa lhag par mang bas dge 'dun phal cher gyis zhabs la gtugs//thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa gnang ba'i slob ma ni drug yod de/paṇḍi ta bi ma la sa hya dang / tsand+ra ā ka ra dang / ratna ka ra ste dge slong paṇḍi
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 157ta gsum dang / dge bsnyen paṇḍi ta su ga ta dang / rnal 'byor ma u ma pa ti dang / rnal 'byor ma tā raṃ ga rnams so/ /de la dang po gsum yang bskyed rdzogs kyi rtogs pa khyad par can brnyes/ ngag gi dmon pa dang bden tshig 'grub pa yin/ 'di gsum kus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs/ dge bsnyen su ga tas las bzhi dang / khyad par mngon spyod thogs med du 'grub/slob dpon 'di bzhis lhan cig shar phyogs kyi lngongs su lta zhing byon pa la/ shar phyogs kyi kla klo pa ṭhā na rnams kyis yul 'khor rnams la ches sdug bsngal ster zhing / phyi nang gi lha khang thams cad kyang bshig pa gzigs/khyad par rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi de ba gi re zhes bya ba'i ri la sangs rgyas kyi lha khang mang po yod pa de skabs me la bsregs/ kha sarba ṇa'i gtsug lag khang la'ang me btang mod/ mes ma tshig /slob dpon grogs mched rnams byon pa la yang / nga'i yul du mgo bregs gos dmar can 'di lta bu sngar med pa las da ltar 'ongs pa ma legs zhes slob dpon bzhi po btson dong du bcug /gshed ma bskos te bkrong bar bsams pa las/ gshed ma dang btson srung rnams la nyungs kur gtor bas/ de rnams dran med du myos pa'i bar la bros nas byon te byang chub chen po la gsol ba btab pas/ drag po'i phrin las 'grub cing bya ba'i dus yin par lung bstan//de nas dza ri khaṇḍar slob dpon 'di bzhi zhal 'dzom ste gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor lo bskor bas/ zla ba drug tsam na pa ṭhā na dang / mo khol nang 'khrugs te shar phyogs kyi tu ruṣka'i rigs thams cad g.yul ngor brlag /hend+ra'i rgyal po man shing zhes bya bas 'dzin pa byung ngo / /u ma pa tis
158 bka' babs bdun ldan/'ja' lus grub/ rnal 'byor ma mā tā raṃ gas lta stangs bzhi thegs med du grub/ der slob dpon nyid kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i slob ma rnal 'byor pho mo nyi shu tsam byung / de nas lho phyogs kurṇa ṭa kur bzhugs tsam na/ de'i yul gyi rgyal po ni mu stegs pa yin pas de 'dul ba'i phyir rgyal po'i pho brang du byon/ pho brang nang na sngon srid sgrub kyis bzhengs pa'i ling ga 'jigs su rung ba gcig yod pa'i steng du byon te gar mdzad pas zhabs rjes byung //rgyal pos glang po che khros pa (679)drug rbad pas glang po che drug kur phyag gis mnan pas g.yo ba med/ tsaṇḍi kā'i rdo sku cho 'phrul che ba zhig yod pa la sdigs mdzub mdzad pas mar gyi gong bu la nyi ma phog pa bzhin du mer gyis zhu/ da lta sku de ya cha ba gcig tu song 'dug gsung / der rgyal pos kyang grub pa thob par shes nas phyag byas/ slob dpon grub pa brnyes pa'i grags pa phyogs thams cad du khyab pas ma ra ha ṭa dang / koṅku na'i dge 'dun rnams kyis spyan drangs te de'i gtsug lag khang thams cad du phebs/dbang bskur ba dang / gdams ngag sbyin pa dang / rgyud bshad pa la sogs pas rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa cher gsal bar mdzad/ paṇḍi ta sum cu tsam dang / gzhan yang 'khor rnam bzhir gtogs pa drug cu lhag gcig dang grong khyer gyi mi bcu gcig tsam gyis phra mo rnams grub//gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin mchog thob pa mang du byung zhing / de nyid du dngos grub mchog thob nas mi snang bar gyur pa mang du byung / de nas rbha nāṃ gyi rgyal pos spyan drangs te yun ring du mchod pa byas shing / der gser gling dang / dha na shrī'i gling dang / bai gu'i gling dang / ra khang dang pu gang la sogs pa thag ring po'i gling rnams dang / gzhan yang 'dzam bu gling gi dge
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 159slong rnams dang / paṇḍi ta ji snyed 'dus te rgyal pos kyang de thams cad la lo gsum du mchod pa byas/ rab tu byung ba ni stong phrag gsum tsam/ dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma ji snyed cig dang / gzhan yang phyogs bzhi'i rnal 'byor pa brgya stong du ma rnams la la ni sgrub thabs zhu//la la ni gdams ngag zhu/ la la ni dbang dang byin rlabs zhu bar byed/kha cig ni zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing skor ba la sogs pas las 'brel 'jog par byed de/ lho phyogs ka ling ku'i paṇḍi ta chen po bai da 〉stsa dang /saṅga shī la dang / ma lnga ra'i yul gyi slob dpon chen po bī ra bantu dang / a saṅga bo dhi dang / pañtsa dha ra ba li'i yul gyi slob dpon ā nanda ma ti dang / bee dā nanda dang / pu gang gi yul gyi mkhas pa chen po dharma kṣa gho ṣa dang / pa ra hi halho khudang / rdo rje gdan pa su me gha la sogs pa rnams kyis slob dpon chen po nyid dang / rnal 'byor ma dī na ka ra dang / slob dpon chen po gi ñtsha ra ma ti la sogs pa slob dpon gyi thugs kyi sras rnams la rgyud sde zab mo thams cad zhus/ de ltar slob dpon 'di'i bka' drin gyis 'phags pa'i yul gyi dge 'dun sogs nang pa thams cad la rdo rje theg pa'i bka' drin bstsal ba yin no//nas gling dang gser gling dang zangs gling la sogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams ni nyan thos sendha pa kho na yin pa'i phyir slob dpon 'di'i bka'i gnang bas ma khyab ste/ gu ru shar phyogs pa nir pa ṇa shrī slob dpon gyi drung du bzhugs pa'i tshe slob dpon chen po tri ling ga'i tshong 'dus chen po gcig na bzhugs/ skye bo brgya stong du ma phyag 'tshal zhing yod pa la/ mahā bo dhi mjal du 'gro ba'i nas gling pa'i dge slong mang po 'dug pa de kun
160 bka' babs bdun ldan/gsang sngags la ngan du zer zhing / slob dpon la phyag mi 'tshal bar 'dug gsung //de nas tri ling ga'i yul der rgyal po bi ka ṭa zhes pa na ba'i gto bcos la mi mang po dang ma he lnga stong / bya dang ra lug 'bum phrag mang po bsad pa'i mchod sbyin byed dgos zer te/ der cho ga byed pa'i mu stegs dang bram ze brgya stong 'dus/ srog chags thams cad bcings nas yod pa'i skabs shig /slob dpon ni gang nas byung cha med par de rnams kyi mchod sbyin khang par byon/ bram ze dang mu stegs thamasacad la lta stangs mdzad pas thams cad rengs/ (681) der rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes nas 'ongs pas/slob dpon na re/ srog chags 'di snyed cig bsad na khyod myur du 'chi/ shi nas kyang dmyal bar skye/ 'di rnams thong zhing (thongs shig )gsung / de rnams bkrol te btang ma thag tu slob dpon gyis rgyal po'i mgo bor phyag bzhag pas nad las grol/ der mchod sbyin gyi mi rnams kyang rnal 'byor pa 'ba' zhig byas/ ye shes khyad par can skyes pa mang du yod gsung //der yul tsañtsa'i tu ru ṣka'i rgyal po zhig slob dpon bzhugs pa dang nye ba'i lam la song bas/ der slob dpon la ngan du brjod pa mang du byas pa slob dpon gyi slob ma zhig gis thos pas/ khyed rnams lkugs par gyur cig ces dmod pa btab pas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa de nyid du lkugs/der shin tu skrag nas slob dpon la gsog ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas pa rnams kyi nus pa bstan pa'i phyir gcig ma gtogs pa thams cad smra nus par gyur cig ces gsungs pas de bzhin du gyur/ yang yul dbus su byon/wā rā ṇa sīr mu stegs kyi paṇḍi ta ye shes can du 'dod pa ma da su da na swa
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 161ra swasti 'khor mang po'i dbus su khri mthon por gnas pa la sdigs mdzub mdzad pas khri de las lhung / ma thu rā'i yul du sngon nang pa'i rnal 'byor pa cung zad byas pa/ phyis mu stegs pa'i rnal 'byor pa byas pa'i mu kunda warti zhes pa des a hu ṭha tsaṇḍa lī bsgrubs nas skye bo mang po dbang du byed pa grub thob tu grags pa de lta stangs kyis tshar bcad de/ de yang mthar bcom brlag gi grong khyer du slob dpon dpon slob gsum tsam phebs pa zhig la/mu kunda warti 'khor dang bcas pa yang der 'ongs pa 'dzom/ grong khyer gyi skye bo dpag tu med pa yang der 'tshogs te/ 'di gnyis kyi grub rtags blta'o zhes zer ro//der mu kunda de mig 'phrul gyi rig sngags grub pa yin pas/ sngar stag gzig gi rgyal po chen po ha me hu pā tsa la dang / de'i bu a ka par sogs kyang dad par byas pa zhig yin/dus der slob dpon gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pas mig 'phrul gcig kyang sprul ma nus shing / slob dpon gyis 'di la lta stangs mdzad ma thag bhyo nas ha ha zhes rgyug cing zhag bdun du ma sangs/ de'i slob ma rnams kyis slob dpon la gsol ba btab pas slar gsos so//bha nāṃ gyi rgyal po snga ma ni dus der 'das/ de'i bu stobs bzang po zhes bya bas/ sngar pha dang thog mar mjal ba'i gnas de dang nye ba na slob dpon nyid yang dang yang du bzhugs pa'i phug pa zhig yod pa de'i sgor lha khang chen po bzhengs te phul/ lha 'bangs kyi khyim lnga brgya yang phul/ rnal 'byor pho mo mchog tu gyur pa lnga stong tsam 'dus pa'i dus shig byung bas/ de rnams la zla ba gsum du tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad pa'i yo byad rgyal pos phul te tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ slob ma rnams sems rgyud grol ba
162 bka' babs bdun ldan/yang 'di dus kho na mang ba byung / de'i byin rlabs kyis rgyal po de la mnga' zhabs sngon grong 'bum tsam yin pa la/ da ltar 'bum phrag bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i bdag por song / gu ru lto phyogs pa'i zhal snga nas kyang lan lnga mjal ba'i rting ma 'di dus yin gsung //de nas phal cher gnas 'di nyid du bzhugs/ 'gro ba dpag tu med pa smin cing grol bar mdzad nas/ de rjes slob ma rnying pa mchog rnams ma gtogs mi mjal bar lo bdun tsam song ba na rnam smin gyi sku 'ja' tshon ltar yal te ye shes kyi sku mkha' khyab tu (683) bzhugs par gyur to / / spyir rgya bod gnyis mi 'dra ste/ bod na ni dpyod ldan rnams kyang bskyed rdzogs sam lta ba'i rtogs pa bzang tsam yod pa dang / nyams ban bun shar ba dang / yi dam chos skyong ci rigs zhal mthong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes ci rigs shar ba dang / las tshogs dang nus mthu than thun thob pa tsam la grub thob tu ming 'dogs la/ blun po rnams kyis ni khrel dang tshul lugs btang ba'i zog po 'ga'/ sbyin 'bras kyi dbang thang che ba tsam la'ang grub rtags su 'dzin cing grub thob yin zhes zer la/ rgya gar ni rgyud nas gsungs pa'i 'phags lam gyi sa thob pa'i yon tan mngon du gyur pa'am/ lus 'ja' lus su gyur pa sogs thun mong gi rig 'dzin tshad ldan cig thob na grub thob tu 'dzin gyi/ gzhan ni ji tsam bzang yang sgrub pa po zhes pa las grub thob ces mi zer ro//slob dpon chen po 'di ni lta stangs dang / ji tsam gsungs pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ba'i tshig kho nas phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub par mdzad/
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 163cung zad dag pa'i 'khor gyi dbus su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung / tshogs kyi 'khor lo gong bu dang khu ba dang chang dang khrag dang nags tshal gyi shing tog la sogs pa dngos su dgug par mdzad/ sa steng gi 'dren pa gcig pu par gyur pas mtshan yang shrī sa twa nā tha ste/ dpal sems can gyi mgon po zhes che ba'i tshig tu skye bo rnams rjod par byed do//rje btsun de nyid la kho bo'i bla ma rgya gar ba gsum car gyis chos gsan cing / gu ru lho phyogs pa ni chos kyi sras mchog tu gyur pa'ang yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang bla ma gsum nas zhal lung rgyas pa rnams bla ma chen po nyid la gsan/ slob dpon gi bhi ra ma ti dang / rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug ma chen mo dī na ka ra gnyis la dbang dang byin rlabs dang bshad pa mang du gsan 'dug /dogs pa gcod pa ni slob ma'i gtso bo bcu tsam la mdzad par snang mod kyi/ slob ma'i gtso bo rnam pa gnyis po de'i rnam thar mdor bsdus brjod na/sto dang po (gi:ra ma ti )ni/ yul gu dzi rā tha zhes bya ba na/ rgyal rigs kyi bu gha gha zhes bya ba zhig blo shin tu rno bar gyur nas sgra dang rtog ge yan lag dang bcas pa la mkhas par gyur/ a bhā'i gtsug lag khang du rab tu byung / ming ga rtswa ra ma tir btags/ sde snod gsum gyi tshul yang mang du shes/'on kyang lo tshigs ma rdzogs pas rten ni dge tshul yin//dgung lo bcu dgu pa la slob dpon gyi drung du bsnyen/ lo gsum du dbang dang gdams ngag ni ma gnang / bla ma bsten tshul ni rgyud dang mthun par mdzad/ de nas bla mas dbang bskur zhing gdams pa gnang / lo gnyis
164 bka' babs bdun ldan/nas bskyed pa'i rim pa la brtan pa thob/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ye shes kyang ci rigs pa skyes/ slob dpon nyid kyi bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir du rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub bsgrubs pas 'phral du grub/bla ma bsten tshul mkhas pas slob dpon gyi dbang rgyud gdams ngag thams cad thob/ thog mar spyan ras gzigs dang rta mgrin zhal gzigs//de nas 'jam dpal dang gshin rje'i gshed/ de nas dges pa rdo rje dang ku ru kulle zhal gzigs/ nag po chen po rtag tu bran bzhin byed/'jig rten pa'i lha mo drug gis bka' thams cad sgrub pa yin/ mnal thams cad 'od gsal du tshud/ mngon par shes pa rgya chen po mnga' yang bla ma'i rim gro sgrub pa'i bran mdzad pa yin no//lha rnal 'byor ma dī na ka ra ni/ lho phyogs kyi grong khyer shaṃ bha da ta zhes bya ba zhig na/ pi si la'i rigs rgyal po gzhon nu (685) 'phrog byed 'od ces bya ba zhig yod/ de la sring mo chung ngu nas blo rno zhing dge ba la dga' ba zhig yod pa/ lo dgu lon pa'i dus shig na/ sgo drung du dge slong mdzes pa gzi brjid che ba zhig byung / de la bsod snyoms skyel du phyin/ der khyed mi bzang bzang 'dra ba zhig bsod snyoms spyod pa 'di sdug bsngag byas pas/de na re/ nga ni mi sdug na khyod nyid sdug bsngal te/ 'khor ba ru 'khyams 'dug pa gsungs nas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mang du gsungs/ de las thar ba'i thabs shig zhu byas pas/ sems kyi bzhag thabs dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i gnad khyad par can bslabs pas des kyang legs par shes//
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 165lo bcu lon pa'i dus su yul 6 ba gar rgyal rigs rgyal phran zhig la bag mar btang / lo bcu gsum lon pa'i dus su 'khor ba la yid nges par 'byung ste/ khyim thab dang gyos sgyug sogs la/ kho mo nags tshal rnams su ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa zhig byung na ci ma rung / khyed rnams kyis gnang ba mdzod ces yang yang smras pas/ de bzlog pa'i phyir du khyim gyi bdag mor bskos/ slong ba po ci byung ba thams cad la sbyin pa rgya cher btang bas nang mi dang gnyen tshan rnams kyis smod/ slong mo ba dang skye bo rnams ni bstod pa zhig byung / de nas dus gzhan zhig na phyo rdzu btab/ spyod pa sna tshogs pa byas pas der g.yog mo zhig dang lhan cig dben pa zhig tu bzhag /snga ma gas kyang phyo ba che che ltar brdzus pas khyim thab dang bral/ de yang sngon btsas pa'i tshe/ 'di'i rkang lag la padma dang 'khor lo phyed phyed kyis mtshan pa 'dug pas nags su gnas na ni bdag nyid chen mor 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa ltar thog tu babs pa yin gsung //6 ba la dang nye ba ma ra ha ṭa'i grong khyer zhig na/ slob dpon chen po zhi ba sbas pa bzhugs pa thos nas/ mtshan thos pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin skye ba snyam byung / zhal mthong ma thag ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skyes/ dus de'i tshe na lo nyi shu tsam lon pa yin skad/ bud med yin yang blo ni shin tu rno ste/ de gong du tsand+ra byā ka ra ṇa yongs su rdzogs pa shes/ mngon brjod dang /sman dpyad dang / rtog ge yang ci rigs pa mkhyen/ sngon gyi bag chags kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdun brgya pa dang / sum brgya pa dang / sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa rnams bklags pa tsam gyis zin/ dge slong ma dang /dge bsnyen ma 'dra la dris pas don yang legs par shes/ de nas slob
166 bka' babs bdun ldan/dpon chen po zhi ba'i zhal snga nas la thog mar byang chub tu sems bskyed pa la sogs pa zhus shing / skal ba dang ldan par mkhyen nas rim gyis dbang bskur ba dang gdams pa mtha' dag gnang / slob dpon gyi drung du lo bdun du rdo rje theg pa la thos sgom cig car byas pas rgyud thams cad kyi don legs par mkhyen//de nas lo lnga'i bar du bla ma'i rim gro dang sgom pa rtse gcig tu byas pas/ye shes khyad par can skyes te rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ rlung gi rnal 'byor gyi nus pas glang po che brgyas kyang stobs 'gran du med pa dang /dpag tshad tsam du nam mkha' la 'gro bar byed/ lta stangs dang ngag gi bden pa yang grub/ der bla ma'i zhal nas/ da ni khyod rig brtul gyi spyod pa gyis shig /de kho na nyid kyi rtogs pa yang sems can la ston cig /deng nas lo nyi shu rtsaganyis 'das pa na nga dang mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan skad//zla ba drug tu spyod pa spyad pas thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad la sogs pa thams cad (687) nyams 'og tu chud/ drung du byung ba thams cad la gdams ngag bstan/ rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma lnga brgya'i 'khor dang bcas nas yul sna tshogs su 'gro ba'i don spyod cing / slob dpon gyi drung du mchod pa'i phyir dang / rtogs pa'i tshad 'bul bar yang dang yang du 'byon par snang gsung / lan cig rdzu 'phrul gyis kha gend+ra nas/ rang ga nā tha zhes bya ba'i gnas su byon/ de na phyi nang gnyis ku'i gnas yod pa la/ de'i phyi rol pa'i gnas rnams su yang dang yang du 'khyams pa ltar mdzad//
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 167de nas dzigha ma dbang phyug chen po dang / bhe ra ba grub par grags pa lta stangs dang khu tshur gyi rig pa grub pas sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la bar du gcod pa zhig yod/ ming ni bhi ga de ba zer/ des rnal 'byor ma la lta stangs byas pas ma gnod/ rnal 'byor mas de la lta stangs byas pas sa la 'gyel te dbugs 'gyu ba chad/ der ring zhig bzhag pas gnas de'i mu stegs pa rnams kyis yang yang gsol ba 'debs par byung bas/slar yang lta stangs kyis gsos/de yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad/rjes su 'dzin par zhus pas slob dpon gyi drung du brdzangs/yang 'dis dam tshig nyams pa'i rnal 'byor pa bha ma la warma zhes bya ba sngon nus pa cung zad thob pas grub thob tu dzub zhig dang o ḍi shar 'phrad/ lta stangs mdzad pas gsus pa brdol te khrag zags/ des thod par bzed pas de yang brdol/de ltar dam tshig nyams pa tshar bcad gsung / dpal he ru ka dang / khro bo bcu/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsabadun la sogs pa thams cad nam blta 'dod pa'i tshe zhal gzigs/ 'on kyang de skabs mchog gi dngos grub ni ma thob par grags/de ltar slob dpon zhi ba sbas pa slob ma'i mchog gnyis dang bcas pas kho bo'i bla ma gsum la legs par gdams/ de la kho bos rdo rje theg pa'i lam man ngag go babs dang bcas pa'i bka' drin thob pa yin no//spyir rgya gar du gsang sngags la rig pa 'dzin pa 'bum phrag thog mar byung /de nas dpal sa ra ha byon pa nas bzung / rgyal po dharma pā la 'das pa'i bar du grub thob rgyun ma chad par ma zad grub thob mang po dus gcig tu bzhugs par byung ba yin//
168 bka' babs bdun ldan/de nas a bha yā ka ra sku 'das bar la'ang grub thob rgyun ma chad par byung la/ de man chad du res 'ga' na lan re re gas ma byung / khyad par dus phyis grub thob gzhan med par yun ring rabs shig na ye shes bshes gnyen dang / o ka ra nā tha byon kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan che ba tsam ma byung / o ka ra sku 'das nas/ lo brgyad cu lon tsa na grub chen zhi ba sbas pas grub pa brnyes te/ dus kyi dbang las sangs rgyas pa mang nyung gis gzhan phan che chung ma gtogs sdo bo nā ro pa chen po dang gzhan phan che chung 'dra la/ go 'phang slob dpon 'di mtho ba yin no/ /rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ bka' babs thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa'i gtam gyi skabs te dgu pa'o//༈ bka' babs bdun po de dag ni dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i brgyud pa 'ba' zhig yin cing / de'i nang gi yang drug po de dag ni don gyi brgyud pa kho na lags/ gdams ngag phra mo re re zhing gi bla ma brgyud pa mi 'dra ba rnams ni brgyud pa'i yi ge las shes par bya zhing / rnam par thar pa mtha' yas pa ni yi ger 'bri bar ga la lang / brgyud pa'i bla ma 'ga' zhig gi rnam par thar pa (689)ni mi gsung bas re zhig de tsam yin no//'dir da lta rgya gar du grags pa'i lo rgyus gang thos pa rnams kyi steng du sngon gyi slob dpon gyi lo rgyus bod na yod pa'ang yid ches nges pa rnams kyis cung zad kha bskangs nas bshad pa yin no//spyir rgya gar du byon pa'i shing rta chen po rnams dang / brgyud pa'i rnam thar ci rigs pa da dung rgezhan du bshad par bya'o//
thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs/ 169bla ma'i rnam thar brjod pa las//bsod nams cung zad gang thob pa/des ni 'gro ba ma lus pa'ang //de 'dra'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas gyur//bdag kyang skye ba thams cad du//brgyud ldan bla ma thams cad kyi//bran dang bran du skye ba dang //thugs kyi gsang ba 'dzin par shog/ngo mtshar bka' babs bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang gi lam//phyogs kun skye bo rnams kyi nyer spyod rgya chen dang //man ngag rin chen gyis gang bdag sems shing rta yi//bgrod byar gyur te srid gsum dbul ba sel bar shog/ces bka' babs bdun ldan gyi brgyud pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam zhes bya ba rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka'i 'bangs kyi tha chung du gyur pa tā ra nā tha zhes bya bas rang lo nyer drug pa la nye ba na/ grub pa'i gnas mchog dpal stag lung thang dang nye ba rnam rgyal rab brtan zhes bya bar legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo ldan kun dga' rnam rgyal lo//oṃ swasti/ ngo mtshar rlabs brgya blo mkha' 'god 'phyo ba//don bzang nor bu tshig gtsang chus khengs pa'i//
170 bka' babs bdun ldan/chos byung legs bshad sngon med yid bzhin mtsho//sde bzhi dge bcu'i spang khang chen mor 'khyil//zhes 'jam dbyangs bla ma mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos chos sbyin du stsal ba sarba dkarmāṇi bha btu// //ces bka' babs bdun ldan gya brgyud pa' rnam thar nga mchar rmad du byung ba rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam zhes bya ba rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka'i 'bangs kyi tha chung du gyur pa tā ra nā tha zhes bya bas rang lo nyer drug pa la nye ba na/ grub pa'i gnas mchog dpal stag lung thang dang nye ba rnam rgyal rab brtan zhes bya bar legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo ldan kun dga' rnam rgyal lo//oṃ swasti/ ngo mtshar rlabs brgya blo mkha' 'god 'phyo ba//don bzang nor bu tshig gtsang chus khengs pa'i//
dpar skrun smon tshig༄tsho/ /rnam grol zhi ba'i rgya mtshor ro gcig tu/ /gzhol ba'i mtha' yas chos tshul dal 'bab klung / /tshig gi zegs ma res kyang dug gsum gyi/ /dri ma yongs 'khrud legs bshad bdud rtsi 'di/ /par du bskrun pa'i rnam dkar phung po'i mthus/ /yang dag chos kyi sgo mo stong phrag brgya/ /gdangs te rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /nges legs nor bu'i mdzod la dbang 'byor shog/ces pa 'di yang deng dus yid srub kyis rgyud brlams pa'i kla klo'i sdig spyod mi bzad pas gangs ljongs chos ldan gyi zhing du thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che nyin mo'i snang ba ltar 'bar ba de ni ming gi lhag ma tsam du nyam nyis par byas/ phyogs dang phyogs na rdul phran gyi mtshon cha sogs gdug pa'i gnod 'tshe gya gyu'i sbyor ba ni nyin re bzhin du dar ba sogs sgo kun nas lnga bdo'i rgud tshogs mtsho ltar brdol ba 'di dag lhag med du zhi zhing / byang phyogs bod kha ba can du bstan pa'i me ro slar yang sngar bzhin gsos te rgya gar 'phags pa'i ljongs 'dir yang thub pa'i bzhed dgongs dri ma med pa dar rgyas su 'phel slad dang / 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon la 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam ston rnam 'dren shākya seng ge'i ring lugs sgo kun nas rgyas pa sogs 'phral yun legs tshogs du ma'i ched du dmigs/ sbag sa nang bstan shes rig 'dzin skyong slob gnyer khang du/ nang bstan grub mtha' ris med kyi gsung rab par du bskrun dang bskrun 'gyur gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i dge bsngo'i smon tshig tu 7shākya'i dge sbyong chos smra ba ngag dbang blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o//
